source.title: Orchestrator REST APIs
source.provenance: Derived from the generated artifact committed by the MIT-licensed upstream project; the proprietary raw API document is intentionally not redistributed here.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ac_ls
operations.summary: Retrieve Access Control Lists
operations.description: Returns all ACL configurations for a specified appliance. Each ACL contains entries with permit/deny rules and associated route map (rmap) references. Data can be retrieved from cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true or omitted, retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance (slower but current).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_action_logs
operations.summary: Get action/audit log entries
operations.description: Retrieves action/audit log entries within a specified time range. Logs track all operations performed by Orchestrator (system actions) or users (user actions). Results are ordered by queued time descending (newest first).

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time boundary in milliseconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp). Required unless format=csv.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time boundary in milliseconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp). Must be greater than or equal to startTime.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of log entries to return. Capped at 10000 if not specified or exceeds limit.

parameters.name: logLevel
parameters.description: Minimum log level filter: 0=Debug (all logs), 1=Info (Info+Error), 2=Error (only errors). Defaults to 1 (Info).

parameters.name: appliance
parameters.description: Filter by appliance ID (nePk). Supports SQL LIKE wildcards (%) when not specified, returns all appliances.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Filter by username. Supports wildcard (*) at start or end of string for partial matching.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to 'csv' to export all action logs as CSV file. When set, startTime and endTime are ignored.

operations.name: edgeconnect_cancel_actions
operations.summary: Cancel queued or in-progress actions by GUID
operations.description: Cancels all actions associated with the specified GUID key. Actions are flagged for cancellation and will complete with completionStatus=false and result='Action cancelled'. Only applies to actions queued via queueApplianceActionsAndGetPollHandle or queueSystemActionsAndGetPollHandle methods. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: GUID key identifying the action group to cancel. Obtained from endpoints that return a poll handle (e.g., appliance upgrades, restores, bulk operations).

operations.name: edgeconnect_are_actions_in_progress
operations.summary: Check if user has actions in progress or queued
operations.description: Checks if the specified user has any actions currently in progress or queued. Returns true if there are actions where taskStatus != 2 (COMPLETED) and queuedTime > 0.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Username to check for active actions. Must match the 'user' field in action logs exactly (case-sensitive).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_action_status
operations.summary: Get action status by GUID key
operations.description: Retrieves all action log entries associated with a specific GUID key. Used for polling operation progress after initiating bulk operations, appliance upgrades, restores, or other long-running tasks. Results are ordered by action log ID ascending.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: GUID key identifying the action group. Obtained from endpoints that return poll handles (e.g., appliance upgrades, restores, bulk configuration operations).

operations.name: edgeconnect_alarm_acknowledgement5
operations.summary: Acknowledge or unacknowledge appliance alarms
operations.description: Acknowledges or unacknowledges alarms on an appliance by specifying alarm sequence IDs. The current user is automatically recorded as the acknowledging user.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Alarm acknowledgement configuration specifying the alarms to acknowledge/unacknowledge.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_alarm_acknowledgement6
operations.summary: Acknowledge or unacknowledge Orchestrator alarms
operations.description: Toggles the acknowledgment status of one or more Orchestrator alarms. The acknowledging user is automatically captured from the authenticated session. Only affects active (non-closed) alarms.

request_body.description: Alarm acknowledgment request containing alarm IDs and acknowledgment action

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_alarms_config7
operations.summary: Get alarm email notification configurations
operations.description: Retrieves all alarm email notification configurations. Returns the list of configured alarm notification rules including severity filters, email recipients, and format preferences. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_alarms_config8
operations.summary: Create or update alarm email notification configurations
operations.description: Creates or updates alarm email notification configurations. Validates each configuration object and saves the complete list, replacing any existing configurations. Logs the action in the system action log. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: Array of alarm configuration objects to save. This operation replaces ALL existing configurations with the provided array. Each configuration is validated before saving.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_alarms
operations.summary: Retrieve appliance alarms for specified appliances
operations.description:
Returns active, historical, or all alarms for the appliances specified in the request body.

**Response:** Each alarm object includes severity, description, recommendedAction, source, type, timestamps, acknowledgement status, and more. See the ApplianceAlarmItem schema for full details.

**Filtering:** Use query parameters to filter by status (`view`), severity level, and time range (`from`/`to`). Results can be sorted by severity (`orderBySeverity`) and capped with `maxAlarms`.

**Severity values:** Response values are uppercase (`WARNING`, `MINOR`, `MAJOR`, `CRITICAL`), while the `severity` query parameter accepts lowercase (`warning`, `minor`, `major`, `critical`).

**Correlation fields:** The fields `sourceIp`, `destinationIp`, `peerId`, `hierarchy`, `isRoot`, `instanceId`, `sourceLabel`, `destinationLabel`, and `saCount` are always present in every alarm object, but only contain meaningful (non-default) values for correlation-engine alarm types: tunnel down, interface down, nexthop down, and IPSLA link down alarms. For all other alarm types, these fields contain default values (empty string for strings, `false` for booleans, `0` for numbers).

**Obtaining nePk values:** Appliance IDs (nePks) can be retrieved from `GET /appliance`. Each appliance object contains an `id` field in the format `{number}.NE` (e.g., `10.NE`, `2094.NE`).

**Note on hostName:** The `hostName` field is populated from the appliance's configured hostname. In rare cases during alarm creation, if the appliance is not in cache, it may be empty. Resolve via `GET /appliance` if needed.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Filter alarms by status. 'active' returns current unresolved alarms, 'closed' returns historical resolved alarms, 'all' returns both.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Filter alarms by severity level. When specified, only alarms of this severity are returned. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: orderBySeverity
parameters.description: When true, results are sorted by severity level (critical first). Default is chronological order.

parameters.name: maxAlarms
parameters.description: Maximum number of alarms to return. Must be between 1 and 100000.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start time boundary in milliseconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp * 1000). Only alarms occurring after this time are returned.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End time boundary in milliseconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp * 1000). Only alarms occurring before this time are returned.

request_body.description: List of appliance IDs (nePks) to retrieve alarms for. At least one appliance ID must be provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_sub_alarm25
operations.summary: Get appliance sub-alarms for a parent alarm instance
operations.description: Fetches the list of outstanding sub-alarms (nested or child alarms) from an appliance for a specific parent alarm instance. This endpoint queries the appliance directly via /alarm/subAlarms and returns the 'outstanding' array.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the parent alarm instance. Sub-alarms are child alarms grouped under this parent alarm.

operations.name: edgeconnect_alarm_clearance10
operations.summary: Clear appliance alarms
operations.description: Clears one or more alarms on a specific appliance by providing alarm identifiers. The user performing the clearance is automatically captured from the session. An action log entry is created for auditing.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Contains the list of alarm actions specifying which alarms to clear.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_alarm_clearance11
operations.summary: Clear Orchestrator alarms
operations.description: Clears one or more Orchestrator (GMS) alarms by their unique IDs. The clearance is recorded with the authenticated user's information. Only active alarms that exist can be cleared.

request_body.description: Object containing the list of Orchestrator alarm IDs to clear.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_correlated_alarms
operations.summary: Retrieve correlated alarms (active or historical)
operations.description: Returns active or historical correlated alarms based on the view parameter. Correlated alarms include root cause information linking related network events.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Filter alarms by status. 'active' returns current unresolved alarms; 'closed' returns historical resolved alarms.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Filter alarms by severity level. When omitted, returns alarms of all severity levels.

parameters.name: maxAlarms
parameters.description: Maximum number of alarms to return. Must be between 1 and 100000.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start time boundary for filtering alarms. Value is milliseconds since UNIX epoch (January 1, 1970).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End time boundary for filtering alarms. Value is milliseconds since UNIX epoch (January 1, 1970).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_correlated_rc_alarms
operations.summary: Retrieve correlated root cause alarms
operations.description: Returns a list of correlated root cause alarms based on the specified view (active or closed/historical). Root cause analysis correlates multiple alarms to identify underlying issues such as interface failures, tunnel outages, or ISP connectivity problems.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Filter alarms by status. Use 'active' for current unresolved alarms, or 'closed' for historical/resolved alarms.

parameters.name: maxAlarms
parameters.description: Maximum number of alarms to return. Limits result set size for performance.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start time boundary in milliseconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp). Filters alarms that occurred after this time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End time boundary in milliseconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp). Filters alarms that occurred before this time.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_alarm_correlation_settings35
operations.summary: Get alarm correlation settings
operations.description: Retrieves current alarm correlation and remote notification settings. Returns defaults (correlationEnabled=true, remoteNotificationType='correlated') if no settings exist.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_alarm_correlation_settings36
operations.summary: Update alarm correlation settings
operations.description: Updates alarm correlation and remote notification settings. When correlation status changes, aggregation settings are synchronized and changes are orchestrated to all appliances. Validation rules: remoteNotificationType 'correlated' or 'both' requires correlationEnabled=true.

request_body.description: Alarm correlation settings. Both fields are required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_alarm_correlation_status37
operations.summary: Get alarm correlation status
operations.description: Returns the current alarm correlation status including whether correlation is enabled, the last time the correlation engine ran, and the most recent alarm correlation timestamp. Defaults to correlationEnabled=true and lastRunTime=0 if no settings are stored.

operations.name: edgeconnect_all_appliance_alarm_summary12
operations.summary: Get active alarm counts for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves a summary of active alarm counts categorized by severity (critical, major, minor, warning) for appliances. When nePk is omitted, returns counts for all appliances accessible to the user based on RBAC permissions. When nePk is provided, returns counts for the specific appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_custom_severity_get15
operations.summary: Retrieve customized alarm severity configurations
operations.description: Returns custom alarm severity mappings where keys are alarm type IDs and values are severity levels. Use this to view alarm severity overrides that differ from default settings.

parameters.name: alarmTypeId
parameters.description: Filter by specific alarm type ID. If omitted, returns all custom severity configurations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_custom_severity_put17
operations.summary: Update existing custom alarm severity configurations
operations.description: Updates existing custom alarm severity mappings. All specified alarm type IDs must already have custom configurations (use POST for new ones). If updated severity matches the default, the custom configuration is automatically removed. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: Map of alarm type IDs to updated severity levels. All alarm type IDs must have existing custom configurations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_custom_severity_post16
operations.summary: Create custom alarm severity configurations
operations.description: Creates new custom alarm severity mappings for specified alarm types. Only configurations that differ from default severities are stored. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: Map of alarm type IDs to severity levels. Only alarm types with non-default severities will be stored.

operations.name: edgeconnect_custom_severity_delete14
operations.summary: Delete customized alarm severity configurations
operations.description: Removes custom alarm severity settings, reverting affected alarms to their default severity levels. If no alarmTypeId is provided, all custom severities are deleted. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: alarmTypeId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for a specific alarm type. If omitted, all custom severity configurations are deleted.

operations.name: edgeconnect_alarm_email_delay_get21
operations.summary: Get alarm email delay configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current alarm email delay (debounce) configuration. This setting controls how long alarms must persist before triggering email notifications, helping prevent email flooding from transient issues.

operations.name: edgeconnect_alarm_email_delay_put23
operations.summary: Update alarm email delay configuration
operations.description: Updates an existing alarm email delay (debounce) configuration. Requires configuration to exist; use POST to create initial configuration. Negative duration values are normalized to 0.

request_body.description: Updated alarm email delay configuration with duration in seconds

operations.name: edgeconnect_alarm_email_delay_post22
operations.summary: Create alarm email delay configuration
operations.description: Creates a new alarm email delay (debounce) configuration. This setting controls how long alarms must persist before triggering email notifications, helping prevent email flooding from transient issues. Use PUT to update existing configuration.

request_body.description: Alarm email delay configuration with duration in seconds

operations.name: edgeconnect_alarm_email_delay_delete20
operations.summary: Delete alarm email delay configuration
operations.description: Removes the alarm email delay (debounce) configuration, disabling email notification delays. After deletion, alarm emails are sent immediately without any delay buffer.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_alarm_descriptions
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator and appliance alarm descriptions
operations.description: Retrieves a collection of alarm descriptions including severity, recommended actions, and metadata. Replaces the deprecated /alarm/description endpoint. Can return default or customized alarm configurations and supports CSV export for reporting.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format for the alarm descriptions. Use 'csv' to download as a CSV file.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Controls which alarm configuration to return. When true or omitted, returns default alarm descriptions. When false, returns customized alarm descriptions with user modifications.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_gms_alarms
operations.summary: Retrieve Orchestrator alarms with filtering options
operations.description: Returns a list of Orchestrator alarms based on the specified view type. Use 'active' for current alarms, 'closed' for historical/cleared alarms, or 'all' for both. Results can be filtered by severity and time range.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Alarm state filter. 'active' returns current unresolved alarms, 'closed' returns historical cleared alarms, 'all' returns both active and closed alarms.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Filter alarms by severity level. When specified, only alarms matching the exact severity are returned. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: maxAlarms
parameters.description: Maximum number of alarms to return. Must be between 1 and 100000.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start time boundary in milliseconds since Unix epoch (January 1, 1970 UTC). Only alarms occurring after this time are returned.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End time boundary in milliseconds since Unix epoch. Only alarms occurring before this time are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_alarm_notes26
operations.summary: Capture comments for appliance alarms
operations.description: Adds notes/comments to one or more active appliance alarms identified by their sequence IDs or primary keys. The note is stored in Orchestrator and optionally forwarded to the appliance if supported.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Object containing alarm identifiers and the note to add.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_alarm_note27
operations.summary: Capture comments for GMS alarms
operations.description: Adds a comment or note to one or more active Orchestrator alarms identified by their IDs. Only active (non-closed) alarms can receive notes. HTML content is not allowed in notes for security reasons.

request_body.description: Object containing alarm IDs and the note to be captured

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_alarm_notification
operations.summary: Get alarm notification settings
operations.description: Retrieves the current alarm notification configuration. Returns the global enable/disable status for alarm notifications. If no configuration exists, a default configuration with notifications enabled is created and returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_alarm_notification
operations.summary: Set alarm notification settings
operations.description: Enables or disables global alarm notifications on the Orchestrator. This setting controls whether alarm notifications (email alerts, SNMP traps, syslog messages) are sent when alarms are raised or cleared. Configuration is persisted in the GMS config store.

request_body.description: Alarm notification configuration object containing the enable/disable setting.

operations.name: edgeconnect_reset_correlation36
operations.summary: Reset alarm correlation data
operations.description: Clears all correlated alarms and root cause alarms from the system. Optionally includes historical correlation data. This action is logged to the action log for audit purposes.

parameters.name: includeHistorical
parameters.description: When true, also deletes historical correlated alarms and historical root cause alarms. When false, only current active correlation data is cleared.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_alarm_summary
operations.summary: Get alarm summary counts by severity
operations.description: Returns counts of active alarms grouped by severity level (critical, major, minor, warning). When no type is specified, returns combined totals from both Orchestrator and all accessible appliances. Results are filtered based on RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) permissions when applicable.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter alarm summary by source type. When omitted, returns combined totals from both Orchestrator and all accessible appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_disabled_alarms_config33
operations.summary: Retrieve all suppressed/disabled alarm configurations
operations.description: Returns the current alarm suppression configuration containing alarm type IDs and appliance IDs that are disabled. When an alarm type ID is suppressed, alarms of that type will not be generated system-wide. When an appliance ID is suppressed, all alarms from that appliance are disabled.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_disabled_alarms_config34
operations.summary: Enable or disable alarm suppression for alarm types or appliances
operations.description: Updates the alarm suppression configuration by enabling or disabling specific alarm type IDs or appliance IDs. When alarms are disabled, they are suppressed system-wide. When enabled, force synchronization is triggered on affected appliances.

request_body.description: Configuration specifying the action and target alarm types/appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_disabled_alarms_config32
operations.summary: Delete all disabled/suppressed alarm configurations
operations.description: Removes all suppressed alarm type IDs and appliance IDs from the disabled alarms configuration. This resets alarm suppression and triggers a force synchronization on all appliances to re-enable alarm generation. Use this to restore default alarm behavior across the system.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_api_keys35
operations.summary: Get API keys
operations.description: Retrieves all API keys or a specific key by name. For security, the actual key value is never returned in responses.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter by API key name to retrieve a specific key. If omitted, returns all API keys.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_api_key_entry39
operations.summary: Update API key entry
operations.description: Updates an existing API key's configuration. The API key value itself cannot be changed. Either permission or rbacRoles must be provided. Changes are logged in the system audit trail.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The unique name of the API key to update. Must match an existing key exactly.

request_body.description: Updated API key configuration. The key value is preserved from the existing entry.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_api_key36
operations.summary: Create new API key
operations.description: Creates a new API key for authentication. Returns the generated key value only once upon successful creation. Either permission or rbacRoles must be provided.

request_body.description: API key configuration. Name is required and must be unique. Either permission or rbacRoles must be set.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_api_key_entry37
operations.summary: Delete API key
operations.description: Permanently deletes an API key by name. The deletion invalidates the key immediately and removes it from the authentication cache. This action is logged in the system audit trail.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The unique name of the API key to delete. Must match an existing key exactly.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_get_one81
operations.summary: Retrieve appliance information by nePk or list all accessible appliances
operations.description: Retrieves appliance information from Orchestrator. When nePk is provided, returns detailed information for a single appliance including HA peer, zones, interfaces, roles, and custom tags. When nePk is omitted, returns a list of all appliances accessible to the authenticated user based on RBAC settings. Password field is always null for security.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_chg82
operations.summary: Update an appliance's IP, credentials, network role, site, and web protocol
operations.description: Updates an existing appliance's configuration in Orchestrator. Modifiable fields include IP address, credentials, network role, site assignment, and web protocol. Password is encrypted before storage. If the network role is changed to hub, the appliance is automatically added to all regional overlays. Site changes trigger orchestration updates for all appliances.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Appliance configuration data to update. All fields are optional except when changing specific settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_del80
operations.summary: Queue an appliance for deletion from the network.
operations.description: Queues an appliance for permanent deletion from the network. This operation removes the portal account name/key from Orchestrator, unregisters the appliance, and cleans up all associated configurations including overlays, tunnels, and third-party integrations. The deletion is processed asynchronously and prioritized in the orchestration queue. Use with caution as this action is irreversible.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_admin_distance
operations.summary: Get Admin Distance Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves administrative distance settings for routing protocols on a specific appliance. Admin distance values determine route preference when multiple routing sources provide routes to the same destination.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves from Orchestrator cache (faster). When false, fetches live data from the appliance and updates cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_approved_appliances
operations.summary: Retrieve all approved appliances
operations.description: Returns a list of all appliances that have been approved for management by the Orchestrator. Approved appliances have completed the discovery and approval workflow.

operations.name: edgeconnect_backup_get45
operations.summary: Get appliance backup history
operations.description: Retrieves backup history for a specific appliance from the Orchestrator database. Returns an array of backup records sorted by backup time in ascending order (oldest first). Use the 'runningConfig' parameter set to false for faster queries when only metadata is needed.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: runningConfig
parameters.description: Include the running configuration data in response. Set to false to retrieve only backup metadata for faster queries.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by specific backup record ID. When provided, returns only the backup matching this ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_backup_post43
operations.summary: Backup appliance configuration to Orchestrator database
operations.description: Initiates an asynchronous backup of appliance configurations to the Orchestrator database. If nePks is empty or not provided, all managed appliances are backed up. The operation returns a clientKey UUID to poll for progress via GET /action/status?key=<clientKey>. Maximum 30 backups are retained per appliance; older backups are automatically purged. Requires appliance software version 7.2.0.0 or higher (6.2.8.0 for 6.2.x branch, 7.1.1.0 for 7.1.x branch).

request_body.description: Request body containing appliance primary keys and a comment for the backup operation.

operations.name: edgeconnect_backup_delete44
operations.summary: Delete a specific appliance backup record
operations.description: Permanently removes a single appliance configuration backup record from the Orchestrator database. The operation logs the action to the system action log for audit purposes. Use GET /appliance/backup?nePk=<appliance_id> to retrieve available backup IDs before deletion.

parameters.name: backupFilePk
parameters.description: Unique database identifier of the backup record to delete. Obtain this ID from GET /appliance/backup response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_chg_gr46
operations.summary: Move appliances to a different group
operations.description: Moves one or more appliances to a target group. Use GET /gms/group to retrieve available group primary keys. Updates are applied atomically per appliance - partial failures return error details.

parameters.name: groupPk
parameters.description: Target group primary key where appliances will be moved. Format: '<id>.Network' (e.g., '5.Network').

request_body.description: JSON object containing array of appliance primary keys to move

operations.name: edgeconnect_change_appliance_password47
operations.summary: Change a user's password on an appliance
operations.description: Changes the password for a specified user on the target appliance. If the username matches the appliance's configured admin username, the password is also updated in Orchestrator's database to maintain connectivity.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username on the appliance whose password will be changed. Must match an existing user on the appliance.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the new password to apply to the specified user on the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_cp_ustats_cancel_fetch_get
operations.summary: Cancel an in-progress CPU statistics fetch operation
operations.description: Cancels a running CPU statistics fetch operation for the specified appliance. If a fetch is in progress, it stops the operation and resets progress counters. Use this endpoint to abort long-running fetch operations initiated by /appliance/cpustat/historical/fetch.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_cp_ustats_get1
operations.summary: Fetch CPU historical statistics from appliance and store in Orchestrator database
operations.description: Initiates an asynchronous operation to retrieve CPU usage history data from the specified appliance and load it into the Orchestrator database. This operation clears existing CPU stats data for the appliance before loading new data. Only one fetch operation can run at a time globally. Use /appliance/cpustat/historical/isfetchinprogress to check status and /appliance/cpustat/historical/cancelfetch to cancel.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_cp_ustats_is_fetch_in_progress_get1
operations.summary: Check CPU statistics fetch operation status
operations.description: Checks whether a CPU statistics fetch operation is currently in progress and returns detailed progress information. Use this endpoint to poll the status of an asynchronous fetch operation initiated by /appliance/cpustat/historical/fetch.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_cp_ustats_maxtimestamp_get1
operations.summary: Get the most recent CPU statistics timestamp for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the maximum (most recent) epoch timestamp of CPU statistics available in the Orchestrator database for the specified appliance. Use this endpoint to determine if CPU history data exists and how current it is before querying detailed statistics via /stats/timeseries/cpustat.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_custom_tag_meta
operations.summary: Get custom tag metadata for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves custom tag labels for appliances from the Orchestrator cache. When called without nePk, returns a map of all appliance nePks to their custom tags. When called with a specific nePk, returns only the custom tags for that appliance. Supports ETag-based caching for efficient polling.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from a previous response. If the data has not changed, a 304 Not Modified response is returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_for_rediscovery49
operations.summary: Queue appliance for deletion from Orchestrator for rediscovery
operations.description: Removes an appliance from Orchestrator management by queuing it for deletion, allowing it to be rediscovered later. The appliance must exist in Orchestrator. This operation logs the deletion action and prioritizes the appliance in the orchestration task queue.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_denied_appliances
operations.summary: Retrieve all denied appliances
operations.description: Returns a list of all appliances that have been denied during the discovery approval process. Denied appliances cannot be managed by the Orchestrator until they are rediscovered and approved.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_denied_appliances51
operations.summary: Delete denied appliances permanently
operations.description: Permanently deletes one or more denied appliances from Orchestrator. Sends a decommission request to the cloud portal (skipped in Air-Gap mode) and removes the appliance records from the database. Supports both portal-registered appliances (via portalObjectId) and NX/VX model appliances (via UUID).

request_body.description: Object containing arrays of portal object IDs and/or UUIDs of denied appliances to delete.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_discovered_appliances
operations.summary: Get all discovered appliances
operations.description: Returns a list of all discovered appliances that have not yet been approved or denied. This endpoint automatically triggers the appliance discovery job to refresh the list before returning results. Discovered appliances are EdgeConnect devices that have registered with the Cloud Portal but are awaiting approval to join the Orchestrator.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_discovered_appliance_to_orchestrator
operations.summary: Add a discovered appliance to Orchestrator without portal approval
operations.description: Adds a discovered appliance to Orchestrator without sending approval to the cloud portal. Use this API when you want to add an appliance that was discovered via /appliance/discovered but do not need portal-based licensing approval. The appliance will be added to the NE table and will begin orchestration. To license the appliance through the portal after adding, use /license/portal/appliance/grant API.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Primary key (ID) of the discovered appliance to add. Obtain this value from /appliance/discovered endpoint.

request_body.description: Configuration for adding the discovered appliance, including target group and optional location/role settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_approve_discovered_appliances54
operations.summary: Approve and add a discovered appliance to Orchestrator.
operations.description: Approves a discovered appliance and adds it to Orchestrator. This operation validates the appliance UUID for duplicates, registers it with Cloud Portal, pushes portal credentials to the appliance, and adds the appliance to Orchestrator management. The approval triggers email notifications and audit logging.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Primary key ID of the discovered appliance to approve. Use /appliance/discovered API to retrieve available IDs.

request_body.description: Approval configuration including target group ID and optional location/network role settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_discovered_by_portal_object_id
operations.summary: Delete a discovered appliance or queue a managed appliance for deletion
operations.description: Removes an appliance from Orchestrator by portal object ID. If the appliance is only in the discovered state, it is immediately deleted from the discovered table. If the appliance is already managed by Orchestrator, it is queued for deletion instead of being immediately removed.

parameters.name: portalObjectId
parameters.description: The unique portal object identifier for the appliance. This ID is assigned by the cloud portal and uniquely identifies the appliance across the system.

operations.name: edgeconnect_deny_discovered_appliances55
operations.summary: Deny a discovered appliance
operations.description: Denies a discovered appliance, preventing it from being managed by the Orchestrator. The appliance will be moved to the denied list and a denial notification email will be sent. If the appliance was discovered through the portal, a deny request is also sent to the portal.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Primary key (database ID) of the discovered appliance to deny. This ID is returned from the GET /appliance/discovered endpoint.

request_body.description: Optional comment explaining the reason for denying the appliance. This comment is stored in the database for audit purposes.

operations.name: edgeconnect_trigger_update_discovered_appliances
operations.summary: Trigger discovered appliances update job
operations.description: Triggers the UpdateDiscoveredAppliancesJob background job to run immediately. This job updates the list of discovered appliances by synchronizing with the cloud portal and direct appliance connections. Useful when you need to refresh the discovered appliances list without waiting for the scheduled polling interval.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_dns_cache_config
operations.summary: Get DNS Cache Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves DNS cache configuration for a specific appliance, including HTTP snooping settings. Data can be retrieved from Orchestrator's cache for faster response or directly from the appliance for real-time values.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves from Orchestrator's database cache. When false, fetches directly from the appliance (slower but real-time).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_extra_info59
operations.summary: Get appliance extra information
operations.description: Retrieves extra information (location, contact, overlay settings) for the specified appliance. If no configuration exists, creates and returns a new record with default blank values.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_appliance_extra_info60
operations.summary: Save appliance extra information
operations.description: Creates or updates the extra information (location, contact, overlay settings) for a specified appliance. The location object with a valid country is required. This action is logged in the audit trail.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Appliance extra information including location, contact, and overlay settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_appliance_extra_info58
operations.summary: Delete appliance extra information
operations.description: Removes all extra information (location, contact, overlay settings) associated with the specified appliance from Orchestrator. This action is logged in the audit trail.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ha_peer_meta
operations.summary: Retrieve HA peer metadata for appliances
operations.description: Returns cached High Availability (HA) peer data including peer nePk, HA group name, and device status. When nePk is omitted, returns HA peer information for all appliances in HA groups. When nePk is provided, returns HA peer information for the specified appliance only. Supports ETag-based caching using If-None-Match header for conditional requests.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from a previous response for conditional request. If the data has not changed, the server returns HTTP 304 Not Modified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_bridge_interface_state
operations.summary: Get Bridge Interface State
operations.description: Retrieves the bridge interface state including link status and pass-through transmit interface for each network interface (LAN/WAN). Returns cached data by default or fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data source: 'true' returns cached data from Orchestrator database, 'false' fetches fresh data directly from the appliance. Defaults to 'true' if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_interface_meta
operations.summary: Get interface labels for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves cached interface labels (WAN and LAN) for all appliances or a specific appliance. Uses ETag-based caching for efficient polling. Labels are extracted from deployment configuration data.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from previous response. Returns 304 if data unchanged.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_network_role_and_site
operations.summary: Retrieve appliance network role and site information
operations.description: Returns the network role (Hub, Spoke, or NRHub) and site assignment for a specific appliance. The password field is excluded from the response for security reasons.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_modify_network_role_and_site
operations.summary: Update appliance network role and site assignment
operations.description: Modifies the network role (Hub/Spoke/NRHub) and site assignment for a specific appliance. Changing these values triggers cluster updates and overlay configuration updates when applicable.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Appliance network role and site configuration to update. Only networkRole, site, and sitePriority fields are processed.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_peer_priority_list
operations.summary: Retrieve peer priority configuration for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the peer priority list configuration from an appliance. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator's cache or directly from the appliance. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls the data source. When true (default), retrieves data from Orchestrator's cache. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_pp_po_e_list
operations.summary: Delete a PPPoE virtual interface configuration from an appliance
operations.description: Removes a specified PPPoE configuration from the appliance's virtual interface list. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: pppoeName
parameters.description: Name of the PPPoE virtual interface to delete. Must be a valid, non-empty PPPoE configuration name.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_pp_po_e_list
operations.summary: Get PPPoE configuration list from appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the PPPoE interface configuration list for a specified appliance. Data can be retrieved from cache (default) or directly from the appliance. PPPoE configuration is only available when the appliance is in router deployment mode.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When 'true' (default), retrieves from Orchestrator cache. When 'false', fetches live data from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_check_appliances_queued_for_deletion67
operations.summary: Get appliances queued for deletion
operations.description: Retrieves a map of appliances that are currently queued for deletion on the Orchestrator. When an appliance is deleted, it is not removed immediately but queued for deletion processing. This endpoint returns the list of appliances awaiting deletion along with the user who initiated the deletion request.

operations.name: edgeconnect_rediscover_appliance68
operations.summary: Rediscover a denied appliance
operations.description: Changes a denied appliance back to discovered status, allowing it to re-enter the approval workflow. Applies any preconfiguration settings if available.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the discovered appliance to rediscover. Must reference an existing appliance in the denied state.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_get_api70
operations.summary: Retrieve appliance data via passthrough API
operations.description: Proxies a GET request directly to a specified appliance API endpoint. This passthrough endpoint allows Orchestrator to fetch data from appliance REST APIs with minimal performance overhead. Response data may be converted based on appliance version.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Appliance API path relative to '/rest/json/'. Use 'shaper' to call '/rest/json/shaper'. May include query parameters after '?'.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_post_api71
operations.summary: Modify appliance settings via passthrough API
operations.description: Proxies a POST request directly to a specified appliance API endpoint. Orchestrator forwards the request to the target appliance's REST API with optional data conversion based on appliance version. Audit logging is performed for most operations except read-like endpoints.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Appliance API path relative to '/rest/json/'. Leading '/' is optional and will be stripped. May include query parameters after '?'.

request_body.description: JSON payload to send to the appliance API. Content is logged for audit purposes (truncated at max log characters). Sensitive data APIs do not log request body.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_deleteapi69
operations.summary: Delete appliance resource via passthrough API
operations.description: Proxies a DELETE request directly to a specified appliance API endpoint. This passthrough endpoint allows Orchestrator to execute DELETE operations on appliance REST APIs without performance overhead. Requires READ_WRITE role permission and RBAC validation for the target API path.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Appliance API path relative to '/rest/json/'. For example, use 'shaper' to call '/rest/json/shaper'.

request_body.description: Optional JSON data to send with the DELETE request. Logged for audit purposes (truncated at max log characters).

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_restore72
operations.summary: Restore appliance configuration from a backup
operations.description: Initiates an asynchronous restore of appliance configuration from a previously created backup. The backup file ID can be obtained using GET /appliance/backup?nePk=<appliance_id>. The operation uploads the backup to the appliance, triggers restore, and reboots the appliance. Requires appliance software version 7.2.0.0 or higher (6.2.8.0 for 6.2.x branch, 7.1.1.0 for 7.1.x branch). Poll GET /appliance/restore/status?nePk=<nePk> for operation progress.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Request body containing the backup file ID to restore from.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_restore_bulk72
operations.summary: Bulk restore multiple appliances from backups
operations.description: Initiates asynchronous restore operations for multiple appliances from their respective backups. Each appliance in the request array is restored from the specified backup file. For HA (High Availability) pairs, restores are coordinated sequentially with a 5-minute delay between peers. Poll GET /appliance/restore/status?nePk=<nePk> for each appliance to track progress. Requires appliance software version 7.2.0.0+ (6.2.8.0 for 6.2.x, 7.1.1.0 for 7.1.x).

request_body.description: Array of appliance restore requests, each containing the appliance nePk and backup file ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_bulk_restore_status
operations.summary: Get appliance restore status (active and recent)
operations.description: Retrieves both active (in-progress) and recent (last completed) restore status for a specific appliance. Use this endpoint to poll for restore operation progress after initiating a restore via POST /appliance/restore. The 'active' object is populated only when a restore is currently in progress; otherwise returns an empty object. The 'recent' object contains the last completed restore status from the database.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_changes73
operations.summary: Persist in-memory configuration changes to persistent storage on appliances
operations.description: Saves pending configuration changes from memory to persistent storage on one or more EdgeConnect appliances. Supports two modes: single appliance (via nePk query parameter) or bulk operation (via request body). Requires auto-save feature to be enabled in Orchestrator settings.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

request_body.description: List of appliance identifiers for bulk save operation. Used only when nePk query parameter is not provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_scalars
operations.summary: Get scalar data of an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves hardware scalar configuration data for a specific appliance. Scalars contain hardware limits and capabilities including memory size, processor count, maximum supported flows, tunnels, ACLs, maps, and interface configurations. Data can be retrieved from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data source. When 'true' (default), retrieves from Orchestrator cache for faster response. When 'false', fetches directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_shell_access_setting
operations.summary: Get shell access setting of appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the shell access security configuration for a specific appliance. The setting controls the level of SSH and console access permitted on the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When 'true', returns data from Orchestrator's cache. When 'false', fetches data directly from the appliance. Defaults to 'true' if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_stats_config_get75
operations.summary: Get appliance statistics configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current statistics configuration that will be synchronized to all appliances. Returns default configuration if none exists in the database.

operations.name: edgeconnect_stats_config_post76
operations.summary: Update appliance statistics configuration
operations.description: Updates statistics configuration synchronized to all appliances. The 'app2' field is automatically set to match 'app' value. Configuration is persisted to database and pushed to appliances during orchestration. Logs an action entry for audit purposes.

request_body.description: Statistics configuration to apply. The 'app2' field should be omitted as it is auto-populated from 'app'.

operations.name: edgeconnect_stats_config_default_get77
operations.summary: Get default appliance statistics configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the factory default statistics configuration that will be synchronized to appliances. This immutable configuration provides baseline settings for data retention and statistics collection limits. Use this to compare against current configuration or reset to defaults.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_zone_list_meta79
operations.summary: Get cached zone list metadata for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves zone names from deployment configuration for appliances. Returns zone names from both WAN and LAN interfaces. Supports ETag-based caching for efficient polling.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from previous response for cache validation. Returns 304 if data unchanged.

operations.name: edgeconnect_resync_appliance83
operations.summary: Force synchronization of appliances
operations.description: Triggers a forced synchronization for one or more appliances. The appliances are added to the force sync list and will be synchronized by the SynchronizationManager. If a single appliance is specified, it will be prioritized in the orchestration queue.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the list of appliance primary keys to synchronize

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliances_software_versions84
operations.summary: Get ECOS Software Versions
operations.description: Retrieves ECOS software version information for a specified appliance. Returns details about all partitions including active partition, build versions, and boot configuration. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true (default), retrieves from Orchestrator cache for faster response. When false, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_application_get85
operations.summary: Get all built-in and user-defined applications
operations.description: Retrieves a combined list of all applications from the cache, including both built-in system applications and user-defined custom applications. Results are aggregated from all connected appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_built_in_applications
operations.summary: List all built-in application signatures
operations.description: Retrieves all built-in (system-defined) application signatures used for traffic classification. Returns cached applications aggregated from connected appliances, or default GMS built-in applications (~130 apps) if cache is empty. Built-in apps include protocols like http, https, ftp, ssh, dns, citrix-ica, and enterprise applications like sap, oracle, ms_sql.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_user_defined_applications
operations.summary: List all user-defined custom applications
operations.description: Retrieves all user-defined (custom) applications from the Orchestrator cache. Applications are aggregated from all connected appliances, de-duplicated, and sorted alphabetically by name. User-defined applications are custom traffic classifiers created by administrators using rules like IP ranges, ports, protocols, DSCP values, and VLANs.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_user_defined_config
operations.summary: Get user-defined application rules from appliance
operations.description: Retrieves detailed configuration of user-defined (custom) applications from a specific appliance. Returns traffic classification rules including IP ranges, ports, protocols, DSCP values, and VLAN tags. Data is retrieved from cache by default or directly from the appliance when cached=false.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true (default), retrieves from Orchestrator cache for faster response. When false, fetches real-time data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application_definition_config
operations.summary: Retrieve application definition configuration data
operations.description: Retrieves application definition configuration data for the specified base classification type and optional resource key. Returns user-defined or system application definitions used for traffic classification. Records with ID > 50000 are user-modified portal records.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: The classification type base path to query. Must not be empty. A forward slash is prepended automatically if not provided.

parameters.name: resourceKey
parameters.description: The specific resource key to filter results. If empty or not provided, defaults to null (retrieves all matching base entries).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_app_express_app_config
operations.summary: Get AppExpress application configurations
operations.description: Retrieves AppExpress application configurations used for monitoring and steering SaaS/cloud application traffic. The 'userDefined' key returns custom configurations while 'merged' combines portal defaults with user overrides.

parameters.name: resourceKey
parameters.description: Specifies which configuration data to retrieve. Use 'userDefined' for custom user configurations or 'merged' for combined portal and user-defined settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_create_or_update_app_express_app_config
operations.summary: Create or update AppExpress application configurations
operations.description: Creates or updates user-defined AppExpress application configurations for SaaS/cloud traffic monitoring and steering. Replaces all existing user-defined settings; retrieve current config via GET with resourceKey='userDefined' first. Keys must be lowercase application names. Maximum 50 applications can be monitored.

request_body.description: Map of lowercase application names to AppExpress configuration objects. All keys are automatically converted to lowercase. Do not include appIndex or cloudPortalDataAvailable fields (read-only).

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_tags_group_association_get299
operations.summary: Get AppExpress group to appliance associations
operations.description: Retrieves AppExpress group associations that map appliances to AppExpress groups. When groupName is provided, returns associations for that specific group only. When groupName is omitted, returns all associations across all groups.

parameters.name: groupName
parameters.description: Name of the AppExpress group to filter associations. When omitted, returns all associations for all groups.

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_tags_group_association_post290
operations.summary: Replace all AppExpress group to appliance associations
operations.description: Replaces all AppExpress group to appliance associations with the provided list. This is a full replacement operation - existing associations not in the request will be removed. Group names are case-insensitive (converted to lowercase). Requires AppExpress license.

request_body.description: Complete list of AppExpress group associations to set. This replaces all existing associations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_tags_group_get299
operations.summary: Get all AppExpress group configurations
operations.description: Retrieves all AppExpress group configurations from the orchestration store. Each configuration defines QoE targets, transport paths, DNS settings, and monitored applications for an AppExpress group. Returns an empty object if no groups are configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_tags_group_post290
operations.summary: Create or update AppExpress group configuration
operations.description: Creates a new AppExpress group or updates an existing one. Validates license limits, group name format, application availability, overlay configuration, QoE intervals, loopback interfaces, and DNS server settings before persisting. Group names are stored in lowercase.

request_body.description: AppExpress group configuration object with QoE settings, transport paths, and monitored applications.

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_express_group_delete999
operations.summary: Delete AppExpress group configuration
operations.description: Deletes an AppExpress group configuration by name. The group name is case-insensitive (converted to lowercase). Before deletion, validates that the group exists and is not associated with any appliances. Groups currently applied to appliances must first be disassociated before deletion.

parameters.name: groupName
parameters.description: Name of the AppExpress group to delete. Case-insensitive (converted to lowercase). Group must exist and not be associated with any appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_tags_get89
operations.summary: Retrieve user-defined application groups by resource key
operations.description: Retrieves application groups configuration by resource key. Application groups allow organizing multiple applications into logical categories for policy management. Returns the stored JSON configuration data or a 'Not found' message if no matching entry exists.

parameters.name: resourceKey
parameters.description: The key identifying which application groups data to retrieve. Use 'userDefined' to get user-defined application groups.

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_tags_post90
operations.summary: Create or update user-defined application groups or change application mode
operations.description: This endpoint supports two operations: (1) Create/update application groups by providing a JSON body with group definitions, (2) Switch between 'old' (legacy) and 'new' (cloud-based) application group modes using the mode query parameter. When creating groups, first use GET to retrieve existing groups, then include all groups in the POST request.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Switch application group mode. 'new' enables cloud-based groups from portal, 'old' uses legacy mode. Once switched to 'new', cannot revert to 'old'.

request_body.description: Map of application group names to their configuration. Required when mode parameter is not provided. Each group name must be alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores, max 31 characters.

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_group_search_post91
operations.summary: Search application groups by wildcard pattern
operations.description: Searches for application groups (tags) that match the specified wildcard pattern. Returns a set of matching application group names sorted alphabetically.

request_body.description: Wildcard search criteria for filtering application groups

operations.name: edgeconnect_app_search_post93
operations.summary: Search applications by wildcard pattern
operations.description: Searches for application names matching the specified wildcard pattern. Returns a sorted set of matching application names. Behavior varies based on AVC mode: when AVC mode is enabled, filters applications from the definition manager; when AVC mode is 'none', returns all applications from the application manager.

request_body.description: Wildcard search parameters including pattern and result limit.

operations.name: edgeconnect_create_or_update_auto_update_config_data
operations.summary: Configure auto-update settings for application classification pipelines
operations.description: Enables or disables automatic updates from the Cloud Portal for each application classification pipeline independently. Controls whether Orchestrator periodically fetches updated classification definitions (port/protocol, DNS, IP intelligence, meter flow, compound, SaaS) from the portal.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: The auto-update configuration base path. Must be exactly "autoUpdateFromPortal".

request_body.description: Auto-update toggle settings for each classification pipeline. Each field must be "on" or "off" (case-insensitive).

operations.name: edgeconnect_compound_post97
operations.summary: Create or update compound application definition
operations.description: Creates or updates a user-defined compound application definition for multi-attribute traffic classification. Compound rules combine two or more attributes (IP, port, DNS, geo, service, DSCP, VLAN, protocol) to identify applications. Simple single-attribute rules are rejected - use dedicated endpoints: /portProtocolClassification for TCP/UDP, /ipIntelligenceClassification for Address Map, or /dnsClassification for Domain Name rules. Upon success, merged data and hashcode are automatically updated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the compound application definition. Must be > 0 and match the id in the request body. IDs > 50000 are portal-modified user records requiring existing portal data.

request_body.description: Compound application definition object containing rule attributes. At least two attributes must be specified (non-empty) to qualify as a compound rule.

operations.name: edgeconnect_compound_delete96
operations.summary: Delete compound application definition
operations.description: Deletes a user-defined compound application definition by ID. For IDs > 50000 (portal-modified records), corresponding portal data must exist. Deletion is blocked if the compound app is part of an application group. Upon successful deletion, the merged data and hashcode are automatically updated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the compound application definition to delete. Must be a positive integer greater than 0. IDs > 50000 represent portal-modified user records and require corresponding portal data to exist.

operations.name: edgeconnect_compound_reorder_post95
operations.summary: Reorder user-defined compound application classification rules
operations.description: Changes the priority order of user-defined compound application classification rules. Only user-defined rules (IDs ≤ 50000) can be reordered. Portal-defined rules (IDs > 50000) cannot be reordered and will remain after user-defined rules.

request_body.description: Array of compound rule IDs in desired order. Must include all user-defined IDs (≤ 50000). Use the GET API to retrieve existing IDs.

operations.name: edgeconnect_dns_post100
operations.summary: Create or update DNS-based application classification
operations.description: Creates or updates a user-defined DNS-based application classification. The domain in the query parameter must match the domain in the request body. Upon success, the system recalculates merged DNS classification data and updates the hash code. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain name to create or update. Must match the domain field in the request body.

request_body.description: DNS classification configuration object containing domain mapping details.

operations.name: edgeconnect_dns_delete99
operations.summary: Delete user-defined DNS classification by domain name
operations.description: Deletes a user-defined DNS-based application classification by domain name. Upon successful deletion, the system automatically recalculates the merged DNS classification data and updates the hash code. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain name to delete from user-defined DNS classification. This is the DNS domain or hostname associated with the application definition.

operations.name: edgeconnect_domain_delete_post101
operations.summary: Delete user-defined DNS application definition by domain name
operations.description: Deletes a user-defined DNS-based application definition by domain name. The domain must not be part of an application group. Upon successful deletion, automatically updates the DNS hashcode for synchronization.

request_body.description: Request body containing the domain name to delete. Only the 'domain' field is required for this operation.

operations.name: edgeconnect_dns_post102
operations.summary: Create or modify a user-defined DNS application for domain name classification
operations.description: Creates a new or updates an existing user-defined application based on domain name classification. Used for DNS-based traffic identification and application categorization.

request_body.description: Domain name user entry configuration for the DNS-based application definition

operations.name: edgeconnect_ip_intelligence_post105
operations.summary: Create or update user-defined Address Map entry
operations.description: Creates or updates a user-defined IP Intelligence Classification entry (Address Map) for the specified IP address range. The ipStart and ipEnd query parameters must match the ip_start and ip_end values in the request body. On failure, the previous configuration is automatically restored.

parameters.name: ipStart
parameters.description: Starting IPv4 address in 32-bit unsigned integer format. Must be less than or equal to ipEnd and match ip_start in request body. Valid range: 0 to 4294967295.

parameters.name: ipEnd
parameters.description: Ending IPv4 address in 32-bit unsigned integer format. Must be greater than or equal to ipStart and match ip_end in request body. Valid range: 0 to 4294967295.

request_body.description: IP Intelligence entry containing application definition details for the IP range.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ip_intelligence_delete104
operations.summary: Delete user-defined Address Map entry by IP range
operations.description: Deletes a user-defined IP Intelligence Classification entry (Address Map) for the specified IP address range. The entry cannot be deleted if it is part of an application group. On failure, the previous configuration is automatically restored.

parameters.name: ipStart
parameters.description: Starting IPv4 address in 32-bit unsigned integer format. Must be less than or equal to ipEnd. Valid range: 0 to 4294967295.

parameters.name: ipEnd
parameters.description: Ending IPv4 address in 32-bit unsigned integer format. Must be greater than or equal to ipStart. Valid range: 0 to 4294967295.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ip_intelligence_confidence
operations.summary: Retrieve user-defined IP Intelligence confidence value
operations.description: Retrieves the user-defined confidence priority override for a specified application. Returns the confidence entry if found, or an empty map if no override exists for the application.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Application name to retrieve confidence value for. Must not be null or empty.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ip_intelligence_confidence_post106
operations.summary: Create or update user-defined application confidence override
operations.description: Creates or updates a user-defined confidence value (priority) for an application to override portal-provided Address Map entries. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: IP Intelligence confidence entry containing application name and priority value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_ip_intelligence_confidence
operations.summary: Delete user-defined IP Intelligence confidence override
operations.description: Removes the user-defined confidence (priority) override for a specified application from the Address Map classification system. Once deleted, portal-provided default confidence values will be used.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Application name to remove the confidence override for. Cannot be null or empty (whitespace-only values are rejected).

operations.name: edgeconnect_meter_flow_post112
operations.summary: Create or modify user-defined DPI meter flow application definition
operations.description: Creates or modifies a user-defined DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) meter flow application definition. The meter flow ID (mid) must correspond to an existing DPI application from the portal template data. Creating new DPI entries or modifying the name of existing entries is not allowed. After successful update, the merged meter flow data and hashcode are automatically recalculated and updated. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: flowType
parameters.description: Meter flow type identifier. Must be 'MF' for meter flow applications. This value must match the flowType in the request body.

parameters.name: mid
parameters.description: Unique meter flow identifier (mid). Must match the mid value in the request body. This ID corresponds to an existing DPI application from the portal template data.

request_body.description: Meter flow application configuration. The flowType and mid must match the query parameters.

operations.name: edgeconnect_meter_flow_delete111
operations.summary: Delete user-defined meter flow application definition
operations.description: Deletes a user-defined DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) meter flow application definition. After deletion, the merged meter flow data and hashcode are automatically recalculated and updated. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: flowType
parameters.description: Meter flow type identifier. Must be 'MF' for meter flow applications.

parameters.name: mid
