parameters.description: Unique meter flow identifier (mid) of the user-defined application to delete. This ID is assigned when the application is created.

operations.name: edgeconnect_port_protocol_post115
operations.summary: Create or modify user-defined port/protocol application classification
operations.description: Creates or modifies a user-defined application classification based on port and protocol. Use protocol=6 for TCP applications, protocol=17 for UDP applications, and port=0 for IP Protocol applications. The port and protocol values in query parameters must match the values in the request body. This operation also updates the merged data and hash code.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port number for the application. Use 0 for IP Protocol applications. Must match the port value in the request body.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Protocol number. Use 6 for TCP, 17 for UDP. For IP Protocol applications (port=0), any valid IP protocol number is accepted.

request_body.description: Port protocol classification entry to create or update

operations.name: edgeconnect_port_protocol_delete114
operations.summary: Delete user-defined port/protocol application classification
operations.description: Deletes a user-defined application classification based on port and protocol. For TCP applications use protocol=6, for UDP use protocol=17, for IP Protocol applications use port=0. Applications that are part of an application group cannot be deleted. This operation also updates the merged data and hash code.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port number identifying the application to delete. Use 0 for IP Protocol applications. Must be a non-negative integer.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Protocol number: 6 for TCP, 17 for UDP, or any valid IP protocol number when port=0.

operations.name: edgeconnect_compound_post118
operations.summary: Create or modify user-defined SaaS cloud application definition
operations.description: Creates or modifies a user-defined SaaS (Software as a Service) cloud application definition. Set saasId to -1 in both query parameter and request body to create a new application. User-defined applications must have ID >= 25000. Silver Peak predefined SaaS applications (ID < 25000) cannot be modified. After successful creation/update, the merged data and hashcode are automatically updated for synchronization with appliances.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: SaaS application ID. Use -1 to create a new application. For existing applications, must be >= 25000 (user-defined) and match the saasId in request body.

operations.name: edgeconnect_saas_delete117
operations.summary: Delete user-defined SaaS cloud application definition
operations.description: Deletes a user-defined SaaS (Software as a Service) cloud application definition. Only user-defined applications (ID >= 25000) can be deleted. Silver Peak predefined SaaS applications cannot be removed. After deletion, the merged data and hashcode are automatically updated for synchronization with appliances.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the user-defined SaaS application to delete. Must be >= 25000 as values below 25000 are reserved for Silver Peak defined SaaS applications.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_time_retriever119
operations.summary: Retrieve modification times and hash codes for application definitions
operations.description: Returns the last modification timestamp and hash codes for application definitions and application groups. Use this endpoint to detect configuration changes by comparing hash codes.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_user_app_groups
operations.summary: Get application groups from appliance
operations.description: Retrieves user-defined application groups (userAppGroups) configuration from a specific appliance. Groups organize related applications for QoS policy management (e.g., citrix, replication, real-time, interactive, encrypted). Data is retrieved from cache by default (faster) or directly from the appliance when cached=false (real-time but slower). Cache is automatically updated when direct fetch is used.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When 'true' (default), retrieves from Orchestrator cache. When 'false', fetches real-time data directly from appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application_trends
operations.summary: Get application bandwidth trends and statistics
operations.description: Retrieves bandwidth statistics for top applications across specified appliances over a time range. Returns data grouped by appliance, with each appliance containing stats for its top applications. The stat granularity (MINUTE, HOURLY, DAILY) is automatically determined based on the time range: <=1 hour returns minute-level stats, <=60 hours returns hourly stats, <=60 days returns daily stats.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds (epoch time). Used with endDate to determine the stat granularity: <=60min returns MINUTE stats, <=60hrs returns HOURLY stats, <=60 days returns DAILY stats.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End timestamp in milliseconds (epoch time). The time range (endDate - startDate) must not exceed 60 days. Stats granularity is auto-determined based on range.

parameters.name: traffic
parameters.description: Filter by traffic type. Determines which category of network traffic to include in bandwidth statistics.

parameters.name: bound
parameters.description: Traffic direction filter. Select inbound for received traffic or outbound for transmitted traffic.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: customRangeUsed
parameters.description: When true, applies custom time range rounding logic for drill-down queries. Affects how start/end times are rounded based on previousStatType.

parameters.name: previousStatType
parameters.description: Previous stat granularity used before drill-down. When customRangeUsed is true, this determines time rounding behavior for zooming into data.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_auth_radius_tacacs
operations.summary: Get authentication order, RADIUS, and TACACS+ configuration
operations.description: Retrieves authentication configuration for an appliance including AAA (Authentication, Authorization, Accounting) settings, RADIUS server configuration, and TACACS+ server configuration. Returns auth_method (authentication order supporting up to 3 methods: local, radius, tacacs), author (authorization settings with default user and map order), and server configurations for both RADIUS and TACACS+ (up to 3 servers each).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Retrieve data from Orchestrator cache (true) or directly from the appliance (false). Defaults to 'true' if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_authentication123
operations.summary: Retrieve Orchestrator advanced configuration properties
operations.description: Returns all advanced Orchestrator configuration properties including security settings, database pool settings, SSL/TLS configuration, and system thresholds. No authentication required. Properties control Orchestrator behavior such as login attempt thresholds, session timeouts, and security policies.

operations.name: edgeconnect_jwt_authentication123
operations.summary: Authenticate and login via JWT (JSON Web Token) SSO
operations.description: Authenticates a user using a signed JWT token from a configured identity provider. The JWT must be signed with a key matching the configured JWT settings in Orchestrator. Token validation includes: issuer verification, audience verification, expiration check, and single-use enforcement. On success, creates an authenticated HTTP session. Requires pre-configured JWT settings in Orchestrator.

parameters.name: id_token
parameters.description: A signed JWT token containing user identity claims. Must include issuer (iss), audience (aud), expiration (exp), and user identifier claims matching the configured JWT settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_authentication_login1
operations.summary: Authenticate user and create REST API HTTP session
operations.description: Authenticates a user using local, RADIUS, or TACACS+ credentials and creates an authenticated HTTP session. Supports optional two-factor authentication (email or app-based TOTP). On successful login, a CSRF token cookie is set for subsequent API calls. Failed login attempts are tracked and may result in temporary account lockout after exceeding the configured threshold.

request_body.description: Login credentials for user authentication. Supports JSON body or form URL-encoded data. Two-factor authentication token required if enabled for user account.

operations.name: edgeconnect_authentication122
operations.summary: Get the current authentication status of the HTTP session
operations.description: Returns the authentication state of the current HTTP session including login status, username, and SSO type. Use this endpoint to verify if a session is authenticated before making API calls. No authentication required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_authentication126
operations.summary: Request two-factor authentication code via email
operations.description: Validates user credentials and sends a 4-digit two-factor authentication code to the user's registered email address. The code expires in 20 minutes. Use this endpoint before calling /authentication/login when the user has email-based 2FA enabled. Also supports requesting a temporary email code for users with only app-based 2FA by setting tempCode to true. No authentication required.

request_body.description: User credentials for authentication before sending the 2FA code.

operations.name: edgeconnect_authentication127
operations.summary: Logout and terminate the current HTTP session
operations.description: Terminates the authenticated HTTP session for the current user. Invalidates the session, removes the login token, and logs the logout action in the audit log. If the 'comments' parameter is set to 'session-timeout', the audit log will indicate an automatic logout due to session expiration. Returns success even if called without authentication, but will return 401 if no session token exists.

parameters.name: comments
parameters.description: Optional comment to log with the logout action. Use 'session-timeout' for auto-logout due to session expiration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_oauth_redirect128
operations.summary: OAuth callback endpoint for SSO authentication
operations.description: Handles the OAuth 2.0 authorization callback from configured identity providers (e.g., Azure AD, Okta). This endpoint is called by the OAuth provider after user authentication. It exchanges the authorization code for tokens, extracts user identity and RBAC roles, and creates an authenticated HTTP session. On success, sets session cookie and CSRF token, then redirects to the main application. Requires pre-configured OAuth settings in Orchestrator.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: OAuth state token obtained from /authentication/oauth/stateToken endpoint. Used to validate the OAuth callback and identify the OAuth provider configuration.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code returned by the OAuth provider after user authentication. Exchanged for access and refresh tokens.

operations.name: edgeconnect_oauth_state_token129
operations.summary: Generate OAuth state token for SSO authorization flow
operations.description: Generates a unique UUID state token required to initiate OAuth 2.0 SSO authentication. The token is associated with the specified OAuth provider configuration and is used to validate the OAuth callback. Token expires after 30 minutes or once used in the /authentication/oauth/redirect endpoint. No authentication required.

parameters.name: oauthType
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the configured OAuth provider. Obtain from the OAuth configuration settings in Orchestrator.

operations.name: edgeconnect_authentication121
operations.summary: Retrieve the orchestrator randomizer key for client-side password encryption.
operations.description: Returns a Base64-encoded secret key that is randomly generated when the Orchestrator starts. This key is required as the 'randomizer' parameter when submitting encrypted passwords in login requests. The key remains constant until the Orchestrator is restarted. No authentication required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_authentication130
operations.summary: Validate user credentials without creating a session
operations.description: Validates user credentials against local, RADIUS, or TACACS+ authentication without creating an authenticated session. Use this endpoint to verify credentials before performing sensitive operations. Failed attempts are tracked and may result in temporary account lockout. No authentication required.

request_body.description: User credentials to validate. Supports local, RADIUS, or TACACS+ authentication.

operations.name: edgeconnect_saml_authentication131
operations.summary: SAML 2.0 SSO callback endpoint for authentication
operations.description: Handles SAML 2.0 authentication callback from configured identity providers. This endpoint receives the SAML assertion from the IdP after user authentication, validates the response, extracts user identity and RBAC roles, and creates an authenticated HTTP session. On success, sets session and CSRF token cookies, then redirects to the main application. Requires pre-configured SAML settings in Orchestrator.

request_body.description: SAML 2.0 assertion response from the Identity Provider.

operations.name: edgeconnect_saml_logout132
operations.summary: Process SAML 2.0 Single Logout (SLO) request from Identity Provider
operations.description: Handles IdP-initiated SAML 2.0 Single Logout requests. The Identity Provider sends a SAMLRequest containing a LogoutRequest to terminate the user's session on Orchestrator. The endpoint decodes the request, validates the signature and issuer against configured SAML settings, processes the logout, and sends a LogoutResponse back to the IdP. Requires pre-configured SAML settings with SLO endpoint in Orchestrator.

parameters.name: SAMLRequest
parameters.description: Base64-encoded and DEFLATE-compressed SAML 2.0 LogoutRequest XML from the Identity Provider. Contains issuer, name ID, and session index for Single Logout (SLO).

operations.name: edgeconnect_user_auth_type133
operations.summary: Check the two-factor authentication methods required for user login
operations.description: Validates user credentials and returns the two-factor authentication (2FA) type configured for the user. Use this endpoint before login to determine if 2FA is required. For non-local users (RADIUS/TACACS+), always returns PASSWORDONLY. Failed attempts are tracked and may result in account lockout. No authentication required.

request_body.description: User credentials to validate before returning authentication type.

operations.name: edgeconnect_user_auth_type_token134
operations.summary: Check user 2FA configuration using a reset password token
operations.description: Retrieves the two-factor authentication (2FA) methods configured for a user identified by their password reset token. Use this endpoint during the password reset flow to determine if 2FA verification is required. The token is obtained from the password reset email link. No authentication required.

request_body.description: Reset password token from the password reset email link.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_auto_tuned_properties
operations.summary: Get auto-tuned orchestrator properties
operations.description: Retrieves the current auto-tuned performance configuration properties for the orchestrator. Values are dynamically calculated based on appliance count thresholds (200, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000+). Properties include thread pool sizes, parallel task limits, and Jetty server thread configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_avc_mode
operations.summary: Get AVC Mode Status
operations.description: Returns the Application Visibility and Control (AVC) mode status. When called without parameters, returns aggregate AVC status across all appliances. When called with nePk, returns AVC status for a specific appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_banner_info136
operations.summary: Retrieve banner messages from an appliance
operations.description: Returns the Message of the Day (MOTD) and login issue banner messages configured on a specified EdgeConnect appliance. Data can be retrieved from cache for faster response or directly from the appliance for real-time values.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Determines the data source. When true (default), returns data from Orchestrator's cache for faster response. When false, fetches live data directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_bfd_vrf_config138
operations.summary: Retrieve BFD VRF configuration
operations.description: Retrieves Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) configuration for appliance VRFs. Returns all VRF configs or a specific VRF config based on parameters.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: vrfId
parameters.description: VRF segment identifier to retrieve specific VRF configuration. Omit to retrieve all VRF configurations.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches directly from appliance and updates cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_bfd_sessions139
operations.summary: Retrieve BFD session state for all VRFs
operations.description: Retrieves Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) session state information for all VRFs on an appliance. Returns active BFD sessions with connection statistics and negotiated parameters.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches directly from appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_vrfs_neighbor140
operations.summary: Get BGP neighbor configuration for all VRFs
operations.description: Retrieves BGP neighbor configuration data across all VRFs (Virtual Routing and Forwarding instances) for the specified appliance. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database; when false or omitted, fetches live data from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_vrf_bgp_system_config141
operations.summary: Get BGP system configuration for all VRFs
operations.description: Retrieves BGP system configuration data across all VRFs (Virtual Routing and Forwarding instances) for the specified appliance. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database; when false or omitted, fetches live data from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_neighbor142
operations.summary: Get BGP neighbor configuration for default VRF
operations.description: Retrieves BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) neighbor configuration for the default VRF segment. Returns a map of configured BGP peers keyed by neighbor IP address. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database; when false or omitted, fetches live data from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_bgp_system_config143
operations.summary: Get BGP system configuration for default VRF
operations.description: Retrieves BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) system configuration for the default VRF segment. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database; when false or omitted, fetches live data from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_bgp_state145
operations.summary: Get BGP state details for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) operational state information for a specified appliance. Returns neighbor session states and BGP summary statistics. Supports fetching data for a specific VRF segment or the default VRF.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database; when false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: vrfId
parameters.description: VRF segment identifier. When provided, retrieves BGP state for the specified VRF; when omitted, returns state for the default VRF (segment 0).

operations.name: edgeconnect_all_vrfs_bgp_state144
operations.summary: Get BGP state details for all VRFs
operations.description: Retrieves BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) operational state information across all VRFs (Virtual Routing and Forwarding instances) for a specified appliance. Returns neighbor state, session status, and routing statistics for each VRF segment.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database; when false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_text_customization_config_get147
operations.summary: Retrieve text brand customization configurations
operations.description: Retrieves all configured text brand customization settings. Returns a map of customization types to their configuration objects. This endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication. Supported text customization types: footer, welcomeText, patentText, orchText, supportLinkURL, homePageTitle.

operations.name: edgeconnect_text_customization_config_put149
operations.summary: Update text brand customization configurations
operations.description: Updates existing text brand customization settings by completely replacing current configurations. Returns 204 if no customizations exist (use POST first). Requires READ_WRITE permission. Logs action to system audit log.

request_body.description: Map of customization type names to their configuration objects. Replaces all existing text customizations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_text_customization_config_post148
operations.summary: Create new text brand customization configurations
operations.description: Creates initial text brand customization settings. Fails if customizations already exist (use PUT to update). Requires READ_WRITE permission. Logs action to system audit log.

request_body.description: Map of customization type names to their configuration objects.

operations.name: edgeconnect_text_customization_config_delete146
operations.summary: Delete all brand customization configurations
operations.description: Removes all brand customization settings including text and image customizations. This operation deletes both text configurations (footer, welcomeText, patentText, orchText, supportLinkURL, homePageTitle) and image customizations (backgroundImage, logoImage, bannerImage, favicon, treeImage). All custom images are restored to their default versions. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_file_name_get150
operations.summary: Retrieve metadata for all uploaded custom brand images
operations.description: Returns file name metadata for all configured custom brand images. Requires authentication with READ or READ_WRITE permission. Supported image types: backgroundImage, logoImage, bannerImage, favicon, treeImage.

parameters.name: metaData
parameters.description: Must be set to true to retrieve image metadata. If false or missing, returns 400 error.

operations.name: edgeconnect_image_put153
operations.summary: Update an existing custom brand image
operations.description: Replaces an existing custom brand image with a new uploaded image. The image is stored in the database and applied to both legacy and React UIs. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Logs the update action to the system audit log.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The image customization type to update. Determines where the image will be displayed in the UI.

parameters.name: qqfile
parameters.description: The file name for the uploaded image. Must be ≤30 characters with a valid image extension.

request_body.description: The image file binary data. Maximum file size is 20MB.

operations.name: edgeconnect_image_post152
operations.summary: Upload a new custom brand image
operations.description: Uploads a custom image for the specified brand customization type. The image is stored in the database and applied to both legacy and React UIs. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Logs the upload action to the system audit log.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The image customization type to upload. Determines where the image will be displayed in the UI.

parameters.name: qqfile
parameters.description: The file name for the uploaded image. Max 30 characters. Must have a valid image extension.

request_body.description: The image file binary data. Max file size is 20MB.

operations.name: edgeconnect_image_delete151
operations.summary: Delete custom brand image and restore default
operations.description: Deletes a custom brand image by type and restores the default system image. Removes the custom image from the database and replaces it with the original default image for both legacy and React UIs. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Logs the deletion action to the system audit log.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The image customization type to delete. Specifies which custom brand image to remove and restore to default.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_bridge_groups
operations.summary: Get bridge groups configuration
operations.description: Retrieves bridge group (link aggregation) configuration data from the specified appliance. Returns cached data by default or queries the appliance directly when cached=false. Requires appliance software version 9.0.3.0 or later.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data source: true or omitted returns cached data from Orchestrator database; false queries the appliance directly and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_broadcast_cli_post154
operations.summary: Broadcast CLI commands to multiple appliances asynchronously
operations.description: Broadcasts CLI commands to multiple appliances asynchronously. The operation validates appliance existence before queuing commands. Each command is executed sequentially on each appliance via the /cli endpoint. Results can be polled using the returned clientKey.

request_body.description: Request body containing target appliances and CLI commands to execute.

operations.name: edgeconnect_bypass_get156
operations.summary: Get bypass mode settings for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the bypass mode settings for a specific NX appliance. Bypass mode allows traffic to pass through the appliance without optimization when enabled. Use cached=true for faster responses or cached=false to query the appliance directly.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance. Defaults to 'true' if not provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_bypass_post155
operations.summary: Toggle bypass mode for NX appliances asynchronously
operations.description: Enables or disables bypass mode on NX hardware appliances. Only appliances supporting bypass (supportsBypass=true) are affected. Non-existent appliances are skipped. Returns a client key for polling operation status.

request_body.description: JSON payload with bypass enable flag and list of appliance primary keys.

operations.name: edgeconnect_builtin_app_get157
operations.summary: Retrieve cached built-in applications
operations.description: Returns a snapshot of all built-in applications from the cache, mapped to their associated appliances. Built-in applications are predefined network applications recognized by the system.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cache_and_db_data
operations.summary: Retrieve cache and database synchronization state
operations.description: Compares in-memory cache data with database data for all registered GMS configuration resources. Identifies which resources need synchronization by detecting differences between cached and stored values. Skips certain internal resources like tgwAssociation and tgwRouteTables.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_cache
operations.summary: Synchronize in-memory cache with database values
operations.description: Reloads specified GMS configuration resources from the database into the in-memory cache. Use this to repair cache discrepancies identified by the GET /cache/syncState endpoint. Each path is processed independently; failures do not stop processing of remaining paths.

request_body.description: Array of resource paths to reload from database to cache. Must contain at least one valid path from the ResourcePath enum.

operations.name: edgeconnect_user_app_get159
operations.summary: Retrieve cached user-defined applications
operations.description: Returns a snapshot of all user-defined applications from the cache, mapped to their associated appliances. User-defined applications are custom network applications created by administrators.

operations.name: edgeconnect_cloud_apps_config160
operations.summary: Get SaaS Optimization configuration for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves SaaS Optimization configuration for a specified appliance. Returns the SaaS Optimization enable/disable state, RTT calculation interval, ping source interface, number of pings, and the collection of cloud applications with their subnets, domains, and threshold settings downloaded from the cloud portal.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval source flag. When true (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_cloud_apps_monitor161
operations.summary: Get SaaS application subnet monitoring data including RTT and reachability status
operations.description: Retrieves real-time monitoring data for SaaS application subnets on a specified appliance. Returns RTT (Round Trip Time) measurements, reachability status, and advertisement state for each configured cloud application subnet. Use this endpoint to monitor SaaS optimization performance and troubleshoot connectivity issues.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval source flag. When true (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aws_accounts165
operations.summary: Retrieve AWS accounts
operations.description: Retrieves registered AWS account(s) from the Orchestrator. Returns all accounts when no ID is specified, or a specific account when ID is provided. The secretKey field is always returned empty for security.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of a specific AWS account to retrieve. If omitted, all registered AWS accounts are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_put_aws_account166
operations.summary: Update an existing AWS account
operations.description: Updates an existing AWS account configuration. Validates the new credentials against AWS before saving. The secret key is encrypted before storage.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the AWS account to update. Obtained from GET /cloudDeployment/aws/accounts or POST response.

request_body.description: Updated AWS account configuration. All fields (name, accessKey, secretKey) are required for update.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_aws_account163
operations.summary: Register a new AWS account for cloud deployment
operations.description: Registers a new AWS account with the Orchestrator for cloud deployment operations. The account credentials are validated against AWS before being stored. The secret key is encrypted before storage.

request_body.description: AWS account configuration containing credentials and metadata. The id field is auto-generated and should not be provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_aws_account
operations.summary: Delete AWS account by ID
operations.description: Removes a registered AWS account from the Orchestrator. The account cannot be deleted if it is currently associated with any active cloud deployments.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the AWS account to delete. Obtained from GET /cloudDeployment/aws/accounts or POST response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_config_by_id170
operations.summary: Retrieve AWS Cloud Hub deployment configuration(s)
operations.description: Retrieves AWS Cloud Hub deployment configuration(s). Returns all AWS deployments when no ID is specified, or a specific deployment when ID is provided.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. If omitted, all AWS deployments are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_aws_deployment_comment_update
operations.summary: Update AWS deployment comment
operations.description: Updates the comment/description for an existing AWS Cloud Hub deployment. Only the comment field can be modified; other deployment configuration settings remain unchanged.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Obtain from GET /cloudDeployment/aws/edgeconnects or POST response.

request_body.description: Object containing the new comment value for the deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_deploy_aws_appliances168
operations.summary: Deploy Cloud Hub(s) in AWS
operations.description: Initiates deployment of one or more EdgeConnect Cloud Hub appliances in AWS. The Orchestrator must be registered to Cloud Portal before deployment. Creates VPC, subnets, security groups, and EC2 instances using Terraform.

request_body.description: AWS deployment configuration specifying account, region, network settings, and instance details.

operations.name: edgeconnect_destroy_deployment_by_id169
operations.summary: Terminate AWS Cloud Hub deployment
operations.description: Initiates termination (destroy) of an AWS Cloud Hub deployment and all associated cloud resources. Uses Terraform to remove VPC, subnets, security groups, and EC2 instances. The operation is queued asynchronously.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID to terminate. Obtain from GET /cloudDeployment/aws/edgeconnects or POST response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cloud_resources_by_id171
operations.summary: Retrieve AWS Cloud Hub deployment cloud resources
operations.description: Returns the Terraform-provisioned AWS cloud resources (VPC, subnets, security groups, EC2 instances, etc.) for a specific deployment. Resources are parsed from the Terraform state file and categorized into common artifacts shared across all instances and per-instance artifacts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Obtain from GET /cloudDeployment/aws/edgeconnects or POST response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_deployment_status_by_id172
operations.summary: Retrieve AWS Cloud Hub deployment status
operations.description: Returns the current deployment status for a specific AWS Cloud Hub deployment. Use this endpoint to monitor deployment progress, check completion state, or verify destruction status.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Obtain from GET /cloudDeployment/aws/edgeconnects or POST response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_aws_instance
operations.summary: Add instance to existing AWS Cloud Hub deployment
operations.description: Adds a new EdgeConnect Cloud Hub instance to an existing AWS deployment. The deployment must not be in DEPLOYING or DESTROYING state. The new instance will be assigned subnets and queued for Terraform deployment.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Obtain from GET /cloudDeployment/aws/edgeconnects or POST response.

request_body.description: New instance configuration specifying availability zone and optional appliance tag.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cloud_deployment_log
operations.summary: Download AWS Cloud Hub deployment log file
operations.description: Downloads the Terraform deployment log for an AWS Cloud Hub deployment as a text file attachment. The log contains detailed information about the deployment process including resource creation, configuration steps, and any errors encountered during deployment or termination operations.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Obtain from GET /cloudDeployment/aws/edgeconnects or POST response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_config_by_id_azure_nva
operations.summary: Get Azure NVA deployment configuration
operations.description: Retrieves Azure NVA EdgeConnect deployment configuration(s) from the Orchestrator. When called without an ID parameter, returns all azure_nva provider deployments. When called with a specific ID, returns only that deployment configuration wrapped in an array.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID to retrieve a specific deployment. Omit to retrieve all azure_nva deployments. Must be a positive integer referencing an existing deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_deployment_comment_update_azure_nva
operations.summary: Update Azure NVA deployment comment
operations.description: Updates the comment field for an existing Azure NVA EdgeConnect deployment. Only the comment can be modified after deployment creation. The action is logged in the system action log.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID to update. Must reference an existing azure_nva deployment.

request_body.description: Deployment update payload containing the new comment value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_deploy_azure_appliances_in_virtual_wan_hub
operations.summary: Deploy EdgeConnect appliances in Azure Virtual WAN hub
operations.description: Initiates deployment of EdgeConnect NVA instances in an Azure Virtual WAN hub. Requires Orchestrator to be registered with the cloud portal. Validates configuration including ASN range (64512-65534, excluding Azure reserved ASNs) and scale unit availability.

parameters.name: deploy
parameters.description: Flag to trigger deployment. When true, deployment is queued for execution.

request_body.description: Azure NVA deployment configuration containing account, region, virtual hub, and appliance settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_destroy_deployment_by_id_azure_nva
operations.summary: Destroy Azure NVA EdgeConnect deployment
operations.description: Terminates and removes EdgeConnect NVA appliances deployed in an Azure Virtual WAN hub. The operation queues the destruction request and returns immediately. Destruction cannot proceed if deployment status is DEPLOYING (2) or DESTROYING (5).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID to destroy. Must reference an existing azure_nva deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cloud_resources_by_id_azure_nva
operations.summary: Get Azure NVA cloud resources for a Virtual WAN Hub deployment
operations.description: Retrieves the Azure NVA resource identifiers associated with an EdgeConnect deployment in Azure Virtual WAN. Returns the NVA ID if the deployment has been successfully provisioned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique deployment identifier assigned by the Orchestrator. Use GET /cloudDeployment/azure-nva/edgeconnects to retrieve available deployment IDs.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_deployment_status_by_id_azure_nva
operations.summary: Get deployment status for Azure NVA EdgeConnect in Virtual WAN hub
operations.description: Retrieves the current deployment status, configuration details, and logs for a specific Azure NVA EdgeConnect deployment. Use this endpoint to track deployment progress, monitor deployment lifecycle states, and retrieve deployment logs for troubleshooting.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Azure NVA deployment assigned by Orchestrator. Obtain this ID from the POST /cloudDeployment/azure-nva/edgeconnects response or GET /cloudDeployment/azure-nva/edgeconnects endpoint.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_cloud_deployment_log_azure_nva
operations.summary: Download deployment log for Azure NVA cloud hub in virtual WAN
operations.description: Retrieves and downloads the deployment log file for a specific Azure NVA (Network Virtual Appliance) cloud hub deployment in virtual WAN. The log contains detailed information about deployment operations, status changes, and any errors encountered during the deployment process. The log file is returned as a downloadable text attachment.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique deployment identifier assigned by the Orchestrator. This ID is returned when creating a new Azure NVA deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_accounts176
operations.summary: Retrieve Azure cloud deployment accounts
operations.description: Retrieves Azure subscription accounts configured for IaaS EdgeConnect deployment. Returns all accounts when no ID is specified, or a single account wrapped in an array when ID is provided. Client secrets are always redacted (empty string) for security.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned Azure account UUID. When omitted, all configured accounts are returned. When provided, returns only the matching account or 204 if not found.

operations.name: edgeconnect_put_azure_account177
operations.summary: Update Azure subscription account
operations.description: Updates an existing Azure subscription account with new credentials or configuration. All required fields must be provided. Credentials are re-validated with Azure AD before storage, and the client secret is encrypted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned Azure account UUID to update. Must not be null or whitespace-only.

request_body.description: Complete Azure account configuration with updated values. All required fields must be provided even if unchanged.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_azure_account174
operations.summary: Add Azure account for cloud deployment
operations.description: Registers a new Azure subscription account for IaaS EdgeConnect deployment. Validates credentials by authenticating with Azure AD and verifying access to zone mappings. The client secret is encrypted before storage.

request_body.description: Azure account configuration with service principal credentials

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_azure_account175
operations.summary: Delete Azure subscription account
operations.description: Removes an Azure subscription account from the Orchestrator by its unique identifier. The account must not be associated with any active cloud deployments. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned Azure account UUID to delete. Must be a valid non-empty UUID string that corresponds to an existing account.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_config_by_id181
operations.summary: Get Azure Cloud Hub deployment configuration
operations.description: Retrieves Azure Cloud Hub deployment configurations. When called without an ID, returns all Azure deployments. When called with a specific ID, returns only that deployment wrapped in an array.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Omit to retrieve all Azure deployments, or provide a specific ID to retrieve a single deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_deployment_comment_update
operations.summary: Update Azure Cloud Hub deployment comment
operations.description: Updates the comment/description field for an existing Azure Cloud Hub deployment. Only the comment field is modified; all other deployment configuration remains unchanged.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Identifies which Azure Cloud Hub deployment to update.

request_body.description: Deployment update data containing the new comment value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_deploy_azure_appliances179
operations.summary: Deploy Cloud Hub(s) in Azure
operations.description: Initiates deployment of one or more EdgeConnect Cloud Hub appliances in Microsoft Azure. Requires Orchestrator to be registered with Cloud Portal. Validates deployment configuration and queues the deployment task.

request_body.description: Azure deployment configuration containing subscription details, network settings, and instance specifications

operations.name: edgeconnect_destroy_deployment_by_id180
operations.summary: Terminate Azure Cloud Hub deployment
operations.description: Destroys all Azure cloud resources associated with a deployment, including VMs, network interfaces, and related infrastructure. The termination is queued asynchronously. Cannot be executed while another deployment or destruction operation is in progress.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Identifies which Azure Cloud Hub deployment to terminate.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cloud_resources_by_id182
operations.summary: Get Azure Cloud Hub deployment cloud resources
operations.description: Retrieves Azure cloud infrastructure resources associated with a specific EdgeConnect deployment. Returns common artifacts shared across instances and per-instance resources such as NICs and VMs.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Orchestrator-assigned deployment identifier. Must be a valid Azure deployment ID returned from the deployment creation endpoint.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_deployment_status_by_id183
operations.summary: Get Azure EdgeConnect deployment status
operations.description: Retrieves the current deployment status for a specific Azure EdgeConnect cloud deployment. Returns deployment metadata including status code, instance count, and configuration details. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role permissions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Orchestrator-assigned deployment identifier. Must be a valid positive integer referencing an existing Azure deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_azure_instance
operations.summary: Add instance to an existing Azure cloud deployment
operations.description: Adds a new EdgeConnect instance (Cloud Hub) to an existing Azure cloud deployment. The new instance is queued for deployment and subnets are automatically assigned. The appliance tag must be unique across all instances in the deployment.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID for the existing Azure cloud deployment. Must be a valid deployment ID that exists and belongs to the Azure provider.

request_body.description: Configuration for the new Azure instance to add to the deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_cloud_deployment_log
operations.summary: Download Azure Cloud Hub deployment log
operations.description: Downloads the Terraform deployment log file for a specific Azure Cloud Hub deployment. The log contains detailed deployment progress, including resource creation status and any errors encountered during provisioning.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique deployment identifier assigned by the Orchestrator. This ID is returned when creating a new Azure deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_config_by_id_azure_ilb
operations.summary: Get Azure Load Balancer Deployment Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves Azure Internal Load Balancer (ILB) deployment configurations. Returns all configurations when no ID is specified, or a specific configuration when ID is provided. The response always returns an array, even for single configurations.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Optional parameter - when omitted, returns all azure_load_balancer deployments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_deployment_comment_update_ilb
operations.summary: Update Azure Load Balancer Deployment Configuration
operations.description: Modifies an existing Azure Internal Load Balancer (ILB) deployment configuration. Supports updating comment (metadata only) and/or health probe port. Changing probePort triggers an asynchronous Azure redeployment.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned unique deployment ID. Must reference an existing azure_load_balancer deployment.

request_body.description: Fields to update. Both fields are optional; at least one should be provided. Updating probePort requires valid Azure account credentials and triggers redeployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_deploy_azure_ilb
operations.summary: Deploy Azure Internal Load Balancer
operations.description: Creates and deploys a new Azure Internal Load Balancer (ILB) configuration. Requires Orchestrator to be registered with the portal and a valid Azure account. Deployment can use an existing subnet or create a new one.

request_body.description: Azure load balancer deployment configuration

operations.name: edgeconnect_destroy_deployment_by_id_azure_ilb
operations.summary: Delete Azure Load Balancer Deployment
operations.description: Destroys and removes an existing Azure Internal Load Balancer (ILB) deployment. Queues the termination request and removes associated Azure cloud resources. Requires READ_WRITE role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing azure_load_balancer deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cloud_resources_by_id_ilb
operations.summary: Get Azure ILB cloud resources
operations.description: Retrieves the list of Azure cloud resources associated with an Azure Internal Load Balancer deployment. Returns resource names and Azure resource IDs extracted from the Terraform state. Resources include azurerm_lb, azurerm_lb_backend_address_pool, azurerm_lb_probe, and azurerm_lb_rule.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID for the Azure load balancer. Must be a valid deployment ID returned from a previous deployment creation.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_deployment_status_by_id_ilb
operations.summary: Get deployment status for Azure load balancer
operations.description: Retrieves the deployment status and execution logs for Azure Internal Load Balancer deployments. When called without an id parameter, returns status for all Azure load balancer deployments. When called with an id, returns status for that specific deployment.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment identifier. If omitted, returns status for all Azure load balancer deployments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_cloud_deployment_log_ilb
operations.summary: Download deployment log for Azure load balancer
operations.description: Downloads the deployment log file for a specific Azure load balancer deployment. The log contains details about the deployment process including Terraform execution output. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permissions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID for the Azure load balancer. Must be a valid positive integer corresponding to an existing deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_config_by_id_azure_route_server
operations.summary: Retrieve Azure Route Server Deployment Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves Azure Route Server deployment configurations. Returns all deployments when called without an ID, or a specific deployment when ID is provided. Results are returned as an array for consistency.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. When omitted, returns all Azure Route Server deployments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_deployment_comment_update_route_server
operations.summary: Update Azure Route Server Deployment Comment
operations.description: Updates the comment/description field of an existing Azure Route Server deployment. Only the comment field can be modified; other deployment configuration settings are immutable after creation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Identifies the Azure Route Server deployment to update.

request_body.description: Deployment update payload containing the new comment value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_deploy_azure_route_server
operations.summary: Deploy Azure Route Server
operations.description: Initiates deployment of an Azure Route Server in the specified virtual network. Requires Orchestrator to be registered to the portal. The route server can be deployed in an existing subnet or a new subnet will be created.

parameters.name: deploy
parameters.description: Flag to trigger deployment. When true, initiates the deployment process.

request_body.description: Azure Route Server deployment configuration

operations.name: edgeconnect_destroy_deployment_by_id_azure_route_server
operations.summary: Delete Azure Route Server Deployment
operations.description: Initiates destruction of an Azure Route Server deployment. The operation queues the termination request and destroys all associated cloud resources via Terraform. The deployment must not be in DEPLOYING or DESTROYING state.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Identifies the Azure Route Server deployment to delete.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cloud_resources_by_id_azure_route_server
operations.summary: Retrieve Azure Route Server cloud resources
operations.description: Fetches the list of Azure cloud resources associated with a specific Azure Route Server deployment. Returns resource names and Azure resource IDs extracted from the deployment state. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID for the Azure Route Server. Must be a valid deployment ID that exists and is of type 'azure_route_server'.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_deployment_status_by_id_route_server
operations.summary: Get deployment status for Azure Route Server
operations.description: Retrieves the current deployment status, logs, and metadata for Azure Route Server deployments. If no ID is specified, returns status for all Azure Route Server deployments.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. If omitted, returns status for all Azure Route Server deployments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_cloud_deployment_log_route_server
operations.summary: Download Azure Route Server deployment log file
operations.description: Retrieves the deployment log file for a specific Azure Route Server deployment. Returns the log content as a downloadable text file attachment. Useful for troubleshooting deployment issues or reviewing Terraform execution history.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the Azure Route Server deployment. Obtained from POST /cloudDeployment/azure/route-server or GET /cloudDeployment/azure/route-server.

operations.name: edgeconnect_getgcp_accounts187
operations.summary: Retrieve GCP service accounts
operations.description: Retrieves registered GCP service accounts. Returns all accounts if no ID specified, or a specific account by project ID. The service account key is never returned for security reasons.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: GCP project ID to filter by. If omitted, returns all registered accounts.

operations.name: edgeconnect_put_gcp_account188
operations.summary: Update GCP service account credentials
operations.description: Updates an existing GCP service account's credentials (key rotation). The new key must belong to the same GCP project as the existing account. The key is validated by fetching GCP regions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The GCP project ID of the account to update. Must match an existing registered account.

request_body.description: Updated GCP service account configuration. The 'key' field is required and must contain a valid service account key for the same project.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_gcp_account185
operations.summary: Register a GCP service account for cloud deployment
operations.description: Registers a new GCP service account for cloud deployment operations. The service account key is validated by attempting to fetch GCP regions. The project ID is automatically extracted from the key JSON.

request_body.description: GCP service account configuration. The 'key' field must contain a valid GCP service account key in JSON format.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_gcp_accounts186
operations.summary: Delete a registered GCP service account
operations.description: Removes a GCP service account from Orchestrator by its project ID. The account cannot be deleted if it is currently associated with any active cloud deployments.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The GCP project ID of the account to delete. This is the project_id extracted from the service account key when the account was registered.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_config_by_id193
operations.summary: Retrieve GCP Cloud Hub deployment configurations
operations.description: Retrieves GCP Cloud Hub deployment configurations. Returns all deployments when no ID is specified, or a specific deployment by ID. Can also retry a failed deployment using the retryApply parameter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. If omitted or -1, returns all GCP deployments. If specified, returns only the matching deployment.

parameters.name: retryApply
parameters.description: When true, retries a failed deployment. Requires a valid deployment ID. Deployment must not be in DEPLOYING or DESTROYING status.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gcp_deployment_comment_update
operations.summary: Update GCP deployment comment
operations.description: Updates the comment/description field of an existing GCP Cloud Hub deployment. The comment is stored in the deployment configuration and persisted to the database.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing GCP deployment.

request_body.description: Deployment update payload containing the new comment value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_deploy_gcp_appliances190
operations.summary: Deploy Cloud Hub(s) in GCP
operations.description: Creates a new GCP Cloud Hub deployment. Validates configuration, fetches portal metadata, and queues instances for deployment. Orchestrator must be registered to Cloud Portal.

request_body.description: GCP deployment configuration including account, network settings, and instance specifications.

operations.name: edgeconnect_destroy_gcp_deployment_by_id192
operations.summary: Destroy all Cloud Hub instances in a GCP deployment
operations.description: Terminates and destroys all Cloud Hub instances associated with a GCP deployment. The deployment must not be currently deploying or destroying. The destruction is queued and processed asynchronously via Terraform.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing GCP deployment that is not currently in DEPLOYING (2) or DESTROYING (5) status.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cloud_resources_by_id194
operations.summary: Retrieve GCP Cloud Hub deployment cloud resources
operations.description: Retrieves the cloud resource artifacts (VPCs, subnets, instances, etc.) created in GCP for a specific deployment. Resources are extracted from the Terraform state file and categorized into common artifacts (shared across deployment) and per-instance artifacts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing GCP deployment with Terraform state.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_deployment_status_by_id195
operations.summary: Get GCP Cloud Hub deployment status
operations.description: Retrieves the current deployment status for a specific GCP Cloud Hub deployment. Use this endpoint to monitor deployment progress, check for completion, or detect failures.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing GCP deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_put_gcp_instance_comment
operations.summary: Update GCP instance comment
operations.description: Updates the comment/description of a specific GCP Cloud Hub instance within a deployment. The comment is stored in the instance configuration and persisted to the database.

parameters.name: deploymentId
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing GCP deployment.

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Unique instance identifier (UUID) assigned by Orchestrator when the instance was created.

request_body.description: Instance update payload containing the new comment value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_gcp_instance196
operations.summary: Add Cloud Hub instance(s) to an existing GCP deployment
operations.description: Adds one or more new Cloud Hub instances to an existing GCP deployment. Each instance is validated, assigned subnets automatically, and queued for deployment. The deployment must not have another action in progress.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing GCP deployment that is not currently deploying or destroying.

request_body.description: Array of GCP instance configurations to add to the deployment. Each instance must specify region, zone, instance type, and bandwidth.

operations.name: edgeconnect_destroy_gcp_instance191
operations.summary: Destroy a deployed GCP Cloud Hub instance
operations.description: Terminates a specific Cloud Hub instance within a GCP deployment. Behavior varies based on deployment state: if no resources have been deployed to GCP yet, the instance is removed from config; if all instances are marked for termination, the entire deployment is destroyed.

parameters.name: deploymentId
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing GCP deployment that is not currently deploying or destroying.

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: UUID of the instance to terminate. Must match an existing instance within the specified deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_getgcp_cloud_deployment_log
operations.summary: Download GCP Cloud Hub deployment Terraform log
operations.description: Downloads the Terraform deployment log file for a specific GCP Cloud Hub deployment. The log contains detailed output from Terraform operations including apply and destroy actions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Orchestrator-assigned deployment ID. Must reference an existing GCP deployment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cluster_state
operations.summary: Get Cluster State
operations.description: Retrieves the cluster state information for all configured clusters or a specific cluster. Returns synchronization status, appliance interface details, nonce, and cipher profile information for each cluster.

parameters.name: clusterName
parameters.description: Filter results by specific cluster/site name. When not provided, returns state for all clusters.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, uses cached flow redirection config from database. When false, fetches fresh data directly from appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cluster_alarm_count
operations.summary: Get Cluster Alarm Count
operations.description: Retrieves the alarm count and maximum severity for each cluster/site that has a cluster profile mapped. Only sites with active (non-disabled) profile mappings are included in the response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_init_for_edge_ha
operations.summary: Initialize Appliances for EdgeHA Cluster
operations.description: Initializes a pair of appliances for Edge High Availability (EdgeHA) clustering. Validates that appliances are compatible, belong to the same HA group, and assigns them to the default EdgeHA cluster profile. If appliances don't have a site name, one is auto-generated.

request_body.description: Array of exactly 2 appliance IDs (nePks) to initialize for EdgeHA clustering. Both appliances must belong to the same HA group.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cluster_profile_mapping
operations.summary: Get All Cluster Profile Mappings
operations.description: Retrieves all cluster profile to site mappings. Returns a map where each key is a cluster profile UUID and the value is a set of site/cluster names assigned to that profile.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_cluster_profile_mapping
operations.summary: Update Cluster Profile Mappings
operations.description: Updates or adds cluster profile to site mappings. Merges provided mappings with existing ones. Sites in the request are moved to the specified profile, removing them from any previous profile assignment. Newly mapped sites trigger cluster sync operations.

request_body.description: Map of profile UUIDs to arrays of site names. Profile IDs must exist (from GET /cluster/profiles). Sites are assigned to the specified profile and removed from previous mappings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_cluster_profiles
operations.summary: Get All Cluster Profiles
operations.description: Retrieves all configured cluster profiles from the system. Cluster profiles define settings for flow redirection and user session synchronization between appliances in a cluster.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_cluster_profile
operations.summary: Update Cluster Profile
operations.description: Updates an existing cluster profile configuration. The profile ID must match an existing profile. Automatically marks all mapped sites for cluster update and queues all appliances for applying the updated profile.

request_body.description: Complete cluster profile object with updated values. The 'id' field must match an existing profile.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_cluster_profile
operations.summary: Add Cluster Profiles
operations.description: Creates one or more new cluster profiles for flow redirection and user session synchronization between appliances. Profile IDs are auto-generated UUIDs and names must be unique across all profiles.

request_body.description: Array of cluster profile configurations to create. Do not include 'id' or 'isEdgeHaProfile' fields as they are system-managed.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_cluster_profile
operations.summary: Delete Cluster Profile
operations.description: Permanently removes a cluster profile from the system. The profile must not be the default EdgeHA profile and must not be mapped to any site/cluster. Unmap the profile from all sites before deletion.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: UUID of the cluster profile to delete. Must be an existing, non-default profile that is not mapped to any site.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_disk_information
operations.summary: Get disk and storage controller information for an appliance.
operations.description: Retrieves disk partition and storage controller information from an EdgeConnect appliance. Returns disk details (size, status, serial number, RAID pairing), controller details (model, firmware, RAID configuration), and a reference image filename for the hardware model.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_configuration_limits
operations.summary: Get appliance configuration limits
operations.description: Retrieves configuration limits and hardware capabilities from a specified appliance. Returns scalar values including maximum flow counts, bandwidth limits, port counts, memory size, and feature support flags.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_customizable_bindings199
operations.summary: Retrieve custom appliance tags
operations.description: Gets all user-defined custom tag entries for a specific appliance. Each appliance supports up to 8 custom tags with unique name-value pairs. Data can be retrieved from cache (default) or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data source. When true or omitted, returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_custom_certs200
operations.summary: Get all custom CA certificates
operations.description: Retrieves all custom CA certificates configured in Orchestrator. Each certificate includes parsed metadata such as issuer, subject (issuedTo), expiration date, and SHA-256 hash. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_custom_cert201
operations.summary: Add or update custom CA certificate
operations.description: Creates a new custom CA certificate or updates an existing one. The certificate is validated before storage: it must be a valid X.509 CA certificate with Basic Constraints CA flag set to true. After successful operation, an alarm is raised indicating Orchestrator restart is required for changes to take effect. A certificate expiration check job is triggered to verify if certificates are expiring within 60 days.

request_body.description: Custom CA certificate to add or update. Include the PEM-encoded certificate, the appliance sync status and a unique alias. The id is required for update operation.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_custom_cert207
operations.summary: Delete custom CA certificate
operations.description: Permanently removes a custom CA certificate from Orchestrator by its unique ID. After deletion, a restart alarm is raised indicating Orchestrator must be restarted for changes to take effect.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the custom CA certificate to delete. Must be a valid existing certificate ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_custom_certs_get_appliance_connectivity202
operations.summary: Test appliance connectivity to Portal and Orchestrator
operations.description: Initiates an asynchronous connectivity test for all appliances to verify they can connect to Portal and Orchestrator. When custom=true, tests using custom CA certificates; when custom=false, tests using the default trust store. Returns a clientKey poll handle to track the async operation status.

parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: When true, tests connectivity using custom CA certificates. When false, uses the default trust store.

request_body.description: Optional list of custom CA certificates to test. If custom=true and no certs provided, uses certificates stored in database. If custom=false, this body is ignored.

operations.name: edgeconnect_toggle_auto_sync_mode
operations.summary: Enable or disable automatic certificate synchronization from the Cloud Portal
operations.description: Toggles the auto-sync setting for custom CA certificates. When enabled, Orchestrator periodically pulls updated CA certificates from the Cloud Portal. When disabled, certificates must be managed manually.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the autoSync toggle value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ca_certs_from_default_trust_store
operations.summary: Retrieve CA certificates from Portal's default trust store
operations.description: Fetches all CA certificates from the Portal's default trust store (CA bundle). The certificates are validated before being returned - only valid X.509 CA certificates with Basic Constraints CA flag set are included. Invalid or expired certificates are filtered out. Each certificate is assigned an auto-generated alias for easy identification.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_custom_certs_enabled203
operations.summary: Get custom CA certificate trust store status
operations.description: Retrieves the current enabled/disabled status of the custom CA certificate trust store. When enabled, Orchestrator uses custom CA certificates for TLS connections instead of the default trust store. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_custom_certs_enabled204
operations.summary: Enable or disable custom CA certificate trust store
operations.description: Enables or disables the custom CA certificate trust store for Orchestrator. When enabled, Orchestrator uses custom CA certificates for TLS connections. A restart is required for changes to take effect. Raises CUSTOM_CERTS_RESTART_REQUIRED alarm when the setting is changed.

request_body.description: Object containing the enabled flag to enable or disable custom CA certificates.

operations.name: edgeconnect_enable_restart_orchestrator
operations.summary: Flag Orchestrator for restart to apply custom certificate changes
operations.description: Sets the isRestartRequired flag to true in the custom certificate settings. This marks that Orchestrator needs a restart for custom CA trust store changes to take effect. No request body is required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_custom_certs_get_orchestrator_connectivity205
operations.summary: Test Orchestrator connectivity to Portal
operations.description: Tests whether Orchestrator can establish a TLS connection to the Portal service using either custom CA certificates or the default trust store. The test makes a POST request to the Portal's hello endpoint and considers any HTTP status code below 500 as a successful connection.

parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: When true, uses custom CA certificates for the connectivity test. When false, uses the default system trust store.

request_body.description: Optional list of custom CA certificates to use for the connectivity test. If custom=true and certificates are provided, those certificates are used. If custom=true and no certificates are provided, certificates stored in the database are used. If custom=false, this body is ignored.

operations.name: edgeconnect_retrieve_settings
operations.summary: Get custom CA certificate trust store settings
operations.description: Retrieves the current auto-sync and restart-required settings for the custom CA certificate trust store. Returns whether automatic portal certificate synchronization is enabled and whether Orchestrator requires a restart to apply certificate changes.

operations.name: edgeconnect_custom_certs_verification206
operations.summary: Verify and validate a custom CA certificate
operations.description: Validates a PEM-encoded X.509 CA certificate before adding it to Orchestrator. Checks certificate validity, expiration, Basic Constraints CA flag, and EC parameter type. Returns parsed certificate details if valid.

request_body.description: Custom CA certificate to verify. Must contain exactly one PEM-encoded certificate.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_db_partition
operations.summary: Delete a database statistics table partition
operations.description: Permanently removes a specified partition from an Orchestrator statistics database table. This operation executes an ALTER TABLE DROP PARTITION SQL command. The action is logged in the system action log for audit purposes.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Name of the statistics database table containing the partition. Must be a valid table name with alphanumeric characters and underscores only.

parameters.name: partition
parameters.description: Name of the partition to delete. Must be a valid partition name (alphanumeric and underscores). Cannot be 'defaultPartition' as it is required for table integrity.

parameters.name: statsCollector
parameters.description: ID of the external stats collector associated with the partition. Use when deleting partitions from remote/external stats collector databases. If omitted, deletes from local database.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_partitions_info
operations.summary: Get database partition details
