operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_existing_overlay322
operations.summary: Delete an overlay configuration
operations.description: Permanently deletes an overlay configuration from the Orchestrator. This operation removes all appliance associations, cleans up regional configurations, deletes scheduled reports using this overlay, and updates priority mappings. Changes are automatically pushed to affected appliances.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the overlay to delete. Must be a valid existing overlay ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_max_number_of_overlays316
operations.summary: Get maximum overlay limit
operations.description: Retrieves the maximum number of overlays allowed on this Orchestrator. The limit is determined by the AAS license token for cloud deployments, or defaults to the system limit (7) for on-premise installations. Use this endpoint to validate overlay creation capacity before adding new overlays.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_regional_overlay320
operations.summary: Get regional overlay configurations
operations.description: Retrieves regional overlay configurations. When called without parameters, returns all overlays with their regional configurations as a nested map (overlayId → regionId → OverlayConfig). When both overlayId and regionId are provided, returns the specific configuration for that combination. Use regionId=0 to retrieve the global overlay configuration.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the overlay to retrieve. Must be provided together with regionId to fetch a specific regional configuration.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Region identifier for the overlay configuration. Use 0 for global configuration, or a positive integer for regional configurations. Must be provided together with overlayId.

operations.name: edgeconnect_modify_regional_overlay321
operations.summary: Update regional overlay configurations
operations.description: Updates existing regional overlay configurations. Use regionId 0 for global configuration or positive integers for region-specific overrides. Validates custom bonding support and mesh topology licensing before saving. Changes are automatically pushed to associated appliances.

request_body.description: Map of overlayId to regional overlay configurations (regionId → OverlayConfig). Each overlay must have a valid ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_all_regional_overlays318
operations.summary: Create batch regional overlay configurations
operations.description: Creates multiple regional overlay configurations in a single batch operation. Each overlay must include a global configuration (regionId=0) and configurations for all existing regions. The system validates license limits, region IDs, overlay names, and bonding policy support before creating.

request_body.description: Array of regional overlay configurations. Each element maps regionId to OverlayConfig.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_overlay_priority_map325
operations.summary: Get overlay priority order mapping
operations.description: Retrieves the priority order mapping for all configured overlays. The response is a JSON object where each key represents a priority number (1-based, sequential) and the value is the corresponding overlay ID. Lower priority numbers indicate higher precedence for route map evaluation.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_overlay_priority326
operations.summary: Update overlay priority order
operations.description: Updates the priority order of overlay route maps. Priority determines which overlay's rules are evaluated first when traffic matches multiple overlays. Lower priority numbers have higher precedence. Changes trigger orchestration to update all appliances with overlay associations.

request_body.description: Map of priority numbers to overlay IDs. Keys must be sequential integers starting from 1. Each overlay ID can only appear once.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_user_permission
operations.summary: Get user permission level
operations.description: Retrieves the permission level (read-write or read-only) for a specified user. Returns 'rw' for users with 'su' or 'net_read_write' roles, otherwise returns 'r'.

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user whose permission level is being queried. Cannot be null or empty.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_schedule_timezone327
operations.summary: Get the configured timezone for scheduled jobs and reports
operations.description: Retrieves the current timezone configuration used for all scheduled jobs and report generation. If no timezone has been explicitly configured, returns the server's default timezone. Supports ETag-based caching for efficient polling.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_schedule_timezone328
operations.summary: Set the timezone for scheduled jobs and reports
operations.description: Configures the timezone used by Orchestrator for scheduled jobs, reports, and time-based operations. Validated against Java TimeZone IDs (case-insensitive). Changes apply immediately and trigger a system-wide event.

request_body.description: Timezone configuration with a valid Java TimeZone ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_services329
operations.summary: Get all services
operations.description: Retrieves all configured services used in the Overlay editor's Internet Policy section. Each service creates a 'Send to <service name>' option for routing traffic through pass-through tunnels. Users must create pass-through tunnels on appliances before use.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_services330
operations.summary: Save the service list
operations.description: Replaces the entire service list atomically. Services removed from the list are automatically deleted from all overlay internet policies. Each service creates a 'Send to <service name>' option in the Overlay editor.

request_body.description: Map of service IDs to service objects. Keys become unique service identifiers. Only the 'name' property is required per service.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_session_timeout
operations.summary: Get session timeout settings
operations.description: Retrieves current auto-logout timeout and maximum concurrent session settings. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_session_timeout
operations.summary: Update session timeout and concurrent session settings
operations.description: Configures user idle timeout (auto-logout) and maximum concurrent sessions for Orchestrator. Both parameters are required and must be within valid ranges. Changes are audited with user attribution.

request_body.description: Session configuration with autoLogout (1-10080 minutes) and maxSession (5-10000) values. Both fields are required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_approximate_disk_space333
operations.summary: Calculate approximate disk space requirements for statistics storage
operations.description: Calculates the estimated disk space usage (in bytes per minute) for various statistics types based on the number of appliances, tunnels, overlays, and DDoS segments. Disk space estimates are computed using predefined multipliers per stat type.

parameters.name: applianceCount
parameters.description: Number of appliances to calculate disk space for. Used to estimate storage requirements for appliance-based statistics.

parameters.name: numberOfSegments
parameters.description: Number of DDoS segments. Used for DDoS-related statistics (ddospeakandpeakdroprate, ddostotalstats, addosbaseline). Must be between 1 and 24.

parameters.name: numberOfTunnels
parameters.description: Number of tunnels. If not provided, automatically calculated based on existing tunnel configuration and appliance count.

parameters.name: numberOfOverlays
parameters.description: Number of overlays. Used in tunnel calculation when numberOfTunnels is not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_statistics_collection334
operations.summary: Retrieve statistics collection enable/disable status for all stat types
operations.description: Returns the collection status (enabled/disabled) for all statistics types configured in the Orchestrator. Each stat type has an associated boolean indicating whether data collection is active.

operations.name: edgeconnect_enable_disable_sc335
operations.summary: Enable or disable statistics collection for a specific stat type
operations.description: Updates the collection status for a specific statistics type. When disabled, the Orchestrator stops collecting the specified type of statistics. Not available in Container Mode.

parameters.name: statType
parameters.description: The statistics type to enable or disable collection for. Must match an existing stat type in the system.

parameters.name: isEnabled
parameters.description: Set to true to enable statistics collection, false to disable it.

operations.name: edgeconnect_statistics_retention336
operations.summary: Retrieve retention settings for non-statistics tables
operations.description: Returns data retention and partition duration settings for all non-statistics tables (e.g., actionlog). Uses custom retention if set, otherwise falls back to default retention.

operations.name: edgeconnect_statistics_retention_update337
operations.summary: Update retention settings for a non-statistics table
operations.description: Updates the data retention period and partition duration for a specific non-statistics table type (e.g., actionlog). The retention value determines how long data is kept, and partitionDuration controls database partition sizing.

parameters.name: statType
parameters.description: The non-statistics table type to update retention for. Must match an existing table name in nonStatsTableRetention.

request_body.description: Retention configuration containing the retention period and partition duration in seconds.

operations.name: edgeconnect_statistics_retention338
operations.summary: Retrieve statistics retention settings for all stat types
operations.description: Returns retention settings for all statistics types at different granularity levels (minute, hour, day, month). Each stat type contains an array of retention configurations per granularity. Response is filtered based on AVC mode: 'application' is excluded in mixed/all mode, 'flowapp' is excluded in none mode.

operations.name: edgeconnect_statistics_retention_update339
operations.summary: Update statistics retention period for a specific stat type
operations.description: Updates the data retention period for a specific statistics type at different granularity levels (minute, hour, day). Each granularity level can have its own retention period. Not available in Container Mode.

parameters.name: statType
parameters.description: The statistics type to update retention for. Must match an existing stat type in the system.

request_body.description: Array of retention configurations for different granularity levels. Each entry specifies retention period for a specific granularity.

operations.name: edgeconnect_stats_retention_notification_info_get340
operations.summary: Retrieve stats retention notification dismissal status
operations.description: Returns the current stats retention notification configuration, indicating whether a user has dismissed the notification. Returns an empty object if no configuration has been set yet.

operations.name: edgeconnect_stats_retention_notification_info_post341
operations.summary: Update stats retention notification dismissal status
operations.description: Creates or updates the stats retention notification configuration. Used to dismiss or re-enable the notification banner. Requires READ_WRITE role. Logs the action to the system audit log.

request_body.description: Notification configuration with dismissal status and username.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_stats_collection
operations.summary: Get statistics collection configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current statistics collection enable/disable settings for all stat types. Returns the stored configuration or defaults (all enabled) if no configuration exists.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_stats_collection
operations.summary: Update statistics collection configuration
operations.description: Updates which statistics types are collected by the Orchestrator. Changes are persisted to the database and logged to the system action log for audit tracking. Only saves if configuration differs from current settings (optimistic locking).

request_body.description: JSON object with boolean flags to enable/disable collection for each statistics type. All properties are optional; unspecified properties default to true.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_default_stats_collection
operations.summary: Get default statistics collection configuration
operations.description: Returns the factory default statistics collection settings. All 17 statistic types are enabled (true) by default. Use this endpoint to retrieve baseline configuration values for comparison or reset operations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_third_party_services345
operations.summary: Get all third party services
operations.description: Retrieves all third party cloud services for the Overlay editor's Internet Policy section. Built-in services (Zscaler, Netskope, HPE SSE/Axis) have their 'enabled' status dynamically determined by subscription status. Custom services default to enabled=false if not explicitly set.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_default_topology_config346
operations.summary: Retrieve topology view configuration for the authenticated user
operations.description: Returns the topology map display configuration for the currently authenticated user. The configuration includes background map image, zoom level, pan positions, and overlay selection preferences. If no user-specific configuration exists, returns the default configuration with the user's key. The map image is always inherited from the default configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_topology_config347
operations.summary: Save topology view configuration for the authenticated user
operations.description: Saves the topology map display configuration for the currently authenticated user. The username is automatically extracted from the authentication context. The image property is automatically removed from user-specific configurations since map images are managed globally via /gms/topologyConfig/map. Creates a new configuration if none exists, otherwise updates the existing one.

request_body.description: Topology view configuration object keyed by context name (e.g. 'admin'). Each value contains map display preferences including zoom levels, pan positions, and overlay selection.

operations.name: edgeconnect_export_topology_info_for_tunnel_type352
operations.summary: Export topology tunnel details as CSV file
operations.description: Exports tunnel topology information for specified appliance(s) and tunnel type as a downloadable CSV file. The CSV contains source and destination appliance details, interface configurations, tunnel identifiers, HA peer mappings, and administrative states. Use 'all' for nePk to export all appliances.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: tunnelType
parameters.description: Type of tunnel to export. Controls which tunnel category is included in the CSV output.

operations.name: edgeconnect_export_topology_info348
operations.summary: Export all tunnel topology for multiple appliances as CSV
operations.description: Exports comprehensive tunnel topology information including overlay (bonded), underlay (physical), and passthrough tunnels for the specified appliance nePks as a downloadable CSV file. The CSV includes source/destination appliance details, interface configurations, tunnel identifiers, HA peer mappings, and administrative states. If an empty nePks array is provided, topology for all appliances is exported.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the nePks array. The nePks field is required. Pass an empty array to export topology for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_export_overlay_topology_info349
operations.summary: Export overlay (bonded) tunnel topology as CSV
operations.description: Exports bonded tunnel topology information for specified appliance nePks as a downloadable CSV file. Bonded tunnels aggregate multiple physical underlay tunnels into a single logical connection. The CSV includes source/destination appliance details, tunnel identifiers (tunnelId-A, tunnelId-Z), overlay ID (tunnelSubTypeId), tunnel alias names, HA peer mappings, administrative states, and supporting physical tunnel IDs. Interface-specific fields (Intfc, intfcLabel, intfcIP, edgeHAInterface) are 'n/a' for overlay tunnels since they operate at the logical layer above physical interfaces.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the nePks array. The nePks field is required. Pass an empty array to export overlay topology for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_export_passthrough_topology_info350
operations.summary: Export passthrough tunnel topology as CSV
operations.description: Exports passthrough tunnel topology information for specified appliance nePks as a downloadable CSV file. Passthrough tunnels route traffic through third-party endpoints or services. Two subtypes exist: 'genericPT' for generic passthrough tunnels and 'serviceTunnel' for third-party service tunnels (identified by 'ThirdParty_' prefix in alias). The CSV includes source appliance details, WAN interface information (name, label, IP, HA status), tunnel identifiers, tunnel mode, administrative state, and the WAN next hop IP as tunnelSubTypeId. Destination appliance fields (tunnelId-Z, tunnelName-Z, intfcIP-Z, intfcLabel-Z, Intfc-Z, edgeHAInterface-Z) are not populated for passthrough tunnels as they terminate at external endpoints.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the nePks array. The nePks field is required. Pass an empty array to export passthrough topology for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_export_underlay_topology_info351
operations.summary: Export underlay (physical) tunnel topology as CSV
operations.description: Exports physical tunnel topology information for specified appliance nePks as a downloadable CSV file. Physical (underlay) tunnels are point-to-point connections over WAN interfaces that form the foundation for overlay (bonded) tunnels. The CSV includes source/destination appliance details (hostname, site, nePk), HA peer mappings, WAN interface information (name, label, IP, HA status), tunnel identifiers (tunnelId-A, tunnelId-Z), tunnel alias names, administrative state, tunnel mode, and the overlay tunnel IDs that this physical tunnel supports (supportedTunnel). Fields tunnelSubType and tunnelSubTypeId are 'n/a' for underlay tunnels as these apply only to overlay and passthrough types.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the nePks array. The nePks field is required. Pass an empty array to export underlay topology for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_link_info_for_overlay_id
operations.summary: Get tunnel link status matrix for an overlay network
operations.description: Returns a symmetric 2D matrix representing tunnel link status between all appliances in the specified overlay. Each cell [i][j] contains the worst-case status between bidirectional tunnels (src→dst and dst→src). If appliance count exceeds APPLIANCE_TOPOLOGY_LINK_THRESHOLD, the linkInfo array is not populated (null). Supports ETag-based caching - provide If-None-Match header with previous ETag to receive 304 if data unchanged.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the overlay network to query. Cannot be null or empty.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from previous response for conditional caching. If provided and cache is valid, returns 304.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_link_info_for_overlay_id_v2
operations.summary: Get sparse tunnel link status pairs for an overlay network (v2)
operations.description: Returns tunnel link status as sparse array-of-pairs grouped by status, replacing the dense N×N matrix from v1. The response contains linkInfo[status] = [[srcIndex, destIndex], ...] where each [srcIndex, destIndex] pair references indices into the nePks array. Status codes: 0=NO_TUNNEL, 1=UP, 2=PARTIALLY_DOWN, 3=DOWN, 4=NO_STATUS. Payload size is O(T) where T is the number of tunnel connections, compared to O(N²) in v1. No appliance count threshold — works at any scale. Supports ETag-based caching.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Overlay network identifier. Use 'all' for worst-case status across all overlays, '0' for underlays, or a specific overlay ID (e.g. '1', '2').

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from previous response for conditional caching. If provided and cache is valid, returns 304.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_map_image354
operations.summary: Update the global topology background map image
operations.description: Updates the background map image used in all topology views across the Orchestrator. This is a global setting stored in the default configuration - individual user configurations inherit this value automatically. Only the image filename is required; it must reference a valid map image file. Requires READ_WRITE role.

request_body.description: JSON object with 'default' key containing map image settings. The 'default' key is required and must contain an 'image' field with a non-empty filename.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_gms_tree_config
operations.summary: Get tree view display configuration for the current user
operations.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's tree view display preferences including sorting, grouping, visibility of IP addresses, platform icons, and counts. Returns an empty object if no configuration has been saved.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_gms_tree_config
operations.summary: Create or update tree view display configuration for the current user
operations.description: Saves the authenticated user's tree view display preferences. The request body must be a JSON object with a single key matching the current username. Creates a new config or updates the existing one. This action is audit-logged.

request_body.description: Map with a single entry keyed by the current username. The value is a TreeConfigData object with display preferences. Exactly one entry is allowed and the key must match the authenticated user.

operations.name: edgeconnect_version_info357
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator Version Information
operations.description: Retrieves the current running orchestrator version and a list of all installed software versions available on the system. Installed versions are discovered by scanning directories in /home/gms matching pattern gms.X.X.X.X.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azureti_cidr791
operations.summary: Get VTI Subnet and Mask for the Azure Subnet Global Pool
operations.description: Retrieves the current VTI IP Pool settings including the subnet IP address and mask used for Azure vWAN VPN tunnel interface allocation.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_azure_vti_cidr791
operations.summary: Configure VTI IP Pool Subnet for Azure vWAN Tunnel Interfaces
operations.description: Creates or updates the global VTI (Virtual Tunnel Interface) IP Pool configuration used for Azure vWAN VPN tunnel interface subnet allocation. The subnet pool provides IP addresses for tunnel endpoints. Clears any existing VTI IP Pool configuration alarms upon successful save.

request_body.description: VTI IP Pool configuration with subnet IP address and CIDR mask. Both fields are required and must form a valid network address.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_gms_wizard358
operations.summary: Retrieve the Getting Started Wizard configuration
operations.description: Returns the current Getting Started Wizard configuration settings. This endpoint retrieves the wizard auto-open preference stored in the Orchestrator configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_gms_wizard359
operations.summary: Create or update Getting Started Wizard configuration
operations.description: Performs an upsert operation on the wizard configuration. Creates a new configuration if none exists, or updates the existing one. Action is logged to the system action log for audit purposes.

request_body.description: Wizard configuration object. Must not be null.

operations.name: edgeconnect_hostname_by_get360
operations.summary: Get the hostname of the Orchestrator
operations.description: Retrieves the hostname or domain name of the Orchestrator server. In container deployments, returns the registered domain name; otherwise returns the system hostname.

operations.name: edgeconnect_license_by_get361
operations.summary: Get current license key and information
operations.description: Retrieves current Orchestrator license information including key, serial number, appliance limits, and expiration details. Supports traditional license keys, portal-based licensing (ECSP/metered), and physical appliance default licenses. The license may be sourced from the stored license key file or portal-based licensing depending on account type.

operations.name: edgeconnect_license_by_put362
operations.summary: Apply a new Orchestrator license key
operations.description: Applies and validates a new license key to the Orchestrator. The encrypted key is decrypted to extract serial number, max appliances, and optional expiration date. For physical appliances, the key's serial number must match the server's MAC address. Virtual appliances accept any valid key and adopt its serial number. The action is logged to the system action log. License key format after decryption: SERIAL#MAX_APPLIANCES[#EXPIRATION_DATE].

request_body.description: JSON object containing the encrypted license key to apply

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aas_token_display
operations.summary: Retrieve AAS license feature display metadata
operations.description: Returns AAS (Aruba Activation Server) license feature display metadata from the gmsconfig database. This data is provided by Portal and stored locally during the AAS token polling process. The display map contains UI-friendly information about licensed features including names, descriptions, enable status, and token identifiers. Data is stored unencrypted at /orchToken/display path.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aas_token_stats
operations.summary: Retrieve AAS licensing runtime statistics
operations.description: Returns in-memory AAS (Aruba Activation Server) licensing runtime statistics. The stats include the license tier, expiration timestamp, and polling status/schedule. Stats are updated after each poll to Portal (default every 24 hours, or 5 minutes on retry after failure).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aas_token_usage
operations.summary: Get AAS license feature usage and limits
operations.description: Retrieves current usage versus licensed limit for each AAS (Aruba Activation Server) enforced feature. Before returning data, performs a license compliance check to ensure usage data is current. The response maps feature token keys to their usage details. Features tracked include: overlays, regions, hubs per region, routing segments (VRF), QoS policies, AppExpress, topology types, and secondary accounts.

operations.name: edgeconnect_validate_aas_feature
operations.summary: Validate feature requests against AAS license limits
operations.description: Pre-validates whether requested feature values would exceed AAS (Aruba Activation Server) license or system limits. For additive features (overlay, region, vrf, secondaryAccount), the requested value is added to current usage before checking the limit. For non-additive features (topologyMesh, qos, appExpress), the requested value is checked directly against the limit. Feature keys are automatically suffixed with 'Limit' internally (e.g., 'overlay' → 'overlayLimit'). Returns empty message if within limit, or descriptive error if exceeded.

request_body.description: Map of feature keys to their requested values. Keys should NOT include 'Limit' suffix - it is appended automatically.

operations.name: edgeconnect_validate_aas_feature_hub
operations.summary: Validate hub configurations against AAS license limits
operations.description: Pre-validates proposed hub-to-region configurations against the AAS license limit for logical hubs per region. Hubs with the same site name within a region count as a single logical hub. Hubs without site names count individually. The Default region (regionId=0) has no limit enforcement. Network roles 1 (HUB) and 3 (NRHUB) are counted as hubs.

request_body.description: Map of appliance identifiers to proposed hub configurations. Keys can be nePk or discoveredId. Missing fields inherit current appliance configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_validate_key363
operations.summary: Validate an encrypted license key without applying it
operations.description: Pre-validates a license key before applying via POST /gmsLicense. Decrypts and checks: (1) key format validity - must decrypt to SERIAL#MAX[#DATE], (2) serial number format - six hex pairs in XX-XX-XX-XX-XX-XX format, (3) max appliances is numeric, (4) for physical appliances only - serial number matches server MAC address. Virtual appliances accept any valid key. Does not check expiration date.

parameters.name: licenseKey
parameters.description: Encrypted license key string to validate. The key is decrypted to extract serial number, max appliances, and optional expiration date in format: SERIAL#MAX[#DATE].

operations.name: edgeconnect_os_info364
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator Operating System Type
operations.description: Returns the operating system type where the Orchestrator is running. The OS is detected using the Java 'os.name' system property.

operations.name: edgeconnect_disk_space_info_get365
operations.summary: Get Disk Space Full Notification Status
operations.description: Retrieves the current disk space notification status for the Orchestrator. Returns whether the disk is over 90% full and the dismissal state of the warning notification. The system automatically monitors disk usage and sets this flag when /home partition exceeds 90% capacity.

operations.name: edgeconnect_disk_space_info_put366
operations.summary: Dismiss Disk Space Warning Notification
operations.description: Updates the disk space warning notification dismissal state. Used to acknowledge disk full warnings in the UI. Creates a new config entry if none exists, or updates the existing one.

request_body.description: Disk space notification configuration to update

operations.name: edgeconnect_root_password_info_get367
operations.summary: Get Root Password Changed Status
operations.description: Retrieves the root password changed notification flag status from the Orchestrator database. Returns whether the default root password has been changed for security compliance tracking.

operations.name: edgeconnect_root_password_info_post368
operations.summary: Update Root Password Changed Status
operations.description: Updates the root password changed notification flag in the Orchestrator database. Creates a new configuration entry if none exists, or updates the existing one. Logs the action for audit purposes.

request_body.description: Root password status configuration to save

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_get_full369
operations.summary: Get all remote authentication server configurations
operations.description: Retrieves all configured external authentication servers including RADIUS, TACACS+, OAuth 2.0, JWT, and SAML. Returns configuration details for each protocol type. Sensitive data (secret keys, client secrets, certificates) are masked with empty strings for security. Only protocols that have been configured will appear in the response with their data; unconfigured protocols may be omitted or return empty objects.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_get_all_jwt370
operations.summary: Retrieve JWT authentication configurations
operations.description: Retrieves JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication configurations for SSO integration. Returns all configurations when no ID is specified, or a specific configuration when ID is provided. Sensitive data (certificates and client secrets) are masked in the response for security.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for a specific JWT configuration in the gmsConfig table. If omitted, returns all JWT configurations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_update_one_jwt374
operations.summary: Update JWT authentication configuration
operations.description: Updates an existing JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication configuration. The configuration is identified by ID (not name). If cert is omitted, the existing certificate is preserved. Either the existing cert or a new cert/jwkUrl must be valid.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the JWT configuration to update in the gmsConfig table.

request_body.description: JWT configuration object with updated values. Required fields: name, issuer, auditor, userNameKey.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_post_jwt371
operations.summary: Create JWT authentication configuration
operations.description: Creates a new JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication configuration for SSO integration. Either a signing certificate (cert) or JWK URL (jwkUrl) must be provided for token signature verification. Configuration names must be unique across the system.

request_body.description: JWT configuration object. Either cert or jwkUrl must be provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_delete_jwt_config
operations.summary: Delete JWT authentication configuration
operations.description: Permanently removes a JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication configuration from the system. This action cannot be undone. Users authenticated via this JWT configuration will no longer be able to log in using SSO after deletion.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the JWT configuration to delete. Must reference an existing configuration in the gmsConfig table.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_get_all_oauth375
operations.summary: Retrieve OAuth server configurations
operations.description: Returns OAuth server configurations. If no id is provided, returns all configured OAuth servers. If id is specified, returns only that OAuth server's configuration. Client secrets are never returned for security.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: OAuth server ID to retrieve a specific configuration. If omitted, returns all OAuth server configurations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_update_one_oauth379
operations.summary: Update an existing OAuth server configuration
operations.description: Updates an OAuth 2.0 server configuration identified by its ID. The client secret is optional; if not provided, the existing secret is preserved. The server name must be alphanumeric and the 'openid' scope is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the OAuth server configuration to update. Must reference an existing OAuth server.

request_body.description: OAuth server configuration object with updated values. Client secret is optional for updates.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_post_oauth376
operations.summary: Create a new OAuth server configuration
operations.description: Creates a new OAuth 2.0 server configuration for remote authentication. The server name must be unique and alphanumeric. The 'openid' scope is required and automatically validated.

request_body.description: OAuth server configuration object containing connection and authentication details.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_delete_one_oauth377
operations.summary: Delete an OAuth server configuration
operations.description: Permanently removes an OAuth server configuration identified by its ID. This operation cannot be undone and will affect users relying on this OAuth provider for authentication.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the OAuth server configuration to delete. Must reference an existing OAuth server.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_get_radius381
operations.summary: Retrieve RADIUS authentication server configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current RADIUS (Remote Authentication Dial-In User Service) server configuration. Secret keys are redacted in the response for security. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_post_radius382
operations.summary: Create or update RADIUS authentication server configuration
operations.description: Creates a new or updates an existing RADIUS (Remote Authentication Dial-In User Service) server configuration. If updating, only non-empty secret keys will overwrite existing values. Requires READ_WRITE permission. The operation is logged in the system action log.

request_body.description: RADIUS server configuration object with primary server settings required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_delete_radius380
operations.summary: Delete RADIUS server configuration
operations.description: Removes the RADIUS (Remote Authentication Dial-In User Service) server configuration from the Orchestrator. This action disables RADIUS-based authentication for user login. Requires READ_WRITE permission. The operation is logged in the system action log.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_get_all_saml_config383
operations.summary: Retrieve SAML server configurations
operations.description: Returns SAML server configurations. When called without an ID, returns all configured SAML servers. When called with a specific ID, returns only that server's configuration. Sensitive certificate data (idpX509cert, spX509cert) is redacted from the response.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: SAML server identifier. If omitted, all SAML configurations are returned. If provided, only the matching configuration is returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_update_saml_config387
operations.summary: Update SAML server configuration
operations.description: Updates an existing SAML identity provider configuration by ID. The server name must be unique and alphanumeric. If idpX509cert is not provided in the request, the existing certificate is retained.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the SAML server configuration to update. Must reference an existing SAML server.

request_body.description: SAML server configuration object with updated IdP and SP settings

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_post_saml384
operations.summary: Create a new SAML server configuration
operations.description: Creates a new SAML identity provider configuration for SSO authentication. The server name must be unique and alphanumeric. Required fields include IdP metadata and X.509 certificate.

request_body.description: SAML server configuration object containing IdP and SP settings

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_delete_saml_config385
operations.summary: Delete a SAML server configuration
operations.description: Permanently removes a SAML identity provider configuration by ID. This action disables SSO authentication for users who rely on this SAML server. The deletion is logged in the system action log.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the SAML server configuration to delete. Must reference an existing SAML server.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_get_tacacs389
operations.summary: Retrieve TACACS+ remote authentication server configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current TACACS+ (Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus) server configuration for remote authentication. Returns server connection details with secret keys masked for security. No query parameters required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_post_tacacs390
operations.summary: Create or update TACACS+ remote authentication server configuration
operations.description: Creates a new or updates an existing TACACS+ (Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus) server configuration for remote authentication. If no configuration exists, a new one is created; otherwise, the existing configuration is updated. The action is logged in the system action log.

request_body.description: TACACS+ server configuration object containing primary server details and optional secondary server for failover.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_delete_tacacs388
operations.summary: Delete TACACS+ server configuration
operations.description: Removes the TACACS+ (Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus) remote authentication server configuration from the Orchestrator. This operation deletes the configuration entry from the database and logs the action. No request body or query parameters are required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_remote_auth_get_light391
operations.summary: Get available remote authentication types
operations.description: Retrieves all configured remote authentication types (RADIUS, TACACS+, OAuth, SAML) with minimal configuration details. This endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication and is designed to populate login screen options. Sensitive fields are excluded from the response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_smtp393
operations.summary: Get SMTP email server configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) server configuration used for sending email notifications and alerts. The password field is always null in the response for security. Returns an empty object if no SMTP server has been configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_smtp_post394
operations.summary: Configure SMTP email server settings
operations.description: Creates or updates the SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) server configuration for sending email notifications and alerts. Not available for Cloud Orchestrator deployments.

request_body.description: SMTP server configuration object containing mail server address, authentication credentials, and connection settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_del_unverified_emails395
operations.summary: Delete unverified email addresses
operations.description: Removes unverified email addresses from the email verification queue. Only emails that have not been verified (verified=false) will be deleted. Use this to clean up pending verification requests or remove invalid email addresses.

request_body.description: Array of email addresses to delete from the unverified emails list.

operations.name: edgeconnect_send_verification_email396
operations.summary: Resend verification email to an unverified email address
operations.description: Resends a verification email to an address that exists in the unverified emails list. The email contains a unique verification link that the recipient must click to verify their email address for Orchestrator notifications.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Email address to send verification to. Must already exist in the unverified emails list.

operations.name: edgeconnect_smtp_test_mail397
operations.summary: Send test email to verify SMTP configuration
operations.description: Sends a test email to the specified recipient(s) to verify SMTP server configuration is working correctly. The test email confirms email delivery with a predefined subject and body. If password is omitted but authentication is enabled, the stored SMTP password will be used only if the submitted server, port, and user match the existing configuration. If they do not match, the request is rejected with 400.

request_body.description: Test email configuration containing recipient address and SMTP server settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_list_unverified_emails398
operations.summary: List unverified email addresses
operations.description: Retrieves all email addresses pending verification from the database. These are addresses that have been added for notifications but have not yet clicked the verification link. Returns only email strings, not full verification records.

operations.name: edgeconnect_verify_email_address399
operations.summary: Verify an email address using verification link
operations.description: Verifies an email address using the unique verification link sent to the user's inbox. Upon successful verification, any queued/blocked notification emails are automatically sent. This endpoint is publicly accessible (no authentication required) as it is accessed directly from email links.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique secure random string from the verification email link. This token identifies the pending email verification record.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_brief_info400
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator Server Brief Information
operations.description: Retrieves essential runtime information about the Orchestrator server including uptime, software release version, current time with timezone, and operational modes. Supports ETag-based caching for efficient polling.

operations.name: edgeconnect_hello401
operations.summary: Get Server Instance UUID
operations.description: Returns a unique identifier (UUID) for the current Orchestrator server instance. The UUID is generated once at server startup and remains constant until the server restarts. Useful for detecting server reboots or failover events.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_server_info402
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator Server Detailed Information
operations.description: Retrieves comprehensive system information about the Orchestrator server including hardware specs, disk usage, memory, CPU count, network identity, and portal registration details. Response varies based on deployment mode (container vs standalone).

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_ping_info403
operations.summary: Ping Orchestrator Server Health Check
operations.description: Returns Orchestrator server health status including hostname, uptime, version, database connectivity, and current time. This endpoint does not require authentication and is commonly used for monitoring, load balancer health checks, and HA failover detection.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_groups_get
operations.summary: Retrieve all HA groups
operations.description: Returns all configured High Availability (HA) groups. Each HA group contains a pair of appliances configured for redundancy with associated network settings for synchronization. Response is a map with group IDs as keys.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_groups_post
operations.summary: Save or update HA groups configuration
operations.description: Creates or updates the complete High Availability (HA) groups configuration. This is a replace operation - the entire HA groups configuration will be overwritten with the provided data. Each HA group pairs two appliances for redundancy and failover. Validation rules: (1) Each group requires exactly 2 appliances, (2) Each appliance must have valid haSyncInfo, (3) An appliance cannot appear in multiple groups, (4) The subnet/mask must provide at least 32 subnets for HA interfaces. Both appliances must be in inline-router mode. Actions are logged to the system audit trail.

request_body.description: Map of HA groups to create or update. Keys are numeric group IDs as strings (starting from '0'). This operation replaces the entire HA groups configuration - include all groups to preserve existing ones.

operations.name: edgeconnect_health_summary406
operations.summary: Get health summary for appliances over a time range
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated health summary for specified appliances over a time range. Returns hourly health status data including alarm states, loss, latency, jitter, MOS, and bandwidth utilization metrics. Response keys are appliance IDs mapping to arrays of hourly health entries.

request_body.description: Health fetch parameters specifying time range, appliances, overlay, and health metrics to retrieve

operations.name: edgeconnect_appliance_alarm_summary407
operations.summary: Get alarm summary for an appliance within a time period
operations.description: Retrieves a summary of alarms for a specific appliance within a time range. Returns the most recent alarm of each severity level (critical, major, minor, warning) along with counts of all alarms by severity. Both active and closed alarms that fall within the time range are included.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start time in milliseconds since EPOCH. Defines the beginning of the time range for alarm queries.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End time in milliseconds since EPOCH. Defines the end of the time range for alarm queries.

parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the appliance (network element primary key). Used to filter alarms for a specific appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_health_threshold_config_get408
operations.summary: Retrieve health threshold configuration settings
operations.description: Returns the current health threshold configuration used to determine health status levels for network metrics. Thresholds define boundaries between healthy (good), warning (ok), and critical states for bandwidth utilization, packet loss, latency, jitter, and MOS. Also includes alarm severity toggles.

operations.name: edgeconnect_health_threshold_config_post409
operations.summary: Update health threshold configuration
operations.description: Creates or updates the health threshold configuration used to determine health status levels for network metrics. Thresholds define boundaries between healthy, warning, and critical states. Unknown properties in the request body are ignored.

request_body.description: Health threshold configuration object containing threshold settings for all network metrics and alarm severity toggles.

operations.name: edgeconnect_jitter_period_summary410
operations.summary: Get jitter health summary for an appliance at a specific time
operations.description: Retrieves jitter metrics summary for a specific appliance at a given hour boundary. Returns the tunnel with worst jitter performance, including minutes spent in each health state and maximum jitter value. Data is aggregated from tunnel health statistics.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Hour boundary timestamp in seconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp). Defines which hourly period to retrieve jitter data for.

parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the appliance (network element primary key). Cannot be empty.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Overlay network identifier to filter results. Use -1 to include all overlays (excludes underlay with overlayId=0).

operations.name: edgeconnect_latency_period_summary411
operations.summary: Get latency health summary for an appliance at a specific time
operations.description: Retrieves latency metrics summary for a specific appliance at a given hour boundary. Returns the tunnel with worst latency performance, including minutes spent in each health state and maximum latency value. Data is aggregated from tunnel health statistics.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Hour boundary timestamp in seconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp). Defines which hourly period to retrieve latency data for.

parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the appliance (network element primary key). Cannot be empty.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Overlay network identifier to filter results. Use -1 to include all overlays (excludes underlay with overlayId=0).

operations.name: edgeconnect_loss_period_summary412
operations.summary: Get packet loss health summary for an appliance at a specific time
operations.description: Retrieves packet loss metrics summary for a specific appliance at a given hour boundary. Returns the tunnel with worst loss performance, including minutes spent in each health state and maximum loss percentage. Data is aggregated from tunnel health statistics.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Hour boundary timestamp in seconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp). Defines which hourly period to retrieve loss data for.

parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the appliance (network element primary key). Cannot be empty.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Overlay network identifier to filter results. Use -1 to include all overlays (excludes underlay with overlayId=0).

operations.name: edgeconnect_mos_period_summary413
operations.summary: Get MOS health summary for an appliance at a specific time
operations.description: Retrieves Mean Opinion Score (MOS) metrics summary for a specific appliance at a given hour boundary. Returns the tunnel with worst MOS performance, including minutes spent in each health state. MOS measures voice quality on a scale of 1-5, where lower values indicate worse quality.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Hour boundary timestamp in seconds since EPOCH (Unix timestamp). Defines which hourly period to retrieve MOS data for.

parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the appliance (network element primary key). Cannot be empty.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Overlay network identifier to filter results. Use -1 to include all overlays (excludes underlay with overlayId=0).

operations.name: edgeconnect_apply_hostname414
operations.summary: Change appliance hostname
operations.description: Changes the hostname of a managed EdgeConnect appliance. The operation retrieves the current hostname, applies the new hostname to the appliance, and waits for the change to complete. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: JSON object containing the new hostname to apply to the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_https_certificate
operations.summary: Retrieve the HTTPS certificate configuration from an appliance
operations.description: Returns the HTTPS certificate details for the specified appliance. Supports both cached and live data retrieval modes.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data retrieval source. When 'true', returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When 'false', fetches live data directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idle_time415
operations.summary: Clear idle time
operations.description: Resets the user's session idle timer to prevent automatic logout. Clears the auto-logout counter and idle start time for the authenticated user.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idle_time416
operations.summary: Increment session idle counter
operations.description: Increments the user's session idle counter and checks if the session is approaching automatic logout threshold. Used by clients to track user inactivity and trigger timeout warnings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_auto_update_get
operations.summary: Retrieve IDPS auto signature update state
operations.description: Returns the current state of automatic IDPS signature updates. When enabled ('on'), signatures are automatically downloaded and updated from the portal. Default value is 'on' if not previously configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_auto_update_put
operations.summary: Update IDPS auto signature update state
operations.description: Enables or disables automatic IDPS signature updates from the portal. Input is case-insensitive; value is stored as lowercase internally. Response echoes the submitted value with original case.

request_body.description: IDPS auto signature update state configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_config_get
operations.summary: Retrieve IDS/IPS global configuration
operations.description: Returns the global IDPS configuration including signature download schedule, auto-update settings, supported appliances list, and IDS version mappings for each appliance. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_config_put
operations.summary: Update IDS/IPS global configuration schedule
operations.description:
Updates the IDS/IPS global configuration schedule for signature downloads. The schedule field is required and determines when automatic signature downloads occur. After updating, the system reschedules the signature download jobs accordingly.

**Schedule Types:**
- **Minutes**: Every X minutes starting at effectiveTime
- **Hourly**: Every X hours starting at effectiveTime
- **Daily**: Every day or weekday at specified time
- **Weekly**: Specific days of the week (1=Sun to 7=Sat)
- **Monthly**: Various patterns (first/last day, specific day, or ranked weekday)
- **Yearly**: Specific date or ranked weekday of a month
- **Run Now**: Immediate one-time execution

request_body.description: IDS/IPS schedule configuration object. The schedule field is required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_profile_state_get
operations.summary: Get IDS/IPS profile-to-appliance assignments
operations.description: Retrieves the mapping of IDS/IPS signature profiles to their assigned appliances. Each profile name maps to an array of appliance identifiers (nePks) that have that profile enabled. Default profiles (Default, Default_S5) are always present.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_profile_state_put
operations.summary: Update IDS/IPS profile-to-appliance assignments
operations.description: Updates the mapping of IDS/IPS signature profiles to appliances. Appliances in the request are removed from their current profiles and assigned to the specified profiles. Each appliance can only be assigned to one profile at a time; duplicate nePks across profiles are rejected.

request_body.description: Map of IDS/IPS signature profile names to arrays of appliance identifiers (nePks) to assign to each profile.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_reserved_signatures_get
operations.summary: Get IDPS reserved signatures
operations.description: Retrieves a list of reserved IDS/IPS signatures filtered by signature family. Reserved signatures (active=2) are pre-loaded signature sets available for deployment to appliances.

parameters.name: signature_family
parameters.description: The signature family version to filter reserved signatures. Determines which generation of signatures to retrieve.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_signatures_get
operations.summary: Retrieve all IDS/IPS signatures
operations.description: Returns a list of all available IDS/IPS signatures excluding reserved signatures (active != 2). Use to fetch signature metadata for configuration and monitoring purposes.

parameters.name: signature_family
parameters.description: Filter signatures by family version. If omitted, returns all signatures across all families.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_signatures_diff_get
operations.summary: Get IDS/IPS signature difference between two versions
operations.description: Compares two IDS/IPS signature versions and returns the differences categorized as Added, Modified, or Deleted rules. Useful for tracking signature updates and understanding security rule changes between releases.

parameters.name: sigVersion1
parameters.description: First signature version for comparison (e.g., '2.0.0.1'). Represents the baseline version.

parameters.name: sigVersion2
parameters.description: Second signature version for comparison (e.g., '2.0.0.2'). Represents the target version to compare against.

parameters.name: signatureFamily
parameters.description: Signature family to filter results. Defaults to '4.x' if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_signatures_profiles_get
operations.summary: Retrieve IDS/IPS signature profiles
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all IDS/IPS signature profiles configured in the system. Profiles define rule actions (allow, drop, inspect) for intrusion detection signatures. Supports filtering by signature family version.

parameters.name: signature_family
parameters.description: Filter profiles by signature family version. When specified, only profiles matching this family are returned. If omitted, all profiles are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_signatures_profiles_post
operations.summary: Create or update IDS/IPS signature profiles
operations.description: Bulk create, update, or delete IDS/IPS signature profiles. Profiles define rule actions (allow, drop, inspect) for intrusion detection signatures. Default profiles ('Default', 'Default_S5') cannot be removed or edited.

request_body.description: Array of signature profiles to create or update. Must include all existing profiles to preserve them.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_signatures_rules_get
operations.summary: Retrieve IDPS signature rules
operations.description: Retrieves a list of IDS/IPS signature rules based on optional filter criteria. Returns active signature rules that can be filtered by various attributes including class type, severity, action type, and signature profile.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Text filter applied to signature rules. Converted to lowercase for case-insensitive matching.

parameters.name: classtype
parameters.description: Filter rules by classification type. Use 'All' to include all class types.

parameters.name: signatureAction
parameters.description: Filter by signature action type. When not 'all', rules are filtered based on the specified profile's action configuration. Valid values: 'all', 'drop', 'inspect', or custom profile actions.

parameters.name: signature_family
parameters.description: The signature family version to filter rules. Defaults to '4.x' if not specified.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Filter rules by severity level (e.g., 'high', 'medium', 'low').

parameters.name: affected_products
parameters.description: Filter rules by affected products or platforms.

parameters.name: rule_category
parameters.description: Filter rules by category classification.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Signature profile name to use for action filtering. Must match 'Default' or 'Default_S[digit]' pattern for default profiles, and must correspond to the signature_family parameter.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_state_get
operations.summary: Retrieve IDS/IPS state for all appliances
operations.description: Returns the current IDS/IPS mode assignment for all configured appliances. Each appliance is categorized into one of four modes: disabled, IDS (detection only), IPS lookaside (passive prevention), or IPS inline (active prevention). Returns empty arrays if no configuration exists.

operations.name: edgeconnect_idps_state_put
operations.summary: Update IDS/IPS mode for appliances
operations.description: Updates the IDS/IPS operational mode for specified appliances. Each appliance can be assigned to one of four modes: disabled, IDS (detection only), IPS lookaside (passive), or IPS inline (active). The nePks array must contain the exact union of all mode arrays. Changes trigger automatic orchestration to apply configurations to affected appliances.

request_body.description: IDS/IPS mode assignments for appliances. Each appliance must appear in exactly one mode array, and the nePks field must equal the union of all mode arrays.

operations.name: edgeconnect_trigger_signature_update_from_portal
operations.summary: Trigger IDPS signature update from Cloud Portal
operations.description: Initiates an on-demand download of IDS/IPS (Intrusion Detection/Prevention System) signatures from the Silver Peak Cloud Portal. This endpoint triggers a background job that fetches the latest signature updates. If a download job is already running, no new job will be started. Not available when Orchestrator is in Air-Gap mode.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ikeless_config_get417
operations.summary: Retrieve IPSec UDP key material rotation configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current IPSec UDP key material configuration including seed lifetime duration, persist seed setting, max activation wait time, and the rotation schedule. This endpoint is used to manage IKE-less IPSec key rotation settings for secure tunnel communications. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ikeless_config_post418
operations.summary: Update IPSec UDP key material configuration and rotation schedule
operations.description: Updates the IPSec UDP key material configuration including seed lifetime, persistence settings, activation wait time, and optional rotation schedule. A new seed is automatically generated after configuration update. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: IPSec UDP key material configuration including persistence settings, lifetime duration, activation wait time, and optional rotation schedule.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ikeless_history419
operations.summary: Retrieve IPSec UDP key material history from orchestrator
operations.description: Returns the orchestrator's seed history including current active and new key material IDs, their lifetimes, persistence settings, and activation timestamps. Use this to monitor key rotation status and history. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ikeless_status420
operations.summary: Get IPSec UDP key material status for all appliances
operations.description: Retrieves the IPSec UDP key material (IKE-less seed) status for all eligible appliances in the network. Returns whether each appliance has the current active seed and the new (pending) seed. Use this to monitor key rotation deployment across the network. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ikeless_status_appliance
operations.summary: Get IPSec UDP key material status for a specific appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the IKE-less IPSec UDP key material (seed) status for a specific appliance. Returns whether the appliance has the current active and new (pending) seeds, along with push/activation timestamps. Use fromCache=true for quick status checks; use fromCache=false to query the appliance directly for real-time status. Returns empty object {} if appliance is not eligible for IKE-less seeds. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromCache
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, returns cached status from Orchestrator database. When false, queries the appliance directly (falls back to cache if appliance is unreachable).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_inbound_shaper
operations.summary: Get inbound shaper settings for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves inbound traffic shaper (bandwidth limiter) configuration for all interfaces on the specified appliance. Returns an object where each key is an interface name (e.g., 'wan0', 'wan1') and each value contains the shaper settings including traffic class priority, accuracy level, maximum bandwidth limit, and enabled state. Use cached=true for faster response times or cached=false for real-time data.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Source of data retrieval. When true (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_apply_labels_to_appliance422
operations.summary: Push interface labels to appliance
operations.description: Pushes active interface labels from Orchestrator to a specific EdgeConnect appliance via REST API. Only active labels are sent; inactive labels are excluded. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_interface_state
operations.summary: Retrieve network interface state and configuration data
operations.description: Retrieves network interface configuration and state information for a specified appliance. Data can be fetched from the Orchestrator database cache or directly from the appliance. When fetching from the appliance, the cache is automatically updated.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls the data source. When true, retrieves from Orchestrator database cache. When false, fetches directly from the appliance and updates the cache. Default is true if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_acl_address_groups_get430
operations.summary: Retrieve ACL address groups
operations.description: Retrieves ACL address group objects used for access control policies. When the 'name' parameter is provided, returns a single address group matching that name. When 'name' is omitted, returns all configured address groups. Address groups define IP address ranges for use in security policies.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The unique name of the address group to retrieve. If omitted, returns all address groups.

operations.name: edgeconnect_address_groups_put426
operations.summary: Replace an existing ACL address group
operations.description: Replaces an existing ACL address group with new configuration. The address group must already exist; use POST to create new groups. Validates group name (max 64 chars, alphanumeric with dots/underscores/hyphens), IP formats, and nesting rules (max 2 levels).

request_body.description: Complete address group object to replace the existing one. The name field must match an existing group.

operations.name: edgeconnect_address_groups_post425
operations.summary: Create or update an ACL address group
operations.description: Creates a new address group or updates an existing one if the name matches. If the group exists, performs an update; otherwise creates a new group. Address groups define IP address collections for use in ACL security policies.

request_body.description: Address group object to create or update

operations.name: edgeconnect_acl_address_groups_delete429
operations.summary: Delete an ACL address group
operations.description: Deletes an ACL address group by name. The group is moved to a deleted state and associated gateway rule dependencies are cleaned up. Requires READ_WRITE role.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The unique name of the ACL address group to delete. Must be an existing address group name.

operations.name: edgeconnect_acl_address_group_bulk_upload427
operations.summary: Bulk import address groups from CSV file
operations.description: Imports address groups in bulk from a CSV file. The CSV must have 5 columns: groupName, includedIPs, excludedIPs, includedGroups, and comment. The first row is treated as a header and skipped. Multiple rows with the same group name are merged into a single address group with multiple rules. Existing groups with matching names are updated.

request_body.description: CSV file with address group data. Format: groupName,includedIPs,excludedIPs,includedGroups,comment. Use quotes for fields containing commas.

operations.name: edgeconnect_acl_address_group_merge428
operations.summary: Consolidate all address groups immediately
operations.description: Triggers immediate consolidation (merge) of all address groups stored in the database. This operation flattens nested address group references, resolves group dependencies, and updates the flattened representation used by the system. The merge process compares timestamps to determine if changes exist since the last merge. If no changes are detected, the operation completes without modification.

operations.name: edgeconnect_acl_ip_objects_memory_consumed
operations.summary: Get estimated memory consumption for IP object groups
operations.description: Calculates the estimated memory footprint (in bytes) of the flattened IP object group configuration. Useful for capacity planning and monitoring resource usage. The calculation extracts unique group identifiers from the flattened configuration and sums their UTF-8 byte lengths.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specifies which IP object type to calculate memory for. Case-insensitive.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_groups_get437
operations.summary: Retrieve ACL service groups
operations.description: Retrieves ACL service group objects used for port-based access control policies. When the 'name' parameter is provided, returns a single service group matching that name. When 'name' is omitted, returns all configured service groups. Service groups define protocol and port combinations for use in ACL security rules.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name of the service group to retrieve. If omitted, returns all service groups.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_groups_put433
operations.summary: Replace an existing ACL service group
operations.description: Replaces an existing ACL service group with new configuration. The service group must already exist; use POST to create new groups. Validates group name (max 64 chars, alphanumeric with dots/underscores/hyphens), protocol settings, port formats, and nesting rules (max 2 levels).

request_body.description: Complete service group object to replace the existing one. The name field must match an existing group.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_groups_post432
operations.summary: Create or update an ACL service group
operations.description: Creates a new service group or updates an existing one if the name matches. Service groups define protocol and port combinations for use in ACL security policies. Supports TCP, UDP, ICMP, and ICMPV6 protocols with port ranges and nested group references.

request_body.description: Service group object to create or update. If a group with the same name exists, it will be updated.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_groups_delete436
operations.summary: Delete an ACL service group
operations.description: Deletes an ACL service group by name. The group is moved to a deleted state in the database and the action is logged to the system audit log. Requires READ_WRITE role.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The unique name of the ACL service group to delete. Must be an existing service group name.

operations.name: edgeconnect_acl_service_group_bulk_upload434
operations.summary: Bulk import service groups from CSV file
operations.description: Imports service groups in bulk from a CSV file. The CSV must have 9 columns: groupName, protocol, includedPorts, excludedPorts, includedGroups, excludedGroups, icmpTypes, icmpCodes, and comment. The first row is treated as a header and skipped. Multiple rows with the same group name are merged into a single service group with multiple rules. Existing groups with matching names are updated.

request_body.description: CSV file with service group data. Format: groupName,protocol,includedPorts,excludedPorts,includedGroups,excludedGroups,icmpTypes,icmpCodes,comment. Use quotes for fields containing commas.

operations.name: edgeconnect_acl_service_group_merge435
operations.summary: Consolidate all service groups immediately
operations.description: Triggers immediate consolidation (merge) of all service groups stored in the database. This operation flattens nested service group references, resolves group dependencies, and updates the flattened representation used by the system. The merge process compares timestamps to determine if changes exist since the last merge. If no changes are detected, the operation completes without modification.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_management_settings
operations.summary: Retrieve license management settings
operations.description: Returns the management settings configuration that defines which appliance types (EdgeConnect, NX, VX, VRX, CPX, SaaS) are enabled for management. Settings are stored in the GmsConfig database.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_nx_licensed_appliances
operations.summary: Retrieve NX licensed appliances
operations.description: Returns a list of NX appliances with perpetual licenses. These are appliances where portal licensing is not required (isLicenseRequired=false and isPortalLicensed=false).

operations.name: edgeconnect_licensing440
operations.summary: Retrieves portal licensed appliances
operations.description: Returns a list of all appliances with portal-based licensing information including license requests and granted licenses. In Air-Gap mode or when Portal is unreachable, returns locally cached appliance data without contacting the Portal.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns data from local cache without contacting Portal. Default is false, which fetches fresh data from Portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_account
operations.summary: Retrieve portal-registered account for an appliance
operations.description: Returns the Cloud Portal registration account details for the specified appliance. The endpoint resolves the account by checking the appliance's portal config, falling back to discovered appliance records or the Orchestrator's primary account if needed.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_discovered_appliance_account
operations.summary: Get portal account for discovered appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the Cloud Portal account credentials (account name and account key) for a discovered appliance by its ID. If the appliance has a secondary account configured, returns those credentials; otherwise, returns the Orchestrator's primary account.

parameters.name: discoveredId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the discovered appliance. Must be a valid integer ID from the discovered appliances list.

operations.name: edgeconnect_licensing450
operations.summary: Update EC appliance account and license settings
operations.description: Updates EdgeConnect appliance portal account registration and license configuration. Supports grant/revoke operations and license setting changes. When account is provided, returns an action group ID for async polling; otherwise returns immediately.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Request body containing account, action, and license configuration. All fields are optional depending on the operation.

operations.name: edgeconnect_grant441
operations.summary: Grant an appliance a base license via HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect Cloud Portal
