operations.description: Approves and grants a base license to the specified appliance through the Cloud Portal. This operation sends an approval request to the portal and pushes portal credentials to the appliance to enable token refresh.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_license_token442
operations.summary: Remove license token from appliance
operations.description: Removes the license token directly from a specified appliance. Typically used after revoking an appliance's license to fully deactivate it. WARNING: This will immediately stop the appliance from passing traffic.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_revoke_portal_license
operations.summary: Revoke appliance base license via Cloud Portal
operations.description: Revokes a base license from an appliance through HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect Cloud Portal. The request sends a deny/revoke request to the portal for the specified appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_portal_licensed_appliances2
operations.summary: Get portal licensed appliances with timestamp
operations.description: Retrieves all portal-licensed appliances along with a timestamp indicating when the cache was last updated from the Portal. In air-gap mode or when portal configuration is unavailable, returns locally stored appliance data without contacting the Portal.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns cached data without contacting the Portal. When false or omitted, fetches fresh data from the Portal and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_change_ec_license_settings
operations.summary: Configure EC appliance license settings
operations.description: Updates license configuration for an EdgeConnect appliance. Configures bandwidth tier, WAN optimization (boost), mini, plus, and feature licenses. The license settings are pushed to the appliance via the /spPortal/licenses/ec endpoint. Mini license requires VXOA 8.1.6.0 or above. Tier license requires VXOA 8.1.7.19+, 8.1.9.6+, or 8.2.0.0+. Feature licenses require VXOA 9.1.0.0 or above.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: License configuration object containing settings for tier, boost, mini, plus, and feature licenses.

operations.name: edgeconnect_licensing445
operations.summary: Retrieve portal account license summary
operations.description: Retrieves license summary for the primary portal account, including counts and states for all license types (EdgeConnect/FX, CPX, SaaS, ECSP, Metered, Cloud Orchestration). Requires Orchestrator to be registered with Cloud Portal.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns cached license data from Orchestrator. When false or omitted, fetches fresh data directly from Cloud Portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_accounts_portal_license_summary
operations.summary: Retrieve portal license summary for all accounts
operations.description: Fetches the license summary from Cloud Portal for both primary and secondary accounts. Returns licensing information including EdgeConnect (FX), CPX, SaaS, ECSP, metered, and cloud orchestrator license details.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns cached license data from the Orchestrator. When false or omitted, fetches fresh data directly from Cloud Portal. Default is false.

operations.name: edgeconnect_licensing446
operations.summary: Retrieves VX licensed appliances
operations.description: Returns a list of appliances that require license keys (isLicenseRequired=true) and are not portal-licensed. These appliances use traditional license key validation rather than cloud portal licensing.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_link_aggregation
operations.summary: Get link aggregation configuration
operations.description: Retrieves all link aggregation (interface bonding) configuration from an appliance. Returns bonded interface groups (blan0, blan1, bwan0, bwan1) with their LACP settings. Requires appliance version 9.0.3.0 or later.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true or omitted, returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_run_link_integrity_test
operations.summary: Start a bidirectional link integrity test between two appliances
operations.description: Initiates a bidirectional link integrity test between two appliances using iperf or tcpperf. The test runs in both directions sequentially: first from appliance A (server) to appliance B (client), then reversed. Only one test can run at a time across the system.

request_body.description: Configuration for the link integrity test including appliance pairs, test parameters, and network path settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_link_integrity_status
operations.summary: Retrieve link integrity test status for an appliance
operations.description: Queries the current status of a link integrity test (iperf/tcpperf) on the specified appliance. Returns whether a test is actively running and the console output containing transfer rates and bandwidth statistics. Use this endpoint to poll test progress after starting a test with /linkIntegrityTest/run.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_live_tail_logger_get_loggers
operations.summary: Retrieve available logger names from the Orchestrator
operations.description: Returns an array of logger names based on the optional feature filter. When feature is omitted, returns all non-special loggers from the log4j configuration (excluding root logger). When feature is specified, returns loggers associated with that feature from the database.

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: Filter loggers by a specific feature name. If omitted, all available non-special loggers are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_address_lookup450
operations.summary: Convert address to geographic coordinates (geocoding)
operations.description: Geocodes a physical address to latitude/longitude coordinates using Google Geocoding API. Results are ordered by match quality with best match first. Returns empty array if API key is not configured or on error. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role access.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Physical address string to geocode (street, city, postal code, country). The address is URL-encoded before being sent to the geocoding service.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_logging_settings
operations.summary: Get logging settings from appliance or Orchestrator database
operations.description: Retrieves logging configuration settings for a specified appliance. Returns both local logging configuration (log levels, rotation settings, facilities) and remote syslog receiver settings. Use cached=true for faster response from database, or cached=false to fetch real-time data from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves settings from Orchestrator database (gmsdb). When false, fetches directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_login_sessions
operations.summary: Get all active login sessions
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all currently active user sessions on the Orchestrator. This endpoint provides session details including user information, login timestamps, and session type indicators for monitoring and administration purposes.

operations.name: edgeconnect_loopback_orch_get453
operations.summary: Retrieve loopback orchestration settings
operations.description: Retrieves the complete loopback orchestration configuration for all segments. Loopback orchestration manages automatic IP address assignment from configured pools for loopback interfaces across appliances. The response is keyed by segment ID containing IPv4/IPv6 pools and regional overrides.

operations.name: edgeconnect_loopback_orch_post454
operations.summary: Set loopback orchestration configuration
operations.description: Creates or updates the loopback orchestration configuration for automatic IP address assignment from configured pools. Validates segment IDs, region IDs, subnet pools, interface labels, role IDs, and management IP constraints before saving. Triggers orchestration for all appliances after successful update.

request_body.description: Loopback orchestration configuration map keyed by segment ID. Each segment contains IPv4/IPv6 pools and optional region-specific overrides.

operations.name: edgeconnect_loopback_pool_info455
operations.summary: Retrieve loopback pool allocation summary
operations.description: Returns allocation statistics for all configured loopback pools organized by segment, region, and subnet. Provides total address counts, allocated addresses, and deleted (reclaimable) addresses for each pool.

operations.name: edgeconnect_loopback_pool_info_seg456
operations.summary: Retrieve deleted loopback IP allocation history by segment
operations.description: Returns historical records of deleted loopback IP allocations for a specific VRF segment. These are IP addresses previously assigned to appliances but now marked as deleted and available for reclamation.

parameters.name: seg
parameters.description: VRF segment ID to filter history records. Use 0 for the default segment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_reclaim_addr_by_specific_id457
operations.summary: Reclaim a deleted loopback IP address by record ID
operations.description: Reclaims a specific deleted loopback IP address by its history record ID. The reclaimed IP is added back to the pool's reusable address list, making it available for future allocations. Use the /loopbackOrch/pool/history endpoint to retrieve available record IDs.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique database identifier of the deleted loopback history record to reclaim. Obtain this ID from the /loopbackOrch/pool/history endpoint response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_reclaim_by_seg457
operations.summary: Reclaim all deleted loopback IP addresses by segment
operations.description: Reclaims all deleted loopback IP addresses for a specific VRF segment. This bulk operation retrieves all historical/deleted entries for the segment, removes them from the history table, and adds the IP addresses back to the reusable pool for future allocations.

parameters.name: segId
parameters.description: VRF segment ID to reclaim deleted addresses from. Use 0 for the default segment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_reclaim_by_seg_reg_subnet457
operations.summary: Reclaim deleted loopback IP addresses by segment, region, and subnet
operations.description: Reclaims all deleted loopback IP addresses for a specific VRF segment, region, and subnet pool combination. This bulk operation retrieves deleted history entries, removes them from the history table, and adds the IP addresses back to the reusable pool for future allocations.

parameters.name: seg
parameters.description: VRF segment ID to filter deleted addresses. Use 0 for the default segment.

parameters.name: reg
parameters.description: Region ID to filter deleted addresses. Use 0 for the global/default region.

parameters.name: subnet
parameters.description: Loopback pool subnet in CIDR notation (IPv4 or IPv6). Must match an existing pool configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_maintenance_mode458
operations.summary: Get maintenance mode appliances
operations.description: Retrieves the current maintenance mode state for all appliances. Returns two lists: appliances with paused orchestration (configuration changes are not applied) and appliances with suppressed alarms (alerts are disabled). Supports ETag-based caching for efficient polling.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from a previous response for cache validation. If matched, returns 304 Not Modified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_maintenance_mode459
operations.summary: Configure appliance maintenance mode
operations.description: Add or remove appliances from maintenance mode. Maintenance mode allows pausing orchestration (configuration changes queued) and suppressing alarms (alerts disabled) for specified appliances.

request_body.description: Maintenance mode configuration specifying action and target appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_uploaded_map460
operations.summary: Delete an uploaded custom topology map image
operations.description: Removes a user-uploaded map image file from the Orchestrator's uploaded maps directory. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: The exact filename of the map image to delete, including extension.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_uploaded_maps461
operations.summary: Retrieve list of uploaded custom topology map images
operations.description: Returns a list of user-uploaded map image files available for use in topology visualizations. System files like .keep_dir are automatically excluded from results.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_management_services_config
operations.summary: Get Management Services Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the management services configuration for a specified appliance. Returns a map of configured applications with their display names and source interface settings.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval mode. When 'true' or omitted, returns cached data from Orchestrator. When 'false', fetches live data directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_model_spec
operations.summary: Retrieve appliance model specifications
operations.description: Retrieves model specification data for one or more appliance models. First checks local orchestration store cache, then fetches missing data from Cloud Portal. Results are cached for future requests.

request_body.description: Request body containing model identifiers and specification keys to retrieve.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_physical_port_names
operations.summary: Get physical port names for appliance models
operations.description: Retrieves networking port specifications for specified appliance models. This is a convenience wrapper around /modelSpec that automatically sets searchKeys to 'spec.networking.ports'. Data is fetched from local cache first, then Cloud Portal for missing entries.

request_body.description: JSON object containing an array of model identifiers to query for port information.

operations.name: edgeconnect_multicast_config_get463
operations.summary: Get Multicast Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the multicast routing configuration for a specific appliance, including PIM (Protocol Independent Multicast) and IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) settings per interface, rendezvous point IP address, and multicast group filter configuration.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance. Defaults to true if not provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_multicast_enable_get464
operations.summary: Get Multicast Enable Status
operations.description: Retrieves the multicast routing feature status (enabled/disabled) for a specific appliance. Used to verify multicast configuration state before applying routing changes.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When 'true', returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance. Defaults to 'true' if not provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_multicast_interface_state_get465
operations.summary: Get Multicast Interface State
operations.description: Retrieves PIM (Protocol Independent Multicast) interface state information for a specific appliance. Returns details about designated router configuration, interface IPs, and generation IDs for each multicast-enabled interface. Always fetches fresh data directly from the appliance (no caching).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_multicast_neighbor_state_get466
operations.summary: Get PIM Neighbor State
operations.description: Retrieves PIM (Protocol Independent Multicast) neighbor state information for a specific appliance. Returns details about discovered PIM neighbors including their IP addresses, DR priority, and generation IDs. Always fetches fresh data directly from the appliance (no caching).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_multicast_route_state_get467
operations.summary: Get Multicast Route State
operations.description: Retrieves multicast routing table state information for a specific appliance. Returns active multicast routes including source IPs, group addresses, incoming and outgoing interfaces. Always fetches fresh data directly from the appliance (no caching).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_nac_info
operations.summary: Get NAC Security Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves Network Access Control (NAC) security configuration for a specified appliance. Returns 802.1X authentication profiles, MAC authentication profiles, AAA profiles, RADIUS server configurations, and interface policy assignments. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Determines data source. When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator (faster). When false, fetches live data from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_nat468
operations.summary: Get complete NAT configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the complete NAT configuration for an appliance, including both NAT maps (translation rules) and NAT pools (IP address pools). This is a combined endpoint that aggregates data from /nat/maps and /nat/natPools.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selection. When 'true', returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance (slower but current).

operations.name: edgeconnect_branch_nat_maps_get469
operations.summary: Get NAT maps configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the NAT maps (priority-based translation rules) for an appliance. Each map contains numbered priority entries that define traffic matching criteria and address translation actions. Lower priority numbers are evaluated first.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selection. When 'true' (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator database (faster). When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance (slower but current).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_nat_pools470
operations.summary: Get NAT pools configuration
operations.description: Retrieves all NAT pools configured on an appliance. NAT pools define IP address ranges used for source or destination address translation in NAT rules. Maximum 200 pools supported per appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selection. 'true' (default) returns cached data from Orchestrator database (faster). 'false' fetches live data directly from appliance (slower, updates cache).

operations.name: edgeconnect_natall471
operations.summary: Get NAT all inbound/outbound settings
operations.description: Retrieves all NAT (Network Address Translation) configuration settings including inbound and outbound NAT rules for a specified appliance. Data can be fetched from cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Determines data source. When true (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_natmap472
operations.summary: Get NAT policy maps and rules
operations.description: Retrieves NAT (Network Address Translation) policy maps and rules for a specified appliance. Returns configuration containing active map selection, map definitions with priority-based rules, and match/set conditions for traffic handling.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When 'true' (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_natmap_dynamic473
operations.summary: Get dynamic NAT maps configuration
operations.description: Retrieves dynamic NAT (Network Address Translation) maps and rule configurations for a specified appliance. Returns a map structure where keys are map names and values contain priority-based rule definitions with match criteria and NAT settings. Supports version-specific data format conversion for appliances running versions prior to 8.1.0.0.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When 'true' (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_net_flow_data
operations.summary: Get NetFlow/IPFIX export configuration
operations.description: Retrieves NetFlow or IPFIX flow export configuration from an EdgeConnect appliance. Returns collector settings, interface export options, timeout configurations, and IP masking settings. Use cached=true for faster response from Orchestrator database, or cached=false for real-time data from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When false, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_erase_nm_post475
operations.summary: Erase Network Memory on one or more appliances
operations.description: Initiates an asynchronous operation to erase network memory (deduplication cache) on specified appliances. Returns a client key for polling the operation status. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: Request body containing the erase flag and list of appliance identifiers

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_notification477
operations.summary: Retrieve the Orchestrator notification banner
operations.description: Retrieves the current Orchestrator notification banner configuration. This endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication and supports ETag-based caching for efficient polling. Returns an array with zero or one notification object.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from a previous response. If the notification has not changed, a 304 Not Modified response is returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_notification478
operations.summary: Create or update the Orchestrator notification banner
operations.description: Creates a new notification banner or updates the existing one. If no notification exists, a new one is created; otherwise, the existing notification is updated with version tracking. The operation is logged in the system action log for audit purposes.

request_body.description: Notification configuration containing author and message content.

operations.name: edgeconnect_del_notification476
operations.summary: Delete the Orchestrator notification banner
operations.description: Deletes the Orchestrator notification banner message, removing it from display for all users. This operation clears all notification configuration data from the database and logs the action in the system action log. Safe to call even if no notification exists.

operations.name: edgeconnect_optmap479
operations.summary: Retrieve optimization maps configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the optimization maps (traffic optimization policy rules) for a specific appliance. Returns optimization maps containing rules with match criteria and optimization settings. Data can be retrieved from cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Determines data source. When true (default), retrieves from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches fresh data from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_info_get
operations.summary: Get orchestrator High Availability mode and instance information
operations.description: Retrieves the current orchestrator HA mode (NORMAL, HA_PRIMARY, or HA_BACKUP) along with instance details. In NORMAL mode, only the mode field is populated. In HA modes, returns both primary and current instance information including IP addresses and registration timestamps.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_instances_get
operations.summary: Get orchestrator HA instances
operations.description: Retrieves all registered orchestrator instances in the HA cluster, or a specific instance by ID. Returns instance details including registration time and last health check timestamp.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Optional instance ID to retrieve a specific orchestrator instance. If omitted, returns all registered instances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_instance_put
operations.summary: Update HA instance comment
operations.description: Updates the comment/description field for a specific orchestrator HA instance. Only the comment field from the request body is used; other fields are ignored. The action is logged to the system audit log.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the orchestrator instance to update. Must match an existing registered instance.

request_body.description: Instance object containing the comment to update. Only the comment field is processed; all other fields are ignored.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_orch_instance
operations.summary: Remove an orchestrator HA instance
operations.description: Decommissions and removes an orchestrator instance from the HA cluster. The instance record is permanently deleted from the database. This action is logged to the system audit log.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the orchestrator instance to remove. Must match an existing registered instance ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_notification_config_get
operations.summary: Get HA notification configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current email notification settings for orchestrator HA cluster health monitoring. Returns default configuration (threshold=2 minutes, disabled) if not previously configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_notification_config_put
operations.summary: Update HA notification configuration
operations.description: Updates email notification settings for HA cluster health monitoring. Configures alert thresholds and recipient email for instance failure notifications. Resets any existing email alert state upon successful update.

request_body.description: HA notification configuration object with email settings and failure threshold

operations.name: edgeconnect_haprimary_put
operations.summary: Promote current backup instance to primary orchestrator
operations.description: Promotes the current backup orchestrator instance to become the new primary. The previous primary must be shut down before promotion. After successful promotion, the orchestrator restarts automatically in 10 seconds to apply the new HA mode. This action is logged to the audit trail.

operations.name: edgeconnect_primary_instance_http_status_get
operations.summary: Check primary orchestrator HTTP reachability status
operations.description: Checks if the primary orchestrator instance is reachable via HTTPS. When called from a backup instance, performs an HTTP ping to the primary on port 443. When called from the primary itself, always returns reachable. Only available when orchestrator is in HA mode (HA_PRIMARY or HA_BACKUP).

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_cluster_reachability_config_get
operations.summary: Get HA cluster reachability configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the IP addresses or DNS names configured for appliances to reach orchestrator instances in an HA cluster. Returns default reachability and any label-specific overrides. Returns an empty configuration object if no reachability settings have been configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ha_cluster_reachability_config_post
operations.summary: Update HA cluster reachability configuration
operations.description: Updates the IP addresses or DNS names used by appliances to reach orchestrator instances in an HA cluster. Allows configuring default reachability and label-specific overrides for multi-site deployments.

request_body.description: HA cluster reachability configuration with default and label-specific instance addresses

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_segment_ospf_interfaces_config480
operations.summary: Get OSPF interface configurations for all VRF segments
operations.description: Retrieves OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) interface configurations across all VRF segments on a specified appliance. Data can be fetched directly from the appliance or from cached Orchestrator storage.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database; when false, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_segment_ospf_config481
operations.summary: Get OSPF system configuration for all VRFs/segments
operations.description: Retrieves the OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) system-level configuration for all VRFs on the specified appliance. Data can be fetched directly from the appliance or from the Orchestrator cache. The response is a map where keys are segment IDs and values are OSPF system configurations including redistribution settings and router ID.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Determines the data source. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database. When false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ospf_areas_config482
operations.summary: Get OSPF areas configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the OSPF areas configuration for a specified appliance. Returns area settings including area type, redistribution, summary LSA control, and NSSA translator role. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached configuration from Orchestrator database. When false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_interface_config_dta483
operations.summary: Get OSPF interfaces configuration
operations.description: Retrieves OSPF interface configuration settings for a specified appliance. Returns a map of interface names to their OSPF configuration including area assignments, authentication settings, timers, and BFD configuration.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, returns cached configuration from Orchestrator database. When false, fetches live configuration directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ospf_system_config484
operations.summary: Get appliance OSPF system-level configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the OSPF routing protocol system configuration for a specified appliance. Returns settings for OSPF enable/disable state, router ID, and route redistribution from BGP, local, and Silver Peak (subnet share) sources to OSPF.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from GMS database. When false, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_vrfs_ospf_interfaces_state
operations.summary: Get OSPF interface state for all VRFs
operations.description: Retrieves the current OSPF interface state across all VRF segments for the specified network element. Returns interface details including neighbor information, OSPF timers, designated routers, and interface configuration state. Data can be fetched directly from the appliance or from cached GMS database.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: When true, retrieves cached data from GMS database instead of querying the appliance directly. Useful for offline appliances or reducing appliance load.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_vrfs_ospf_neighbors_state
operations.summary: Get OSPF neighbors state for all VRF segments
operations.description: Retrieves the OSPF neighbor state information for all VRF segments on the specified appliance. Returns neighbor details including router ID, IP address, state, and interface information keyed by segment ID.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: When true, retrieves cached data from GMS database instead of querying the appliance directly. Defaults to false.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_vrfs_ospf_system_state
operations.summary: Get OSPF system state for all VRFs
operations.description: Retrieves the current OSPF system state information for all VRF segments on the specified appliance. Returns routing protocol status, redistribution configuration state, LSA counters, and neighbor counts per segment.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: When true, retrieves cached OSPF state from the GMS database instead of querying the appliance directly. Useful for offline appliances or reducing load.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ospf_interface_state_details
operations.summary: Get OSPF interface state details
operations.description: Retrieves the current operational state of all OSPF-enabled interfaces on the specified appliance. Returns interface status, designated router information, OSPF timers, and neighbor counts. Data can be fetched directly from the appliance or from cached data stored in Orchestrator.

parameters.name: nePk

parameters.name: fromGms

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ospf_neighbor_state

operations.description: Retrieves the current state of OSPF neighbors for a specified appliance. Returns information about each OSPF neighbor including their adjacency state, router ID, designated router status, and timing parameters. Data can be fetched directly from the appliance or from the cached database.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: When true, retrieves cached data from database. When false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ospf_state_system
operations.summary: Get OSPF system state
operations.description: Retrieves the current OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) routing protocol system state for a specified appliance. Returns configuration and operational data including router ID, neighbor count, LSA statistics, and route redistribution settings.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, retrieves cached data from Orchestrator database. When false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_overlay_mng_props491
operations.summary: Retrieve overlay manager properties
operations.description: Retrieves the current overlay manager properties including orchestration settings, tunnel configuration, and IPsec parameters. The ipsecPresharedKey field is always set to null in the response for security reasons. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role access.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_overlay_mng_props492
operations.summary: Update overlay manager properties
operations.description: Updates overlay orchestration properties including tunnel settings, polling intervals, and IPsec configuration. Requires READ_WRITE role. parameters.name: isOrchestratorSetting
parameters.description: Skip tunnel settings validation when true. Use for orchestrator-only settings (polling, enable flags).

request_body.description: Overlay manager properties to update. Omit ipsecPresharedKey to retain current value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_overlay_mng_props_default493
operations.summary: Retrieve factory default overlay manager properties
operations.description: Returns the factory default values for overlay manager properties. Use this endpoint to understand baseline settings before configuring orchestration, or to reference defaults when resetting configuration. The response contains only orchestration-level defaults (not WAN label tunnel settings). Requires READ or READ_WRITE role access.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_pause_orchestration494
operations.summary: Get nePks of appliances paused from orchestration
operations.description: Retrieves the list of appliance network element primary keys (nePks) that are currently excluded from orchestration. Paused appliances do not receive configuration updates until they are removed from the pause list.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_pause_orchestration495
operations.summary: Set appliances to pause from orchestration
operations.description: Replaces the entire pause orchestration list with the provided appliance nePks. Appliances in the list are excluded from configuration orchestration. Removing an appliance from the list automatically triggers a full sync for that appliance.

request_body.description: Complete list of appliance nePks to pause from orchestration. This replaces the existing list entirely.

operations.name: edgeconnect_port_forwarding_get496
operations.summary: Retrieve port forwarding rules
operations.description: Retrieves all port forwarding (inbound NAT) rules configured on a specified EdgeConnect appliance. Returns rules that define how incoming packets are translated to internal destinations.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false or omitted, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_port_profiles_get500
operations.summary: Retrieve all Deployment Profile templates
operations.description: Retrieves all Deployment Profile (port profile) templates stored in the Orchestrator. Returns an array of profile objects containing system configuration, interface settings, and routing information.

operations.name: edgeconnect_port_profiles_put501
operations.summary: Update an existing Deployment Profile template
operations.description: Updates an existing Deployment Profile (port profile) template in the Orchestrator. The profile must exist and the name must be unique. The id from the query parameter overrides any id in the request body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Deployment Profile to update. Must match an existing profile.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the updated Deployment Profile configuration. The 'id' field in the body is ignored and replaced with the query parameter value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_port_profiles_post498
operations.summary: Create a new Deployment Profile template
operations.description: Creates a new Deployment Profile (port profile) template in the Orchestrator. A Deployment Profile defines interface configuration, routing, and system settings that can be applied to appliances. The profile name must be unique across all profiles.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the Deployment Profile configuration. The 'id' field should be empty or omitted for new profiles - a UUID will be auto-generated.

operations.name: edgeconnect_port_profiles_delete499
operations.summary: Delete a Deployment Profile template
operations.description: Permanently removes a Deployment Profile (port profile) template from the Orchestrator. The profile must exist and cannot be recovered after deletion. This action is logged in the system audit trail.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Deployment Profile to delete. This is a system-generated value returned when creating or listing profiles.

operations.name: edgeconnect_port_profiles_label_in_use_get502
operations.summary: Check if interface label is in use by deployment profiles
operations.description: Determines whether a specific interface label is associated with any deployment profiles. Only checks profiles in router mode. For inline configurations, validates based on the specified side (LAN/WAN).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the interface label to check. Must not be null or empty.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Specifies which side of the interface to check. Case-insensitive comparison is performed.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_qo_s_maps
operations.summary: Retrieve QoS policy settings for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves QoS policy configuration including maps, rules, match criteria, and set actions. Returns data from cache by default, or directly from the appliance when cached=false. Each QoS map contains priority-based rules that match traffic and apply QoS settings.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selection. When true or omitted, returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance (slower but more current).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_debug_apis
operations.summary: Get allowed REST API endpoints for current user
operations.description: Retrieves a list of REST API endpoints accessible to the authenticated user or API key based on RBAC permissions. Returns APIs from user session or API key hashmap combined with bypass APIs.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Filter results by HTTP method. Only alphabetic characters are retained and converted to uppercase. If omitted, returns endpoints for all methods.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_appliance_access_groups504
operations.summary: Retrieve appliance access groups (assets)
operations.description: Retrieves appliance access group configurations. Supports three modes: (1) Get all assets when no parameters provided, (2) Get a specific asset by name using applianceAccessTypeName, (3) Get the current user's assigned asset from session using assigned=true.

parameters.name: applianceAccessTypeName
parameters.description: Name of a specific appliance access group (asset) to retrieve. When provided, returns only the configuration for that asset.

parameters.name: assigned
parameters.description: When true, returns the appliance access group assigned to the current user's session. Returns 204 if no asset is assigned or if request is from API key/local. Ignored when applianceAccessTypeName is provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_create_or_update_appliance_access_group505
operations.summary: Create or update appliance access group (asset)
operations.description: Creates a new appliance access group (asset) or updates an existing one. Assets define which appliance groups and/or regions a user can access. Only one asset can be processed per request. When an existing asset is modified, active sessions of users assigned to that asset are automatically terminated to apply changes.

request_body.description: Map containing a single asset name (key) and its configuration (value). Only the first entry is processed if multiple entries are provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_appliance_access_group_by_name506
operations.summary: Delete appliance access group (asset) by name
operations.description: Permanently removes an appliance access group (asset) configuration from the system. The asset cannot be deleted if it is currently assigned to any user. Upon successful deletion, the RBAC API key cache is cleared and the action is logged.

parameters.name: applianceAccessTypeName
parameters.description: Unique name of the appliance access group (asset) to delete. Must be non-empty and match an existing asset name.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_rbac_assignment_by_username511
operations.summary: Get RBAC assignments
operations.description: Retrieves role-based access control (RBAC) assignments. Returns all assignments when no username is provided, or a single assignment for the specified user. Use this to query user access customizations including roles and asset permissions.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Filter by specific username. When omitted, returns all RBAC assignments. When provided, returns only the assignment for that user.

operations.name: edgeconnect_create_or_update_rbac_assignment509
operations.summary: Create or update RBAC user access customization
operations.description: Creates a new RBAC assignment or updates an existing one for a user. If the user already has an assignment, it is replaced. The user's active session is terminated after the update to apply new permissions.

request_body.description: User access customization object. At least one of 'roles' or 'asset' must be provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_rbac_assignment510
operations.summary: Delete RBAC user access customization by username
operations.description: Removes the role-based access control (RBAC) assignment for a specific user. This operation deletes both role assignments and appliance access group associations. The user's active session is terminated upon successful deletion.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username whose RBAC assignment should be deleted. Must be non-empty and match an existing assignment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_legacy_api35
operations.summary: Get list of all legacy APIs
operations.description: Retrieves all legacy API transformation entries from the database. Each entry defines how legacy API requests are transformed to their new API equivalents. Requires enableLegacyApisSupport advanced property to be enabled for transformations to take effect.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_legacy_api_entry39
operations.summary: Update legacy API transformation entry
operations.description: Updates an existing legacy API transformation entry by ID. Performs a full replacement of all fields with provided values. The action is logged for auditing and the internal cache is refreshed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Database ID of the legacy API entry to update. Must be a non-empty string representing a valid existing entry.

request_body.description: Complete legacy API entry configuration. All fields are required and will replace existing values.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_legacy_api36
operations.summary: Add new legacy API transformation entry
operations.description: Creates a new legacy API transformation entry in the database. Maps a deprecated/legacy API path pattern to its new equivalent endpoint. The transformation is applied at runtime when enableLegacyApisSupport advanced property is enabled. Logs the action for auditing.

request_body.description: Legacy API transformation configuration. All fields are required to define the mapping from old to new API.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_legacy_api_entry37
operations.summary: Delete legacy API transformation entry
operations.description: Permanently removes a legacy API transformation entry from the database by its ID. The internal cache is refreshed and the action is logged for auditing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Database ID of the legacy API entry to delete. Must be a non-null, non-empty string representing an existing entry's primary key.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_roles512
operations.summary: Get all RBAC roles or a specific role by name
operations.description: Retrieves all defined RBAC roles or a specific role when menuTypeName is provided. Roles define which menus users can access and their permission level (read-only or read-write).

parameters.name: menuTypeName
parameters.description: Name of a specific role to retrieve. If omitted, all roles are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_role513
operations.summary: Create or update an RBAC role
operations.description: Creates a new RBAC role or updates an existing role with the same name. When a role is modified, all active sessions of users assigned to that role are automatically invalidated, and the RBAC API key hashmap is cleared to enforce new permissions immediately.

request_body.description: Map of role definitions with role name as key and role configuration as value. Must contain at least one role entry.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_role_by_role_name515
operations.summary: Delete an RBAC role by name
operations.description: Permanently removes an RBAC role from the system. Roles currently assigned to users or API keys cannot be deleted. On successful deletion, the RBAC API key hashmap is cleared to enforce permission updates.

parameters.name: menuTypeName
parameters.description: Unique name identifier of the role to delete. Must be a non-empty string matching an existing role name.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_assigned_menus514
operations.summary: Get menu access permissions for current session user
operations.description: Retrieves the menu access map for the currently authenticated session user based on their assigned RBAC role(s). This endpoint is session-based only and returns 204 for API key requests, localhost requests, or users without RBAC customization.

operations.name: edgeconnect_reachability_from_appliance517
operations.summary: Get appliance connectivity status
operations.description: Retrieves connectivity status from the specified EdgeConnect appliance. The response contains reachability information for REST API, SSH, HTTPS, and WebSocket protocols. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role permissions.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_reachability_from_gms
operations.summary: Get appliance reachability status from Orchestrator
operations.description: Retrieves reachability status for an appliance from the Orchestrator's perspective. Returns device connectivity details including state, hostname, and configuration sync status. State values: 0 (Unknown), 1 (Normal), 2 (Unreachable), 3 (Unsupported version), 4 (Out of sync), 5 (Sync in progress).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_reachability_from_gms518
operations.summary: Get detailed WebSocket reachability status from Orchestrator
operations.description: Retrieves detailed WebSocket connectivity status for an appliance. Returns direct GMS WebSocket status, Portal WebSocket status with end-to-end encryption indicator, preferred communication channel, and timing configuration (ping frequency, idle timeout). Validates that appliance exists in Orchestrator cache before processing.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliances_reachability
operations.summary: Get reachability status for all appliances from the Orchestrator
operations.description: Returns a map of all managed appliances keyed by appliance nePk. Each entry contains the appliance hostname, sync state, direct WebSocket connection status, and portal WebSocket connection status.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_realtime_stats
operations.summary: Retrieve real-time tunnel stats, flow stats, packet drop stats (with reason codes), DSCP stats, traffic class stats, shaper stats, and interface stats from an EdgeConnect appliance for monitoring scripts and alerting
operations.description:
Real-time monitoring API for tunnel bandwidth, TCP/UDP flow counts, packet drops, QoS shaper metrics, DSCP traffic, traffic class throughput, and interface bandwidth. Poll faster than every 3 seconds to avoid data gaps.

**Common Use Cases:**
- Build monitoring scripts that poll this API at configurable polling intervals
- Set up threshold-based alerting when packet drops exceed a defined threshold
- Track packet drop reason codes to identify specific network issues
- Monitor consecutive polling intervals to trigger alerts on persistent problems
- Create real-time dashboards with input parameters for EdgeConnect appliance metrics

**Statistics Types:**

| Type | name | filter | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| tunnel | tunnel name, 'pass-through', or 'pass-through-unshaped' | not used | Returns per-tunnel tx/rx bytes, packets, and MOS scores for voice quality monitoring on overlay tunnels. |
| trafficType | '0' (optimized) or '3' (all-traffic) | not used | Returns aggregate bandwidth metrics across all optimized WAN-accelerated traffic or all traffic types combined. |
| dscp | '0' to '63' | required | Returns per-DSCP marking statistics to monitor QoS policy effectiveness and traffic classification by differentiated services code point. |
| trafficClass | '0' to '9' | required | Returns per-traffic-class throughput and packet counts to verify business intent traffic prioritization (class 0 is highest priority). |
| flow | '0' (TCP accel), '1' (TCP unaccel), '2' (non-TCP) | required (use '3' for all traffic) | Returns flow metrics: CREATED (flows created/sec), DELETED (flows deleted/sec), EXISTING (active flows), MAX (peak flows), plus byte/packet counters. |
| shaper | '0' to '9' (traffic class) | 0=outbound, 1=inbound | Returns QoS shaper queue depth, throughput, and shaped traffic metrics per traffic class for outbound or inbound direction. |
| drops | '' (empty string) | not used | Returns packet drop counters with reason codes to identify congestion, policy drops, or interface errors across the appliance. |
| interface | interface name (e.g., 'wan0') | required | Returns per-interface tx/rx bytes, packets, and error counters for physical and logical interfaces like wan0, lan0, or bvi0. |

**Internal Drop Reason Codes (for type=drops):**

The response keys are numeric reason codes (1-399). The complete code-to-description mapping is available in the `x-drop-reason-codes` extension on the RealTimeStatsResponse schema. Common categories include:

| Code Range | Category |
|------------|----------|
| 1-27 | LAN Rx/Tx errors (pass-through, packet length, tunnel, policy, checksum, queue full, buffer) |
| 28-57 | WAN Rx/Tx errors (tunnel, TPH, frame, queue full, checksum, flow state, SYN, buffer) |
| 58-77 | NAT, MTU, FEC, fragmentation errors |
| 78-88 | QoS drops (packet expired, tunnel down, bad flow, enqueue full - egress/ingress) |
| 89-101 | Packet/stream encode/decode/transform errors |
| 102-113 | FRED/FMST flow errors |
| 114-135 | IPsec and TCP errors |
| 136-140 | ZCI and kernel errors |
| 141-165 | License, control packets, NAT, overlay errors |
| 166-177 | Routing errors (no route, TTL, bridge, VXLAN, FEC framing) |
| 178-189 | QoS flow errors, security policy drops |
| 190-213 | ICMP, tunnel, bridge port, VRF errors |
| 214-260 | Local packet errors, hash collisions, multicast, WTX encap |
| 261-293 | Zone/VRF, IDS/IPS, segmentation, IPSec queue errors |
| 294-339 | ZCI internal errors, datapath overflow, FPOC fragment errors |
| 340-399 | FPOC cleanup, DDOS, VXLAN, tracert, OTO, IDS inline, bridge/switch errors |

To get the live code mapping from a specific appliance, call `stats/drops/meta/info` via the appliance proxy API.

**Filter Values (string):** '0'=optimized_traffic, '1'=pass_through_shaped, '2'=pass_through_unshaped, '3'=all_traffic

**Response Format:** `{'metric': [[timestamp, value], ...]}` with up to 3 data points.

**Authorization:** READ or READ_WRITE role.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Specifies which real-time statistic category and metric to retrieve from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_region_single_get528
operations.summary: Get regions
operations.description: Retrieves region configurations. Returns all regions when regionId is not provided, or a specific region when regionId is specified. Results are filtered based on user's RBAC region access permissions; default region (ID 0) is always included.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Unique region identifier. When omitted, returns all regions. When provided, returns only the specified region.

operations.name: edgeconnect_region_put529
operations.summary: Update region name
operations.description: Renames an existing region identified by regionId. Updates the region name in the database and refreshes the UI cache for both regions and region associations.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the region to update. Must reference an existing region.

request_body.description: Object containing the new region name.

operations.name: edgeconnect_region_post521
operations.summary: Create a new region
operations.description: Creates a new region for grouping appliances. The system auto-assigns the next available region ID (starting from 1). Regional overlay configurations are automatically initialized from the default overlay config.

request_body.description: Object containing the name for the new region.

operations.name: edgeconnect_region_delete527
operations.summary: Delete a region by ID
operations.description: Permanently deletes a region and all associated configurations. This operation removes regional overlays, loopback configurations, SSE connector pools, and gateway rules. All appliances are added to the pending orchestration list after deletion.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the region to delete. Must be a non-zero value as the default region (ID 0) cannot be deleted.

operations.name: edgeconnect_region_association_get524
operations.summary: Get region associations for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves appliance-to-region associations. Returns all associations as a map when nePk is not provided, or a single association object when nePk is specified. Results are filtered based on user's RBAC region access permissions.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_region_association_put526
operations.summary: Update region association for a single appliance
operations.description: Updates the region association for a specific appliance identified by nePk. If the appliance is being moved from a custom region (non-default) to another region, it will be removed from any overlay external hub lists.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: Object containing the target region ID to associate with the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_region_association_post523
operations.summary: Create or update appliance-to-region associations
operations.description: Associates one or more appliances with specified regions. If an appliance is moved from one custom region to another, it will be removed from overlay external hub lists and associated connector interfaces will be cleared.

request_body.description: Array of appliance-to-region association objects. Each object must contain nePk and regionId.

operations.name: edgeconnect_region_association_get525
operations.summary: Get all appliances associated with a region
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all appliance-to-region associations for a specific region. Returns appliances that are assigned to the specified region ID.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Unique region identifier to retrieve appliances for. Region ID 0 represents the default region.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_releases
operations.summary: Get all available software releases
operations.description: Retrieves all available software releases for both Orchestrator (GMS) and EdgeConnect (ECOS/VXOA) products. Returns lists of release versions with their metadata including release dates, descriptions, and types.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_release_notifications
operations.summary: Get active release upgrade notifications
operations.description: Retrieves all pending software upgrade notifications for Orchestrator and EdgeConnect products. Returns notifications that are past due (nextTime is null or in the past) and have not been dismissed. Returns an empty array if the release information job is currently running.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delay_release_notification
operations.summary: Delay release upgrade notifications
operations.description: Postpones software upgrade notifications by a specified number of hours. If no version is specified, delays ALL notifications for both Orchestrator and EdgeConnect releases. The notification's nextTime is set to current time plus the delay period.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Target release version (e.g., '9.3.0.40000'). If omitted, delays notifications for all available releases.

request_body.description: Delay configuration specifying how many hours to postpone the notification

operations.name: edgeconnect_dismiss_release_notification
operations.summary: Permanently dismiss release upgrade notifications
operations.description: Permanently dismisses software upgrade notifications by setting the dismiss flag to true. If no version is specified, dismisses ALL Orchestrator (GMS) release notifications. Dismissed notifications will no longer appear in GET /release/notifications responses.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Target release version to dismiss (e.g., '9.3.0.40000'). If omitted, dismisses all Orchestrator release notifications.

operations.name: edgeconnect_remote_log_receiver_single_get540
operations.summary: Retrieve remote log receiver configurations
operations.description: Retrieves one or all configured remote log receivers. Returns receiver configuration data including type-specific settings. WebSocket receivers include a dynamically generated URL for connection. HTTP/HTTPS receivers have headerValue omitted for security.

parameters.name: receiverId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of a specific receiver to retrieve. If omitted, all receivers are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_remote_log_receiver_put536
operations.summary: Update existing remote log receiver configurations
operations.description: Updates one or more existing remote log receiver configurations. Each receiver object must include a valid id field referencing an existing receiver. Supports updating HTTP, HTTPS, Kafka, Syslog, and WebSocket receiver types.

request_body.description: Array of receiver configuration objects to update. Each object must include the id field and all required fields for the receiver type.

operations.name: edgeconnect_remote_log_receiver_add535
operations.summary: Create one or more remote log receivers
operations.description: Creates new remote log receiver configurations for forwarding audit logs or alarms to external systems. Supports HTTP, HTTPS, Kafka, Syslog, and WebSocket receiver types. The id field must NOT be included in POST requests as IDs are auto-generated.

request_body.description: Array of receiver configuration objects. Each object must include common required fields (receiverType, enabled, name, logType) plus type-specific fields based on the receiverType.

operations.name: edgeconnect_remote_log_receiver_delete539
operations.summary: Delete a remote log receiver configuration
operations.description: Permanently removes a remote log receiver configuration by ID. This operation clears associated alarms, closes WebSocket connections, and cleans up Kafka producer resources if applicable. The deletion is logged as a system action.

parameters.name: receiverId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the receiver to delete. Must be a valid existing receiver ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_latest_sequence_id_get538
operations.summary: Retrieve the latest sequence ID for alarms or audit logs
operations.description: Returns the most recent sequence ID for either alarm events or audit log entries. Use this endpoint to determine the current position in the event stream for synchronization purposes.

parameters.name: logType
parameters.description: Type of log to retrieve the latest sequence ID for. Use 'alarm' for alarm events or 'auditLog' (case-insensitive) for audit log entries.

operations.name: edgeconnect_remote_log_receiver_subscribe541
operations.summary: Request resubmission of specific log messages by sequence ID
operations.description: Triggers resubmission of audit logs or alarms to a configured receiver based on sequence IDs. The logType in the request body must match the receiver's configured logType. For audit logs, max 1000 messages can be requested per call.

parameters.name: receiverId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of an existing remote log receiver. Must reference a valid, configured receiver.

request_body.description: Specifies the log type and sequence IDs to resubmit. The id array supports single numbers, ranges (e.g., '4-6'), or open-ended ranges (e.g., '4-LATEST').

operations.name: edgeconnect_socket_status_get537
operations.summary: Retrieve WebSocket receiver connection status
operations.description: Returns the current connection status for all WebSocket-based remote log receivers. Provides real-time monitoring information including client IP, connection establishment time, and ping/pong health metrics.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_scheduled_pdf_reports
operations.summary: Retrieve scheduled PDF reports
operations.description: Returns a list of all scheduled PDF reports metadata when called without parameters. When called with an id parameter, downloads the specified report as a binary file stream.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the report to download. When omitted, returns metadata for all available reports.

operations.name: edgeconnect_dns542
operations.summary: Get DNS resolver configuration for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the current DNS IP addresses (nameservers) and domain search names configured for a specific EdgeConnect appliance. Data can be retrieved from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role permissions.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval source. When 'true' (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator. When 'false', fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_rest_api_config_get543
operations.summary: Retrieve REST API configuration settings
operations.description: Retrieves the current REST API configuration settings from the database. The configuration is cached in memory for performance. If no configuration exists, default values are created and returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_rest_api_config_post544
operations.summary: Update REST API configuration for Orchestrator-EdgeConnect communication
operations.description: Updates Orchestrator-to-EdgeConnect communication settings. Changes are persisted to gms_config database table, cached in memory, and logged to audit trail with action 'Update REST API config'.

request_body.description: Configuration object for portal communication settings. The communicateWithApplianceViaPortal property defaults to true if omitted.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_rest_request_time_stats_details546
operations.summary: Get detailed REST request timing for a specific appliance and resource
operations.description: Retrieves detailed timing information for individual REST requests sent to a specific appliance and resource. Returns request-level data including response time, timeout status, and timestamp.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Base resource path to filter (e.g., 'webconfig'). Must match the resourceBase stored in the database.

parameters.name: portalWS
parameters.description: WebSocket connection type. True for portal WebSocket (channel=2), false for direct WebSocket (channel=1).

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: HTTP method to filter by. Must match method of recorded requests.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of time range as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Only requests on or after this time are included.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of time range as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Use 0 for current time.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_rest_request_time_stats_summary545
operations.summary: Get aggregated REST request timing statistics
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated REST request timing statistics grouped by appliance, resource path, and HTTP method. Includes min/avg/max response times and timeout counts for performance monitoring.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Base resource path to filter (e.g., 'webconfig', 'stats'). Use 'all' to include all resources.

parameters.name: portalWS
parameters.description: WebSocket connection type. True for portal WebSocket (channel=2), false for direct WebSocket (channel=1).

parameters.name: timedout
parameters.description: Filter by timeout status. True returns only timed-out requests, false returns only non-timed-out requests.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of time range as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Only requests on or after this time are included.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of time range as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Use 0 for current time.

operations.name: edgeconnect_apply_rma_wizard547
operations.summary: Apply RMA wizard to replace an existing appliance
operations.description: Initiates the RMA process to replace an existing appliance with a discovered appliance. The wizard performs: license revocation, old appliance shutdown, database migration, optional software upgrade/downgrade, and optional configuration restore.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: RMA wizard configuration containing existing appliance, discovered replacement appliance, optional backup, optional software image, and optional interface mapping.

operations.name: edgeconnect_check_interface_mapping
operations.summary: Validate interface mapping for RMA replacement
operations.description: Validates that interface mapping covers all required interfaces in the appliance deployment configuration. Checks standard interfaces (lan0, wan0), bonded interfaces (blan*, bwan*), PPPoE interfaces (ppp*), and bridge interfaces (bvi*). Returns validation status with detailed error messages for unmapped interfaces.

request_body.description: Interface mapping validation request containing appliance ID and mapping configuration

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_roles
operations.summary: Get All Roles
operations.description: Retrieves all configured segmentation roles or a filtered subset. Roles define Group Policy IDs (GPIDs) used for network segmentation. Default roles 'default' (ID: 0, GPID: 0) and 'unknown' (ID: 1, GPID: 65535) are always present.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Filter roles by name using a case-insensitive substring match. Only alphanumeric characters, dashes (-), and underscores (_) are allowed.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_roles
operations.summary: Save Roles Configuration
operations.description: Saves the complete roles configuration, replacing existing roles. Default roles (ID 0: 'default' with GPID 0, ID 1: 'unknown' with GPID 65535) are automatically added. Maximum 255 roles allowed including defaults. Deleting roles (by omission) cascades to: port profiles, templates, overlays, security policies, loopback configurations, and SSE connector pools/interfaces. The operation is atomic and synchronized.

request_body.description: Complete map of roles to save. Omitted roles from previous configuration will be deleted with cascading effects. Role IDs 0 and 1 are reserved for defaults and will be auto-populated.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_next_role_id
operations.summary: Get Next Available Role ID
operations.description: Returns the next available role ID for creating a new role. IDs 0 (default) and 1 (unknown) are reserved for system default roles. Valid custom role IDs range from 2-255 (max 254 custom roles). The algorithm scans existing roles starting from the last assigned ID, wrapping from 255 back to 2 when necessary to find an unused slot.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_route_labels
operations.summary: Get all route labels
operations.description: Retrieves all configured route labels from the GMS configuration. Returns a map of label IDs to label objects, always including the mandatory 'Internet' label (id=1).

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_route_labels
operations.summary: Create or update route labels
operations.description: Saves route labels to GMS configuration and triggers orchestration to apply changes to all appliances. The mandatory 'Internet' label (id=1, name='Internet', version=1) must always be included.

request_body.description: Map of route labels keyed by label ID (string). Each key must match the corresponding label's id field.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_label_next_id
operations.summary: Get next available route label ID
