operations.description: Retrieves the next available unique identifier for creating a new route label. The endpoint scans existing labels and returns the first unused ID in the valid range (2-127), wrapping around if necessary.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_label_version_counter
operations.summary: Get next version counter for route labels
operations.description: Retrieves the next available version number for assigning to new route labels. New labels must use a version >= this value to ensure uniqueness. Version 1 is permanently reserved for the mandatory 'Internet' label.

operations.name: edgeconnect_routemap548
operations.summary: Get route policy settings
operations.description: Retrieves route map (route policy) configuration for a specific appliance. Returns all route maps with their rules containing match criteria and set actions. Data can be fetched from Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Determines data source. When 'true' or omitted, returns cached data from Orchestrator. When 'false', fetches live data directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_sa_map
operations.summary: Get built-in policy information
operations.description: Retrieves built-in policies (SA Map) from a specific appliance. The SA Map contains traffic steering rules with match criteria and actions.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_sdwan_ai_chat_logs
operations.summary: Retrieve chat conversation history
operations.description: Retrieves the complete conversation history for the current user's active SD-WAN AI chat session. Returns all messages exchanged including questions, AI-generated answers, timestamps, and reference documents. Requires an active chat session initiated via /sdwanai/search.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sdwan_ai_clear_context
operations.summary: Clear chat context and reset conversation
operations.description: Clears the current SD-WAN AI chat context and resets the conversation. This operation closes the existing chat session, removes the chat ID mapping, clears cached configuration, and automatically creates a new session. Use this to start a fresh conversation without previous context.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_enable_sase_copilot
operations.summary: Get SASE Copilot enabled status
operations.description: Returns whether the SASE Copilot (AI assistant) feature is enabled on this Orchestrator. The setting is stored as an advance property with a default of false.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sdwan_ai_feedback
operations.summary: Submit feedback on an AI response
operations.description: Submits user feedback (rating) for a specific AI-generated response to improve AI quality. Requires an active chat session for the authenticated user. Authorization header is used to identify the user session.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Session authentication token used to identify the user and retrieve active chat session.

request_body.description: Feedback payload containing message identifier and rating

operations.name: edgeconnect_sdwan_ai_search
operations.summary: Query the SD-WAN AI assistant with natural language
operations.description: Sends a natural language query to the SD-WAN AI assistant and returns a streaming response. Supports conversation continuity via chat_id and tool execution results. Requires READ_WRITE role.

request_body.description: Search request with question or tool results

operations.name: edgeconnect_sdwan_ai_stop
operations.summary: Stop a SASE Copilot streaming response
operations.description: Stops an in-progress SASE Copilot AI streaming job by its job ID. The response is streamed as Server-Sent Events (SSE). Requires SASE Copilot to be enabled on the Orchestrator.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the job_id of the streaming job to stop.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_secure_web_services_config
operations.summary: Get Secure Web Services configuration for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the Secure Web Services configuration for a specified appliance, including URL classification and IP reputation settings. Also returns whether WebCC (Web Content Classification) is supported by the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Flag to retrieve cached configuration data. When set to 'true', returns cached data instead of fetching from the appliance directly.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_url_look_up
operations.summary: Lookup URL/IP classification and reputation from BrightCloud
operations.description: Queries BrightCloud API for URL/IP classification and reputation. Calls both getinfo (categories, primary category) and getrepinfo (reputation score, country, popularity, age, threat history) APIs and merges results. Requires WebCC credentials configured in GMS config database.

parameters.name: urlLookUp
parameters.description: URL or IP address to lookup for classification and reputation. Must be a valid URL (e.g., https://example.com) or IP address.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_advanced_security_settings550
operations.summary: Retrieve advanced security settings
operations.description: Returns the current advanced security settings configuration for the Orchestrator. These settings control security features like certificate verification, CSRF protection, and binary integrity checks across appliances. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_advanced_security_settings551
operations.summary: Update advanced security settings
operations.description: Updates the Orchestrator's advanced security settings for certificate verification, CSRF protection, and binary integrity checks. Requires READ_WRITE role. Changing verifyPortalCert triggers portal WebSocket reconnection.

request_body.description: Advanced security settings configuration object. All boolean fields default to false if null.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_cipher_profiles
operations.summary: Retrieve all cipher profiles
operations.description: Returns all cipher profiles configured in the Orchestrator. Profiles define cryptographic settings for TLS, SSH, tunnels, certificates, SNMP, NTP, and clustering. Only one profile can be active at a time. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_cipher_profile
operations.summary: Update an existing cipher profile
operations.description:
Updates an existing cipher profile with new cryptographic settings. The profile must be editable (built-in profiles like Default, FIPS, CSfC cannot be modified). If the profile is active, changes are immediately written to configuration files. Requires READ_WRITE role.

**Validation Rules:**
- Profile name: required, max 32 characters, must be unique
- Comments: optional, max 512 characters
- TLS cipher suites and named curves: required, use 'ALL' or specific values from /defaultCipherParameters
- TLS minDHParamKeySize: -1 (default) or 2048-4096 in 1024 increments
- Tunnel IKE minPskLength: 8-64 characters
- Certificate minRSAKeySize: -1, 2048, 3072, or 4096
- Certificate minEcKeyLen: -1, 256, 384, or 521
- All algorithm arrays must have at least one value

**Related Endpoints:**
- GET /defaultCipherParameters - retrieve valid algorithm values
- POST /validate - validate profile against appliance certificates
- POST /activate - activate a profile after updating

request_body.description: Complete cipher profile object with updated settings. The profile must exist (matching id) and be editable.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_cipher_profile
operations.summary: Delete a cipher profile
operations.description:
Permanently removes a user-created cipher profile from the Orchestrator. Built-in profiles (Default, FIPS, CSfC) cannot be deleted. Requires READ_WRITE role.

**Deletion Rules:**
- Profile must exist with the specified ID
- Profile must be editable (user-created, not built-in)
- Profile must not be currently active

**Before Deleting:**
- Ensure another profile is active if needed
- Use GET /security/cipherProfile to verify profile details
- Use POST /activate to switch active profiles if necessary

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the cipher profile to delete. Must reference an existing, editable, and inactive profile.

operations.name: edgeconnect_activate_cipher_profile
operations.summary: Activate a cipher profile
operations.description: Activates the specified cipher profile by ID. This operation deactivates all other profiles, sets the specified profile as active, writes the profile configuration to file, and updates NGINX TLS settings. Only one cipher profile can be active at a time.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the cipher profile to activate. Must reference an existing profile ID from the list of available cipher profiles.

operations.name: edgeconnect_show_active_cipher_profile
operations.summary: Retrieve the active cipher profile
operations.description: Returns the currently active cipher profile containing TLS, SSH, tunnel, certificate, SNMP, NTP, and cluster security settings. Returns null if no profile is active.

operations.name: edgeconnect_clone_cipher_profile
operations.summary: Clone an existing cipher profile
operations.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing cipher profile with a new unique ID. The cloned profile is named 'clone_of_<original_name>', set to inactive and editable, allowing modifications without affecting the original profile.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the cipher profile to clone. Must reference an existing profile ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_default_cipher_parameters
operations.summary: Retrieve default supported cipher parameters
operations.description: Returns all default cipher parameters used for validating cipher profile configurations. These parameters define the supported cryptographic algorithms across TLS, IPSec, SSH, SNMP, NTP, and certificate operations. Use this endpoint to discover available options when creating or updating cipher profiles.

operations.name: edgeconnect_validate_cipher_profile
operations.summary: Validate cipher profile against appliance certificate settings
operations.description: Validates the provided cipher profile configuration against an appliance's current HTTPS certificate settings. Checks certificate algorithm compatibility, key exchange requirements, and TLS cipher suite support.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

request_body.description: The cipher profile configuration to validate against the appliance's current settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_validate_cipher_profile_for_gms
operations.summary: Validate cipher profile against GMS certificate
operations.description: Validates the provided cipher profile settings against the current GMS HTTPS certificate. Checks if the certificate's key type, size, and algorithms are compatible with the profile's certificate settings. Returns success if compatible, or failure with details if validation fails.

request_body.description: The cipher profile configuration to validate against GMS certificate settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_protection_profiles
operations.summary: Retrieve DDoS protection profiles for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves DDoS protection profiles and profile-to-zone mappings for a specific appliance. Supports both cached and real-time data retrieval from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, returns cached data from database; when false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_end_entity_profiles
operations.summary: Retrieve all End Entity Profiles configured in the Orchestrator.
operations.description: Returns a complete list of End Entity Profiles used for certificate management in SD-WAN environments. These profiles define certificate enrollment parameters for appliances, including signing algorithms, EST server configurations, and certificate subject attributes. The system supports a maximum of 32 End Entity Profiles.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_end_entity_profile
operations.summary: Update an existing End Entity Profile's configuration.
operations.description: Updates an existing End Entity Profile identified by its label. The label field is used to match the profile to update and cannot be changed. All other fields can be modified including CSR attributes, EST server configurations, and certificate subject fields.

request_body.description: End Entity Profile configuration with updated values. The label must match an existing profile.

operations.name: edgeconnect_create_end_entity_profile
operations.summary: Create a new End Entity Profile for certificate enrollment configuration.
operations.description: Creates a new End Entity Profile used for certificate management in SD-WAN environments. The profile defines certificate enrollment parameters including CSR attributes, EST server configurations, and certificate subject fields. Maximum 32 profiles allowed. Label must be unique (case-insensitive).

request_body.description: End Entity Profile configuration object containing certificate enrollment settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_end_entity_profile
operations.summary: Delete an existing End Entity Profile by label.
operations.description: Removes an End Entity Profile from the Orchestrator. Deletion fails if the profile is referenced in Tunnel Settings, HTTPS certificate templates, or Logging templates. Remove all references before deleting.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Unique label identifier of the End Entity Profile to delete. Must match an existing profile (case-sensitive).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_est_config
operations.summary: Retrieve all EST server configurations
operations.description: Returns all EST (Enrollment over Secure Transport) server configurations stored in the system. EST is used for certificate enrollment and management. Passwords and challenge passwords are excluded from the response for security.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_est_config
operations.summary: Update an existing EST server configuration
operations.description: Updates an existing EST (Enrollment over Secure Transport) server configuration. The profile name must match an existing configuration. All validation rules from POST apply.

request_body.description: EST server configuration object with updated values. The 'name' field must match an existing profile.

operations.name: edgeconnect_insert_est_config
operations.summary: Create a new EST server configuration
operations.description: Creates a new EST (Enrollment over Secure Transport) server configuration for certificate enrollment. The system supports a maximum of 32 EST configurations. Returns an error if the profile name already exists or the maximum limit is reached.

request_body.description: EST server configuration object to create

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_est_config
operations.summary: Delete an existing EST server configuration
operations.description: Permanently removes an EST (Enrollment over Secure Transport) server configuration from the system. The profile cannot be deleted if it is referenced by any end entity profile.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique profile name of the EST configuration to delete. Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_security_maps
operations.summary: Retrieve Security Policies (Zone-Based Firewall Rules)
operations.description: Retrieves all security policy maps (zone-based firewall rules) configured on the specified appliance. Security maps define traffic filtering rules between security zones with allow/deny actions.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval source. When 'true' (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sessions553
operations.summary: Retrieve all current active user sessions
operations.description: Returns a list of all active user sessions on the Orchestrator. MTO server sessions are automatically filtered out from the response. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_delete_sessions554
operations.summary: Terminate active user sessions
operations.description: Forcefully terminates specified user sessions on the Orchestrator. Sessions are matched using the combination of 'username' and 'login_time' (UNIX timestamp in seconds as string). Each successful termination is logged as a system action. Requires READ_WRITE role.

request_body.description: Array of session identifiers to terminate. Each object must contain 'username' and 'login_time' fields for session matching.

operations.name: edgeconnect_acl555
operations.summary: Get shaper settings for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves WAN traffic shaper configuration for a specified appliance. Returns shaper settings including traffic class definitions, bandwidth allocation, and QoS parameters. Data can be retrieved from cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true (default), retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches real-time data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_shell_access_setting556
operations.summary: Get the current shell access security setting on Orchestrator
operations.description: Retrieves the current shell access setting configured on the Orchestrator. The setting controls SSH access security level across the system. Returns one of three possible values: 'open' (full shell access), 'lockdown_ssa' (Secure Shell Access enabled), or 'lockdown' (shell access disabled).

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_shell_access_setting557
operations.summary: Update the shell access security setting on Orchestrator
operations.description: Updates the SSH shell access security setting on the Orchestrator. Security level can only be increased (never decreased). Allowed transitions: 'open' (0) -> 'lockdown_ssa' (1) -> 'lockdown' (2). If the requested setting matches the current setting, returns 204 with no changes. Successful changes are logged as system actions with the authenticated user.

request_body.description: Shell access setting to apply. Must be more restrictive than or equal to the current setting.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_snat_maps
operations.summary: Get Inter-Segment SNAT Configurations
operations.description: Retrieves the Inter-Segment SNAT mapping configurations for a specified appliance. SNAT maps define address translation rules between network segments (VRFs).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance. Defaults to true if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_snmp_get559
operations.summary: Get SNMP configuration for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the complete SNMP configuration for a specified appliance. Returns SNMP agent settings including system contact, location, description, trap configuration, access community strings, and SNMPv3 user settings. Data can be retrieved from cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data source. When 'true', returns cached data from Orchestrator database (faster). When 'false', fetches real-time data directly from the appliance and updates the cache. Defaults to 'true' if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_account_key_change_count948
operations.summary: Get account key rotation count
operations.description: Retrieves the number of times the account key has been changed (rotated) from Cloud Portal. Supports both primary and secondary accounts. This endpoint requires Portal connectivity and fails in Air-Gap mode.

parameters.name: secondaryAccountName
parameters.description: Name of the secondary account to query. Leave empty or omit to query the primary account.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_account_key_change_status
operations.summary: Get account key change status
operations.description: Retrieves the timestamps for account key generation and commitment to Cloud Portal. Used to track progress of the account key rotation workflow. Returns status for primary account if no parameter provided, or for a specific secondary account if specified. Not available in Air-gap mode.

parameters.name: secondaryAccountName
parameters.description: Name of the secondary account to retrieve key change status for. Leave empty or omit to get primary account status.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_account_key_generate_put950
operations.summary: Generate a new Portal account key
operations.description: Requests the Cloud Portal to generate a new account key for the primary or a secondary account. Requires active Portal connectivity and is disabled in Air-gap mode. The old key is preserved for rollback purposes.

parameters.name: secondaryAccountName
parameters.description: Name of the secondary account to generate a key for. Leave empty or omit to generate a key for the primary account.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_ecsp_license_assign563
operations.summary: Assign EC-SP licenses to appliances on Portal
operations.description: Assigns EC-SP perpetual licenses to specific appliances by mapping appliance IDs to license IDs. The orchestrator must be registered with the Cloud Portal before using this endpoint. The request is forwarded to the portal's /v2/account/license/appliance/ecsp/assign endpoint.

request_body.description: JSON object containing an array of appliance-to-license mappings. Each mapping associates a portal appliance ID with an ECSP license ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_ecsp_licenses_get564
operations.summary: Get EC-SP license status from Portal
operations.description: Retrieves all EC-SP license assets for a subAccount from Cloud Portal, including appliance assignment status. Returns cached data when requested or fetches fresh data from Portal. Only works for subAccounts; parent accounts receive a 404 error.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns cached license data from OrchestrationStore if available. When false or omitted, fetches fresh data directly from Cloud Portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_ecsp_license_unassign565
operations.summary: Unassign EC-SP licenses on Portal
operations.description: Revokes or unassigns one or more EC-SP (EdgeConnect Service Provider) licenses from appliances on the Cloud Portal. The Orchestrator must be registered with the Portal before this operation can be performed.

request_body.description: JSON object containing an array of license IDs to be unassigned from appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_account_license_feature_get566
operations.summary: Get account license features from Portal
operations.description: Retrieves the list of license features for the account registered with the Cloud Portal. Returns cached data if Portal is unreachable. Returns an empty array if the Orchestrator is not registered with Portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_account_license_type_get567
operations.summary: Get account license type from Portal
operations.description: Retrieves the license type for the Portal account with which the Orchestrator is registered. Returns cached data or fetches directly from Portal based on the cached parameter. In Air-Gap mode, returns cached data if available.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns cached license type data from OrchestrationStore if available. When false or omitted, fetches fresh data from Portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_delete_old_key_secondary951
operations.summary: Delete old account key from Portal
operations.description: Commits a previous account key rotation by deleting the old key from the Portal. This is the final step in the key rotation workflow after all managed appliances have been updated with the new key. The operation removes the old key from both the Portal and the local Orchestrator configuration, and updates the key change status timestamp. This endpoint is not available when Air-gap mode is enabled.

parameters.name: secondaryAccountName
parameters.description: Name of the secondary account to delete old key for. When omitted or empty, operates on the primary account.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_account_secondary_post579
operations.summary: Update secondary accounts configuration for Cloud Portal registration
operations.description: Replaces the entire secondary accounts configuration with the provided configuration and triggers registration with the Cloud Portal. Use this endpoint to manage multi-account setups where the Orchestrator needs to register with multiple portal accounts.

request_body.description: Map of secondary account configurations where keys are account names and values are account details.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_app_express_app_config_template
operations.summary: Get default AppExpress application configurations from Cloud Portal
operations.description: Retrieves all default/HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect Cloud Portal AppExpress application configurations. These configurations define how applications are monitored and steered using AppExpress technology. Returns an empty object {} if no default configurations exist.

operations.name: edgeconnect_check_appliance_reachability_using_ws_get569
operations.summary: Check appliance WebSocket reachability
operations.description: Tests appliance WebSocket connectivity by calling /hello on the appliance via portal WebSocket and /helloDirectWS via direct WebSocket. Returns reachability status for both connection paths.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application_tags
operations.summary: Get application groups from portal
operations.description: Retrieves application groups (tags) that are synced from Cloud Portal. These groups categorize applications for traffic management and QoS policies. If no data is cached, triggers a background job to fetch from portal and returns an empty object. If a previous sync job encountered errors, automatically retriggers the sync.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application_tags_info
operations.summary: Get application tags version hash
operations.description: Retrieves the hash code (version identifier) for application tags data synced from the Cloud Portal. This hash is used to detect changes in application group definitions for AVC (Application Visibility and Control). If no data exists, returns '0' and triggers a background job to fetch data from the portal. If a previous fetch job encountered errors, it automatically retries.

operations.name: edgeconnect_broadcast_message_get572
operations.summary: Get Broadcast Messages from Portal
operations.description: Retrieves broadcast messages from the HPE Aruba Portal that are stored locally in the Orchestrator. Messages are fetched periodically from the portal by a background job and cached in the GMS configuration store. Expired messages are automatically filtered out.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_compound_classification
operations.summary: Get compound application classification definitions from portal
operations.description: Retrieves compound application classification definitions from the local cache, which is synchronized with Cloud Portal. These definitions are used for advanced traffic classification based on multiple criteria (IP, port, DNS, geo-location, protocol, etc.). If no data exists locally, a background job is triggered to fetch data from Cloud Portal and an empty object is returned. If a previous sync job failed, it will be re-triggered automatically.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_compound_classification_info
operations.summary: Get compound classification version hash
operations.description: Retrieves the hash code (version identifier) for compound application classification data from the Cloud Portal. This hash is used to detect changes in compound classification definitions. If no data exists or a previous sync job failed, this endpoint automatically triggers the COMPOUND_CLASSIFICATION background job to fetch updated data from the portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_config_get575
operations.summary: Retrieve Cloud Portal registration configuration
operations.description: Returns the HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect Cloud Portal registration settings including host, port, primary registration details, and secondary accounts. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_config_post576
operations.summary: Update Cloud Portal registration configuration
operations.description: Updates the HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect Cloud Portal registration settings. Secondary accounts are automatically retained from existing configuration. Triggers the Orchestrator usage job in container environments and resets encryption keys for trust handshake.

request_body.description: Cloud Portal configuration object with host, port, and registration details

operations.name: edgeconnect_connectivity_get577
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator to Silver Peak Cloud Portal connectivity status
operations.description: Checks the connectivity between the Orchestrator and the Silver Peak Cloud Portal by pinging the portal's health endpoint. In Air-gap mode, always returns 0 (unable to connect) without attempting connectivity check.

operations.name: edgeconnect_portal_connectivity_appliances
operations.summary: Check appliance connectivity to Cloud Portal
operations.description: Initiates an asynchronous connectivity test from all managed appliances to the specified Cloud Portal URL. Each appliance attempts to reach the portal using a URL download test with a 30-second timeout. Use the returned clientKey to poll for action results.

parameters.name: portalUrl
parameters.description: The Cloud Portal hostname or URL that appliances will attempt to connect to. Must not be empty.

operations.name: edgeconnect_portal_connectivity_orchestrator
operations.summary: Test Orchestrator to Cloud Portal connectivity
operations.description: Tests connectivity from Orchestrator to a specified Cloud Portal URL. The endpoint uses the provided portalUrl combined with the stored port configuration to attempt a connection to the Portal's hello endpoint. Returns an integer status: 0 = Unable to connect (connection failed or server error), 1 = Connected (HTTP response status < 500).

parameters.name: portalUrl
parameters.description: The Portal hostname/URL to test connectivity against. The Orchestrator will combine this with its stored port configuration to construct the full Portal URL.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_create_case_post578
operations.summary: Create a technical support case
operations.description: Creates a technical support case on Salesforce through the Cloud Portal. The case is stored locally in the salesforcecases table after successful creation. For Orchestrator cases, leave orchSerialNum empty; for appliance cases, provide the nePk.

request_body.description: Case information for creating a support case via Cloud Portal

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_dns_classification
operations.summary: Get DNS-based application classification definitions
operations.description: Retrieves DNS-based application classification definitions from the Orchestrator database. These mappings define how domain names are classified into applications for traffic analysis. If no data exists or a previous job had errors, the DNS classification job is triggered automatically to fetch data from the cloud portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_dns_classification_info
operations.summary: Get DNS classification version hash
operations.description: Retrieves the hash value (version identifier) for DNS classification data from the Cloud Portal. This endpoint is used to check if DNS-based application classification data needs to be updated. If no data exists, the DNS_CLASSIFICATION background job is triggered automatically. If a previous job encountered errors, it will be re-triggered.

operations.name: edgeconnect_geo_location_get582
operations.summary: Get geolocation for single IP address
operations.description: Retrieves geolocation information for a single IP address from the cloud portal. The IP must be provided as a 32-bit unsigned integer representation. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IP address to geolocate, provided as a 32-bit unsigned integer (0 to 4294967295). Convert standard IPv4 notation to integer format.

operations.name: edgeconnect_geo_location_post581
operations.summary: Batch geolocation lookup for multiple IP addresses
operations.description: Retrieves geolocation data for multiple IP addresses from the cloud portal in a single request. IPs are internally processed in batches of 10 for optimal portal communication. The action is logged for audit purposes. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

request_body.description: JSON array of IP addresses as 32-bit unsigned integers (0-4294967295). Must contain at least one IP. Large lists are automatically partitioned into batches of 10 for portal processing.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ip_intelligence_tmp_get583
operations.summary: Get IP Intelligence Data for Address Map
operations.description: Retrieves a paginated array of IP intelligence classification entries. Data includes IP ranges, service identifiers, geographic information, and organization details. If no data exists and pagination starts from the beginning, the system automatically triggers a background job to fetch data from the portal.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The starting offset for pagination. Values less than 0 are automatically adjusted to 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return. Values <= 0 or > 10000 default to 10000.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ip_intelligence_update_time
operations.summary: Get IP Intelligence data last update timestamp
operations.description: Retrieves the last update timestamp for IP Intelligence data from the portal. This timestamp serves as a version identifier for Address Map application definition data. If no data exists, the InternetDB background job is triggered automatically to fetch data from the cloud portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_search_ip_intelligence_tmp
operations.summary: Search IP intelligence data for Address Map
operations.description: Searches IP intelligence database entries. When filter parameter is provided, performs a text search on app name, description, country, and organization fields (case-insensitive, limited to 5000 results). When only ip parameter is provided, searches for entries containing that IP address.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 address as a 32-bit unsigned integer (0 to 4294967295). Ignored if filter parameter is provided. Searches for IP intelligence entries where the IP falls within the ip_start and ip_end range.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Text search string (case-insensitive) to match against app name, description, country, organization, and subattributes. Takes priority over ip parameter when both are provided. Special characters '_' and '%' are escaped automatically.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ip_intelligence_tmp_total586
operations.summary: Get IP intelligence record count
operations.description: Returns the total number of IP intelligence entries in the database. Use this to check data availability before querying IP intelligence details or for pagination purposes.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_id_to_saas_id_get587
operations.summary: Get service ID to SaaS application details mapping
operations.description: Retrieves a mapping of service IDs to SaaS application details from the Internet Database. Each service ID maps to an array containing: [serviceId, saasId, country, countryCode, org, saasAppName, displayName, priority]. If the database is empty, returns {} and triggers a background job to populate it. Filter priority: serviceIds > matchAny > org > no filter (returns top results).

parameters.name: matchAny
parameters.description: Case-insensitive wildcard match on country, org, and saasAppName fields. Takes priority over 'org' parameter when both are provided.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Case-insensitive wildcard match on organization name only. Ignored if 'matchAny' is provided.

parameters.name: serviceIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of service IDs to retrieve. When provided, returns exact matches for the specified IDs only, ignoring other filter parameters.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 100 if not specified. Ignored when 'serviceIds' parameter is provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_id_to_saas_id_count_get588
operations.summary: Get Internet Service Mapping Count
operations.description: Retrieves the total count of service ID to SaaS ID mappings in the IP Intelligence database. If the database is empty, triggers a background job to fetch data from the portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_id_to_saas_id_countries_get589
operations.summary: Get unique countries from the internet services database
operations.description: Retrieves a map of unique countries from the IP intelligence database. Each country maps to service details including serviceId, saasId, country name, country code, organization, SaaS application name, display name, and priority. If IP intelligence data is not loaded, returns an empty object and triggers a background data sync job.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_id_to_saas_id_saas_app_get590
operations.summary: Get unique SaaS application names
operations.description: Retrieves a list of unique SaaS (Software as a Service) application names from the IP Intelligence database. The list includes both system-defined and user-defined SaaS applications. If the database is empty, an empty array is returned and a background job is triggered to fetch the data.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ip_protocol_numbers_get591
operations.summary: Get IP Protocol Numbers mapping data
operations.description: Retrieves the list of IP protocol numbers and their corresponding names/descriptions. Data is periodically synced from the Cloud Portal via a scheduled background job. If data is not available locally, this endpoint triggers an immediate sync job and returns an empty object. Common protocols include TCP (6), UDP (17), ICMP (1), GRE (47), etc.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_meter_flow_classification
operations.summary: Get Meter Flow Classification definitions for DPI application identification
operations.description: Retrieves meter flow classification definitions (v2 format) from the Orchestrator database. If data is unavailable, automatically triggers the METER_FLOW_CLASSIFICATION job to fetch from Cloud Portal. Also re-runs the job if a previous alarm exists indicating a prior failure.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_meter_flow_classification_info
operations.summary: Get meter flow classification version hash
operations.description: Retrieves the hash code (version identifier) for meter flow classification data from the portal. The hash value serves as a version number to detect changes in application definition data. If no data exists, returns '0' and automatically triggers the METER_FLOW_CLASSIFICATION background job to fetch fresh data. If a previous job encountered an error, this endpoint re-triggers the job.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_port_protocol_classification_template
operations.summary: Get port and protocol to application classification mappings
operations.description: Retrieves port and protocol classification data for application visibility and control (AVC). This data maps IP protocols, TCP ports, and UDP ports to application definitions. If no data exists in the local database, it triggers a background job (PORT_PROTOCOL_CLASSIFICATION) to fetch data from the cloud portal. If a previous fetch job failed (indicated by an alarm), the job is automatically re-triggered.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_port_protocol_classification_info
operations.summary: Get port protocol classification version hash
operations.description: Retrieves the hash code (version identifier) for port protocol classification data, which includes IP Protocol, TCP Port, and UDP Port mappings. This hash is used for cache validation and synchronization with Cloud Portal. If no data exists locally, the endpoint returns '0' and triggers a background job to fetch classification data from the portal. If a previous fetch job failed (alarm exists), it automatically retries.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_portal_registration_get596
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator-Portal registration status
operations.description: Retrieves the current registration status between Orchestrator and Cloud Portal. Returns registration state for both primary and secondary accounts. Use this endpoint to poll registration status after initiating registration via POST.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_portal_registration_post597
operations.summary: Initiate Orchestrator-Portal Registration
operations.description: Resets Orchestrator-Portal registration state and initiates a new registration cycle. No request body required. Portal credentials must be configured via /gmsConfig/spPortal before calling. Registration may take up to 2 minutes; poll GET /spPortal/registration for status.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_portal_registration_secondary_account_get597
operations.summary: Get secondary account Portal registration status
operations.description: Retrieves the current registration status of all configured secondary accounts with the Cloud Portal. Use this endpoint to poll for registration completion after initiating registration via POST. The response includes global status flags and per-account details.

operations.name: edgeconnect_gms_portal_registration_post598
operations.summary: Initiate secondary account Portal registration
operations.description: Initiates a new registration cycle with Cloud Portal for all configured secondary accounts. Resets current registration state, clears cached emails and error messages, and triggers an asynchronous background registration process. No request body is required. Configure secondary account credentials via POST /spPortal/account/secondary before calling this endpoint. Registration runs in background; poll GET endpoint to check completion.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_saas_classification_template
operations.summary: Get SaaS application classification definitions from portal
operations.description: Retrieves SaaS cloud application classification definitions from portal data stored in the Orchestrator database. If no data exists, automatically triggers the SAAS_CLASSIFICATION background job to fetch data from portal. If a previous job encountered errors, re-triggers the job. Returns an empty object {} while data is being fetched.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_saas_classification_template_info
operations.summary: Get SaaS classification data version hash
operations.description: Retrieves the hash value representing the current version of SaaS classification data. This hash serves as a version identifier to detect when SaaS application definitions have been updated from the cloud portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_sp_portal_status_get600
operations.summary: Get Portal Services Status
operations.description: Returns the current operational status of all Cloud Portal related services running on the Orchestrator. This is a debug API useful for monitoring connectivity and health of Portal integration services including trust establishment, registration, WebSocket connection, ZTP, phone home, account key management, secondary account registration, and AAS license token services.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tcp_udp_ports
operations.summary: Retrieve TCP/UDP port to application mappings
operations.description: Returns a mapping of TCP and UDP ports to their associated applications for traffic classification. If data is not cached locally, triggers a background job to fetch from the Cloud Portal.

operations.name: edgeconnect_top_sites_get602
operations.summary: Get top internet sites list
operations.description: Retrieves a cached list of top internet site domain names fetched from HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect Cloud Portal. If no cached data exists, triggers a background job to fetch from portal and returns an empty array.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_traffic_behavior
operations.summary: Get traffic behavior categories and configuration
operations.description: Retrieves traffic behavior classification categories and configuration from the cloud portal. The data is cached locally and synchronized periodically with the portal. If no cached data exists, a background job is triggered to fetch the latest data and an empty object is returned immediately. Traffic behavior categories include: Voice, Video conferencing, Video Streaming, Bulk Data, Interactive, Idle, and Undetermined.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_traffic_behavior_info
operations.summary: Get traffic behavior category version hash from Cloud Portal
operations.description: Retrieves the hash code (version identifier) for traffic behavior category data from the Cloud Portal. This hash value serves as a version number to detect changes in traffic behavior categories. If no data exists, the system automatically triggers a background job (TRAFFIC_BEHAVIOR_JOB) to fetch the latest data from the portal and returns a default hash of '0'.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ztp605
operations.summary: Get Zero Touch Provisioning configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) configuration from the database. The configuration controls whether hardware appliances require manual provisioning with Account Name and Account Key for discovery.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_ztp606
operations.summary: Update Zero Touch Provisioning configuration
operations.description: Updates the Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) configuration to control whether hardware appliances require manual provisioning. When enabled, appliances must be manually configured with Account Name and Account Key before discovery.

request_body.description: ZTP configuration object with manual provisioning setting

operations.name: edgeconnect_download_sse_image
operations.summary: Download SSE connector image file
operations.description: Streams the SSE connector image binary file identified by a one-time-use hash. This endpoint is unauthenticated (@PermitAll) and intended for secure download link distribution.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: UUID hash identifying the image download link.

operations.name: edgeconnect_download_sse_release_notes
operations.summary: Download SSE connector release notes
operations.description: Streams the release notes for a given SSE connector image version. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Connector image version to retrieve release notes for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ssl_certs_get607
operations.summary: Get all SSL certificates on the appliance
operations.description: Retrieves SSL certificate configuration and state information from an appliance. Returns data either from the Orchestrator cache or directly from the appliance based on the cached parameter.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Determines data source. When 'true' (default), retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ssl_ca_certs610
operations.summary: Get all CA SSL certificates from an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves all SSL CA certificates configured on the specified appliance. Data can be fetched from the GMS cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data source: 'true' retrieves from GMS cache, 'false' fetches directly from appliance. Defaults to 'true' if not provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ssl_ca_cert_get_text_post608
operations.summary: Get CA certificate full text representation
operations.description: Parses the provided SSL CA certificate and returns its human-readable text representation. Supports both PEM and PFX (PKCS12) certificate formats.

request_body.description: SSL CA certificate data for text extraction

operations.name: edgeconnect_ssl_ca_cert_validation609
operations.summary: Validate SSL CA certificate
operations.description: Validates an SSL CA certificate and extracts certificate information. Supports PEM and PFX (PKCS12) formats. For non-CA certificates, validates that the private key matches the certificate.

request_body.description: SSL certificate data for validation

operations.name: edgeconnect_ssl_cert_get_info_post611
operations.summary: Parse SSL certificate and extract information
operations.description: Parses a Base64-encoded SSL certificate (PEM or PFX format) and returns extracted certificate details including issuer, subject, and expiration date. For non-CA certificates, validates that the private key matches the certificate.

request_body.description: SSL certificate data for parsing and information extraction

operations.name: edgeconnect_ssl_cert_get_text_post612
operations.summary: Get SSL certificate full text representation
operations.description: Parses the provided SSL certificate and returns its human-readable text representation including version, serial number, issuer DN, validity dates, subject DN, and public key information. Supports both PEM and PFX (PKCS12) formats with optional encryption.

request_body.description: SSL certificate data for text extraction. Supports encrypted payloads with optional randomizer for GCM-IV decryption.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ssl_substitute_cert_get614
operations.summary: Get SSL Substitute Certificate Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the SSL substitute certificate configuration from a specified appliance. SSL substitute certificates are used for SSL/TLS interception and certificate substitution in traffic optimization scenarios.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When 'true' or omitted, returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance (slower but up-to-date).

operations.name: edgeconnect_ssl_substitute_cert_validation613
operations.summary: Validate SSL Substitute Certificate
operations.description: Validates an SSL substitute certificate by parsing and verifying its format, expiration, and key-certificate match. Supports both PFX/PKCS12 and PEM certificate formats. For non-CA PEM certificates, validates that the provided private key matches the certificate.

request_body.description: SSL certificate validation request containing Base64-encoded certificate data and validation parameters.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application2_aggregated_stats
operations.summary: Get aggregate application stats by appliance, group, or all
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated application bandwidth statistics for appliances. Supports three query modes: single appliance (nePk), group (groupPk), or all appliances. Returns LAN/WAN byte and packet counts per application.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (milliseconds) for the start of the data time range. Must be >= 0 and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (milliseconds) for the end of the data time range. Must be >= 0 and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Filter results by application name. Case-sensitive match.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Limit results to top N applications sorted by throughput.

parameters.name: groupPk
parameters.description: Internal group ID for filtering stats by appliance group. Used when nePk is not provided.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Use 'csv' for CSV export. Omit for JSON response.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: Group results by appliance (nePk). Default is true. When true, response includes appliance identifiers in nested structure.

parameters.name: lastHour
parameters.description: When true, fetches data from one hour prior if no data exists in the specified time range. Useful for recent data queries.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application2_aggregated_stats_by_post
operations.summary: Get aggregate application stats for multiple appliances
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated application bandwidth statistics for a list of appliances specified in the request body. Returns LAN and WAN byte/packet counts per application for each appliance. Use this endpoint when querying stats for multiple specific appliances rather than by group.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (milliseconds) marking the start of the query time range. Must be non-negative and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (milliseconds) marking the end of the query time range. Must be non-negative and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Filter results to a specific application name. Case-sensitive exact match. If omitted, returns stats for all applications.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Return only the top N applications by total throughput. Useful for identifying highest bandwidth consumers.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format for the response. Set to 'csv' for CSV file download. Omit or use any other value for JSON response.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: Group results by appliance identifier. When true (default), each result includes the nePk field. When false, results are aggregated across all specified appliances.

parameters.name: lastHour
parameters.description: Enable automatic retry with shifted time range. When true and no data found, the query retries with startTime and endTime shifted back by 3600000ms (1 hour).

request_body.description: JSON object containing the list of appliance IDs to query. The nePks array must contain at least one valid appliance ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_reachability_stats
operations.summary: Get aggregated appliance reachability statistics
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated appliance reachability statistics showing portal, orchestrator, and appliance connectivity metrics. Validates appliance version compatibility (requires 9.5.0, 9.4.2, 9.3.4 or higher). Data is retrieved from ClickHouse database tables (dailyappliancereachability or monthlyappliancereachability) based on granularity.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Query date in YYYY-MM-DD format. For 'month' granularity, use first day of month (e.g., '2024-01-01').

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time aggregation period. 'day' returns daily stats, 'week' returns weekly stats, 'month' returns monthly stats.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_interface_availability_stats
operations.summary: Get aggregated interface availability statistics for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated interface availability statistics for a specific appliance. Returns downtime duration and sample counts for each interface grouped by label and traffic type. Requires appliance version 9.5.0, 9.4.2, 9.3.4 or higher for full support.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date for which to retrieve statistics. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. For month granularity, use first day of month (e.g., '2024-01-01').

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time period aggregation level. Determines how statistics are aggregated and which database table is queried.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_network_role_availability_aggregate_stats
operations.summary: Get network role availability aggregate stats
operations.description: Retrieves network role availability aggregate statistics for appliances in the network. Statistics are aggregated by overlay ID, tunnel type, label (network role), and service name. Requires appliance version 9.5.0, 9.4.2, 9.3.4 or higher for full functionality.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Data granularity filter. Use 'day' for daily stats, 'week' for weekly aggregation, or 'month' for monthly stats.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. For 'month' granularity, use the first day of the month (e.g., 2024-01-01).

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Overlay/tunnel filter. Use '0' for underlay (physical) tunnels, 'all' for all bonded (overlay) tunnels, or a specific numeric overlay ID.

parameters.name: isGroupByNe
parameters.description: When true, groups statistics by appliance (nePk). When false, filters stats for the specified nePk only. Default is false.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnel_availability_stats
operations.summary: Get tunnel availability aggregate stats for a single appliance
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated tunnel availability statistics for a single appliance. Data is grouped by overlayId and includes metrics like blackout, brownout, and IPSLA durations. Requires appliance version 9.3.4, 9.4.2, or 9.5.0 or higher for full support.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date for statistics retrieval. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. For month granularity, use first day of month (e.g., '2022-12-01').

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time granularity for data aggregation. Use 'day' for daily stats, 'week' for weekly stats, or 'month' for monthly stats.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Overlay filter for tunnel types. Use '0' for all physical/underlay tunnels, 'all' for all bonded/overlay tunnels, or a specific overlay ID for a particular overlay.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnel_service_availability_aggregated_stats
operations.summary: Get aggregated tunnel availability statistics for third-party services
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated tunnel availability statistics for third-party services. Returns metrics including total downtime (tunnel_state), blackout periods, brownout periods, and IPSLA violations during business hours. Data is grouped by tunnel name, tunnel ID, tunnel type, label, and service name.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date for statistics retrieval in YYYY-MM-DD format. For 'month' granularity, use the first day of the month (e.g., 2024-01-01).

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Filter by overlay ID. Use '0' for physical tunnels, 'all' or '-1' for all bonded tunnels, or a specific overlay ID number.

parameters.name: tunType
parameters.description: Tunnel type filter. Use 3 for third-party service tunnels. Valid values: 0 (SD-WAN), 1 (Underlay), 2 (Breakout/Pass-through), 3 (Services).

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time granularity for data aggregation. Determines which database table is queried and how data is grouped.

parameters.name: serviceName
parameters.description: Filter by service provider name. Performs prefix matching (LIKE 'serviceName%'). Optional parameter for filtering results.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aggregate_boost_stats_single_appliance
operations.summary: Get Boost stats for single appliance
operations.description: Retrieves WAN Optimization (Boost) aggregate statistics for a single appliance. Returns bandwidth optimization metrics within the specified time range.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time in seconds since EPOCH. Must be >= 0 and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time in seconds since EPOCH. Must be >= 0 and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time-based aggregation level. Controls grouping interval for statistics.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Set to 'csv' for downloadable CSV file.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: Group results by appliance. When true, includes nePk in response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aggregate_boost_stats
operations.summary: Get Boost stats for multiple appliances
operations.description: Retrieves WAN Optimization (Boost) aggregate statistics for multiple appliances. Submit appliance IDs in the request body to get bandwidth optimization metrics.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time in seconds since EPOCH. Must be >= 0 and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time in seconds since EPOCH. Must be >= 0 and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: granularity
