parameters.description: Source IP address to filter traffic statistics. When provided, returns traffic split by destination for this source.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_traffic_behavior_aggregated_stats
operations.summary: Get traffic behavioral stats by query parameters
operations.description: Retrieves aggregate traffic behavioral statistics. Traffic is classified into behavioral categories (Business, Recreational, Streaming, General). When nePk is provided, returns stats for a single appliance. When nePk is omitted, returns stats for all appliances or filtered by groupPk. The isAggregated parameter controls whether to return category-level summaries or detailed per-application breakdowns.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time in Unix epoch seconds. Must be non-negative and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time in Unix epoch seconds. Must be non-negative and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: behavioralCate
parameters.description: Filter by behavioral category name. Common values: Business, Recreational, Streaming, General.

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Filter by application name to retrieve stats for a specific application within the category.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Limit results to top N entries ranked by traffic volume. Useful for dashboard displays.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: Include appliance-level breakdown in response. Only used when nePk is provided. Default: true.

parameters.name: groupPk
parameters.description: Appliance group ID to filter stats. Used when nePk is not provided to query by group.

parameters.name: isAggregated
parameters.description: When true, returns aggregated summary stats. When false, returns detailed per-application stats. Default: false.

parameters.name: lastHour
parameters.description: If no data in last hour, fetch from one hour earlier. Useful for recent data queries. Default: false.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Use 'csv' for downloadable CSV file.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_traffic_behavioral_aggregated_stats_by_post
operations.summary: Get traffic behavioral stats for multiple appliances
operations.description: Retrieves aggregate traffic behavioral statistics for multiple appliances specified in the request body. Use this endpoint to query stats for a specific list of appliances. The isAggregated parameter controls whether to return category-level summaries or detailed per-application breakdowns. Note: groupByNE parameter is not used in POST method.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time in Unix epoch seconds. Must be non-negative and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time in Unix epoch seconds. Must be non-negative and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: behavioralCate
parameters.description: Filter by behavioral category name. Common values: Business, Recreational, Streaming, General.

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Filter by application name to retrieve stats for a specific application within the category.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Use 'CSV' for downloadable CSV file (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Limit results to top N entries ranked by traffic volume. Useful for dashboard displays.

parameters.name: lastHour
parameters.description: If no data in last hour, fetch from one hour earlier. Useful for recent data queries. Default: false.

parameters.name: isAggregated
parameters.description: When true, returns aggregated summary stats by category. When false, returns detailed per-application stats. Default: false.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: Include appliance-level breakdown in response. Only used when nePk is provided. Default: true.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the list of appliance identifiers (nePks) to retrieve statistics for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_traffic_class_aggregated_stats
operations.summary: Get aggregated traffic class statistics filtered by query parameters
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated traffic class statistics for a single appliance or group of appliances. Response structure varies based on query parameters. Use nePk for single appliance stats, groupPk for group stats, or omit both for all appliances.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: groupPk
parameters.description: Group primary key to filter appliances. Used when nePk is not provided to retrieve stats for all appliances in a group.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (milliseconds) for the start of the data time range. Must be >= 0 and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (milliseconds) for the end of the data time range. Must be >= 0 and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time interval granularity for data aggregation. Determines whether stats are aggregated by minute, hour, or day.

parameters.name: trafficClass
parameters.description: Filter statistics by traffic class (QoS priority level). Valid range: 1-10, where 1 is highest priority.

parameters.name: trafficType
parameters.description: Filter by traffic optimization type. 'optimized_traffic' for WAN-optimized flows, 'pass_through_shaped' for shaped pass-through, 'pass_through_unshaped' for unshaped pass-through, 'all_traffic' for combined stats.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: When true, groups statistics by appliance with nePk/IP as the key. Default is true.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: When true, uses IP address as the grouping key instead of internal appliance ID (nePk).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric to sort results by. Required when using the 'top' parameter to limit results.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Limits results to top N items sorted by the specified metric. Requires the 'metric' parameter to be set.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. When set to 'csv', returns data as a downloadable CSV file instead of JSON.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_traffic_class_aggregated_stats_by_post
operations.summary: Get aggregated traffic class statistics for multiple appliances via POST
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated traffic class statistics for specified appliances. Use POST to query a specific set of appliances by nePk. Parameters are validated in order: metric/top dependency, granularity, trafficType, trafficClass, nePks existence, then time range.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of data time range in EPOCH milliseconds. Must be >= 0 and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of data time range in EPOCH milliseconds. Must be >= 0 and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time interval for data aggregation. Case-insensitive (e.g., 'MINUTE', 'Hour').

parameters.name: trafficClass
parameters.description: Filter by QoS traffic class priority level (1=highest). When omitted, returns all traffic classes.

parameters.name: trafficType
parameters.description: Filter by traffic optimization type. Case-insensitive. When omitted, returns all traffic types.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Use IP address as grouping key instead of nePk. Affects response structure when groupByNE=true.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric for sorting results. Required when 'top' is specified.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Return only top N results sorted by metric. Requires 'metric' parameter.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Set to 'csv' for downloadable Excel-compatible file.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: Group statistics by appliance. When true (default), response is keyed by nePk or IP.

request_body.description: List of appliance IDs (nePks) to query. All nePks must exist in GMS.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnel_aggregated_stats
operations.summary: Get aggregated tunnel statistics
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated tunnel statistics for a single appliance or group of appliances. Results can be filtered by tunnel name, overlay type, and time range. Supports sorting by various metrics and limiting results with the 'top' parameter.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Starting time boundary as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be non-negative and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Ending time boundary as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be greater than startTime.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time granularity for data aggregation. Determines the resolution of the returned statistics.

parameters.name: groupPk
parameters.description: Internal group ID to filter stats for appliances within that group. Only used when nePk is not provided.

parameters.name: tunnelName
parameters.description: Filter results to a specific tunnel by name.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: When true, uses IP address as the grouping key instead of internal appliance ID (nePk).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric to sort results by. Required when using 'top' parameter.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Number of top results to return when sorting by metric. Requires 'metric' parameter to be specified.

parameters.name: overlay
parameters.description: Filter tunnels by overlay type. 'all' returns bonded tunnels; '0' returns physical tunnels; specific ID returns tunnels for that overlay; omit to return all tunnels.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Use 'csv' for CSV file download.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: When true, groups stats by appliance with nested structure. When false, returns flat stats.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnel_aggregated_stats_by_post
operations.summary: Get aggregated tunnel statistics for multiple appliances
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated tunnel statistics for multiple appliances specified in the request body. Use this endpoint when querying stats for more than one appliance. Supports filtering by overlay type, sorting by metric, and CSV export.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of time range as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be >= 0 and < endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of time range as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be > startTime.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time granularity for aggregation. Valid values: minute, hour, day, month. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: When true, uses IP address as grouping key instead of nePk. Default: false.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric for sorting and filtering top results. Required if 'top' is specified. Must be non-empty when provided.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Limit results to top N entries sorted by metric. Requires 'metric' parameter. Must be >= 1.

parameters.name: overlay
parameters.description: Filter by overlay type. 'all' = bonded tunnels, '0' = physical tunnels, specific ID = tunnels for that overlay. Omit to include all.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. Set to 'csv' for downloadable CSV file (Content-Type: application/vnd.ms-excel).

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: When true, groups results by appliance in nested structure. When false, returns flat list. Default: true.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the list of appliance identifiers (nePks) to retrieve statistics for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_user2_aggregated_stats_by_post
operations.summary: Retrieve aggregated user statistics for specified appliances
operations.description: Fetches aggregated user statistics for the specified appliances within a time range. Supports filtering by user name, top N users by throughput, and optional CSV export. The endpoint can retry with a 1-hour offset if no data is found and lastHour is enabled.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of the time range as Unix epoch timestamp in seconds. Must be >= 0 and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of the time range as Unix epoch timestamp in seconds. Must be >= 0 and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Filter results by specific user name. If omitted, returns stats for all users.

parameters.name: groupByNE
parameters.description: Groups statistics by appliance (Network Element). When true, response includes an extra level with appliance identifiers as keys. Default is true.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Limits results to top N users ranked by throughput. If not specified, returns all users.

parameters.name: lastHour
parameters.description: If true and no data found in the specified time range, retries query with timestamps shifted back by 1 hour.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. Use 'csv' for CSV file download, otherwise returns JSON.

request_body.description: List of appliance Network Element Primary Keys (nePks) to query statistics for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_availability_time_settings_post1
operations.summary: Configure appliance business hours for KPI availability calculations
operations.description: Creates or updates business hour configurations (KPI Time Settings) for one or more appliances. Validates all parameters including nePk existence, hour ranges (0-23), and timezone validity before persisting to ClickHouse database. Logs system action on success or failure.

request_body.description: Array of appliance business hour configurations. Each configuration specifies an appliance and its working hours for availability metrics.

operations.name: edgeconnect_availability_time_settings_get1
operations.summary: Retrieve business hour configurations for appliances
operations.description: Fetches availability time settings (business hours, timezone) for the specified appliances. Used to retrieve current business hour configurations for availability reporting.

request_body.description: JSON object containing appliance identifiers to query.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_availability_threshold
operations.summary: Get availability threshold settings
operations.description: Retrieves the current availability threshold settings used for health monitoring. These thresholds define the boundaries between Good, Ok, and Poor availability status for overlay tunnels, underlay connections, network roles, interfaces, and appliance reachability. Returns an empty object `{}` if no thresholds have been configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_availability_threshold
operations.summary: Create or update availability threshold settings
operations.description: Creates or updates availability threshold settings for network health monitoring. All five categories must be provided with valid values. Validation rules: all values must be > 0, and okLimit must be > goodLimit for each category.

request_body.description: Availability threshold settings across five network health categories. Each category defines limits for Good, Ok, and Poor classifications.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_gc_stats
operations.summary: Get JVM Garbage Collection statistics
operations.description: Retrieves real-time JVM garbage collection statistics via ManagementFactory GarbageCollectorMXBeans. Returns cumulative collection count and time across all GC algorithms (e.g., G1, CMS, Parallel). Useful for monitoring JVM memory health and identifying GC-related performance issues.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_hikari_stats
operations.summary: Get HikariCP database connection pool statistics
operations.description: Retrieves real-time connection pool metrics from HikariCP via JMX MBeans. Monitors two pools: GMS_DB_POOL for standard database operations and GMS_DB_LONG_RUNNING_QUERY_POOL for extended queries. Useful for diagnosing connection exhaustion, pool sizing issues, and database performance bottlenecks.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_jdbc_stats
operations.summary: Get MySQL database server statistics
operations.description: Retrieves MySQL global status metrics via SHOW GLOBAL STATUS queries. Returns the total number of queries executed (Questions) and server uptime in seconds. Useful for monitoring database activity and calculating query rates (QPS = Questions / Uptime).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_request_count
operations.summary: Get REST API request counts within a time range
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated REST API request counts from the requestCount database table for a specified time period. Useful for monitoring API traffic, identifying usage patterns, and diagnosing load issues.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of the time range in milliseconds since Unix epoch. Must be less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of the time range in milliseconds since Unix epoch. Must be greater than startTime.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_request_stats
operations.summary: Get REST API request statistics by user and IP address within a time range
operations.description: Retrieves REST API request statistics from the requestStats database table for a specified time period. Returns the top 25 request counts grouped by username and IP address. Useful for monitoring API usage patterns, identifying high-traffic users, and analyzing request distribution across clients.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of the time range in milliseconds since Unix epoch. Must be less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of the time range in milliseconds since Unix epoch. Must be greater than startTime.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_dns_by_ip
operations.summary: Get DNS domain name by IP address
operations.description: Retrieves the most recent DNS domain name associated with a given IP address within a specified time range. Queries the hourlytopdns statistics table and returns the latest DNS record found.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IP address to resolve to a DNS domain name. Must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address format. Cannot be null or empty.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of the time range in Unix epoch seconds (signed 64-bit integer). Defines the lower boundary for DNS record lookup.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of the time range in Unix epoch seconds (signed 64-bit integer). Must be greater than startTime for valid results.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_build_in_user_details
operations.summary: Check Built-in Admin User Existence
operations.description: Determines if the built-in 'admin' user exists in the Orchestrator user management system. Used to distinguish between on-premises (admin exists) and container/cloud (no admin) deployments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_db_env_variables
operations.summary: Get Database Environment Variables
operations.description: Retrieves database connection environment variables configured for the Orchestrator. Returns the MySQL database hostname, port, and username used for JDBC connections.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_host_name
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator Hostname
operations.description: Retrieves the hostname of the Orchestrator server. In container/cloud deployments, returns the registered domain name. In on-premises deployments, returns the system hostname from HOSTNAME environment variable or network configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_hourly_flow_stats_retention
operations.summary: Get Hourly Flow Stats Retention Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves retention settings for hourly flow statistics from the statsRetention table. Returns entries filtered by granularity='hour' and default retention of 7776000 seconds (90 days). Used to verify stats retention configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_http_port
operations.summary: Get HTTP Port
operations.description: Retrieves the HTTP port number where the Orchestrator server is deployed. Returns a fixed port value of 8080 for both on-premises and container deployments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ip_address
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator IP Address
operations.description: Retrieves the IP address of the Orchestrator server. For on-premises deployments, returns the server's IP address obtained via system script or local host resolution. For container/cloud deployments, returns an empty string.

operations.name: edgeconnect_is_certificate_present
operations.summary: Check Stats Collector Signing Certificate Presence
operations.description: Checks if the stats collector signing key certificate is configured in the GMS configuration database. Verifies certificate existence at resource base '/statsCollector/signingKey' and returns true only if the config entry exists with non-empty data.

operations.name: edgeconnect_is_in_container
operations.summary: Check Container Deployment Mode
operations.description: Determines if the Orchestrator is running in container/cloud mode or on-premises mode. Checks the CONTAINER_MODE environment variable to determine deployment type.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_orchestrator_model
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator Model Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the Orchestrator model configuration from the GMS config database. For on-premises deployments, returns the model name (default: 'ORCH'). Container/cloud deployments return null as model configuration is not applicable.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_os_flavor_version_info
operations.summary: Get OS Flavor and Version
operations.description: Retrieves the operating system flavor and version where the Orchestrator is deployed. For on-premises deployments, reads from /etc/redhat-release and returns the PRETTY_NAME value with spaces replaced by underscores. For container/cloud deployments, returns 'Container Mode'.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_platform_info
operations.summary: Get Orchestrator Platform Information
operations.description: Retrieves the deployment platform type of the Orchestrator server. The platform is determined from /home/gms/platform.conf file or defaults based on deployment mode (container vs on-premises).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_smtp_configuration
operations.summary: Get SMTP Configuration Resource Keys
operations.description: Retrieves the list of SMTP configuration resource keys from the gmsConfig database. Used to verify that the SMTP configuration upgrader (SmtpConfigUpgrader) completed successfully. After successful upgrade, this endpoint should return an empty list indicating all SMTP configurations were migrated.

operations.name: edgeconnect_validate_configure_logger
operations.summary: Validate Logger Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current Log4j2 ThreadContext values for logging configuration validation. Returns the routing key and orchestrator unique ID used for log routing and identification in both on-premises and cloud container deployments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_orch_task_stats_for_appliance
operations.summary: Get Orchestration Task Statistics for a Specific Appliance
operations.description: Retrieves P99 performance statistics for orchestration tasks executed on a specific appliance. Returns timing metrics (min, max, avg, p99) for the last 300 orchestration runs per task type.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_a_ddos_base_line_max_timestamp
operations.summary: Get ADDoS baseline maximum timestamp for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the maximum timestamp from ADDoS baseline data for a specified appliance. Used to determine the most recent ADDoS baseline record available in the hourlyaddosbaseline table.

request_body.description: Request body containing the appliance identifier

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_a_ddos_segment_flow_utilization
operations.summary: Get ADDoS segment flow utilization statistics
operations.description: Retrieves ADDoS segment flow utilization timeseries statistics for a specific appliance. Returns baseline utilization metrics organized by segment ID, useful for monitoring network segment performance and DDoS detection baselines.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: UNIX epoch timestamp in milliseconds indicating the starting time boundary for data retrieval. Must be a valid positive integer.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the appliance primary key (nePk) to filter results.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_a_ddos_segment_zone_flow_utilization
operations.summary: Get ADDoS baseline segment zone flow utilization timeseries statistics for a specific appliance and timestamp.
operations.description: Retrieves ADDoS baseline segment zone flow utilization statistics for a specific appliance at a given timestamp. The data is filtered by classification=1, metric=0, and protocol=0, then aggregated by segment_id and zone_id. Results are ordered by segment_id and zone_id.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (signed 64-bit) in seconds indicating the time boundary for data retrieval. Use the value from /stats/timeseries/addos/maxTimestamp API to get the latest available timestamp.

request_body.description: Request body containing the appliance primary key (nePk) to filter statistics.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_a_ddos_segment_zone_protocol
operations.summary: Retrieve ADDoS baseline segment zone protocol statistics by appliance, timestamp, metric type, and classification.
operations.description: Retrieves ADDoS baseline segment zone protocol statistics for a specific appliance at a given timestamp. Returns protocol-level traffic metrics (TCP, UDP, ICMP, and others) grouped by segment and zone identifiers. Use this endpoint to analyze DDoS baseline patterns across different network protocols and segments.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (signed 64-bit) specifying the point-in-time for baseline data retrieval. Must be a valid positive EPOCH timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Flow metric type to filter baseline statistics. Determines which flow measurement category is returned.

parameters.name: classification
parameters.description: Classification type for grouping baseline data. Specifies whether to group by zone or source.

request_body.description: Request body containing the appliance primary key (nePk) to filter statistics.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_a_ddos_segment_zone_view
operations.summary: Get ADDoS baseline segment zone view statistics.
operations.description: Retrieves ADDoS baseline statistics for segment-zone view. Returns baseline values grouped by segment, zone, classification, and metric with protocol-level breakdown (all, TCP, UDP, ICMP, others). Use this endpoint to analyze traffic baselines for DDoS protection analysis.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: UNIX epoch timestamp (seconds) for the baseline data snapshot. Use the /stats/timeseries/addos/maxTimestamp endpoint to get the latest available timestamp.

parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: Zone identifier for filtering results. If not provided or set to -1, returns data for all zones.

parameters.name: segmentId
parameters.description: Segment identifier for filtering results. If not provided or set to -1, returns data for all segments.

request_body.description: Request body containing the appliance network element primary key (nePk).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_a_ddos_base_line_flow_utilization
operations.summary: Get ADDoS baseline total flow utilization for a specific appliance and timestamp.
operations.description: Retrieves the total flow utilization from ADDoS baseline statistics for a specified appliance. Returns the sum of baseline values where classification=1, metric=0, and protocol=0 from the hourlyaddosbaseline table.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: EPOCH timestamp (seconds) indicating the time boundary for querying baseline data. Must be a valid timestamp from available hourly baseline records.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the appliance primary key (nePk) to query.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_addos_trends_baseline_all_zone
operations.summary: Get ADDoS trends baseline timeseries data across all zones for an appliance.
operations.description: Retrieves ADDoS trends baseline timeseries statistics aggregated across all zones for a specified appliance. Data is grouped by segment and timestamp, filtered by protocol, metric, and classification. Used for monitoring DDoS protection baseline trends.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time boundary as Unix epoch timestamp in seconds. Must be >= 0 and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time boundary as Unix epoch timestamp in seconds. Must be >= 0 and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Network protocol filter for ADDoS statistics.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Flow metric type for ADDoS baseline measurement.

parameters.name: classification
parameters.description: Classification type for grouping ADDoS baseline data.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the appliance primary key (nePk) to filter statistics.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_addos_trends_baseline_segment
operations.summary: Retrieve ADDoS Trends Baseline Segment timeseries statistics
operations.description: Retrieves ADDoS Trends Baseline Segment timeseries statistics for a specific appliance. Returns flow metrics (concurrent, embryonic, flows/sec) used for DDoS baseline analysis within the specified time range and segment.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time boundary for data retrieval as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be >= 0 and less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time boundary for data retrieval as Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be >= 0 and greater than startTime.

parameters.name: segmentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the network segment to filter statistics. Used to scope baseline data to a specific segment.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Protocol filter for traffic analysis. Valid values: 0 (All protocols), 1 (TCP), 2 (UDP), 4 (Others).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Flow metric type for baseline measurement. Valid values: 0 (Concurrent flows), 1 (Embryonic flows), 2 (Flows per second), 3 (Embryonic Two-Way flows).

parameters.name: classification
parameters.description: Classification type for grouping statistics. Valid values: 1 (Zone-based classification), 2 (Source-based classification).

request_body.description: Request body containing the appliance identifier to filter statistics.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_addos_trends_baseline_segment_zone
operations.summary: Get ADDoS trends baseline statistics by segment and zone
operations.description: Retrieves ADDoS baseline trend statistics for a specific segment and zone combination. Returns time-series data with flow counts broken down by protocol type (TCP, UDP, ICMP, Others). Used for analyzing DDoS protection baseline patterns and detecting anomalies.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time boundary in Unix epoch seconds (64-bit signed integer). Must be less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time boundary in Unix epoch seconds (64-bit signed integer). Must be greater than startTime.

parameters.name: segmentId
parameters.description: Network segment identifier to filter baseline data. Validated to ensure it exists.

parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: Security zone identifier to filter baseline data. Validated to ensure it exists.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Flow metric type for baseline calculation. Values: 0=Concurrent flows, 1=Embryonic flows, 2=Flows per second, 3=Embryonic Two-Way flows.

parameters.name: classification
parameters.description: Classification type for baseline grouping. Values: 1=Zone-based classification, 2=Source-based classification.

request_body.description: Request body containing the appliance identifier (nePk) to query baseline statistics for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_addos_trends_baseline_zone
operations.summary: Retrieve ADDoS Trends Baseline Zone timeseries statistics.
operations.description: Retrieves ADDoS Trends Baseline Zone timeseries statistics filtered by appliance, zone, protocol, metric, and classification. Data is aggregated from hourly baseline records grouped by segment and timestamp. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role permissions.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time boundary for the data range. Must be less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time boundary for the data range. Must be greater than startTime.

parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: Zone identifier to filter baseline statistics. Required for zone-level filtering.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Network protocol filter for baseline data.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Flow metric type to retrieve for baseline analysis.

parameters.name: classification
parameters.description: Classification type for grouping baseline data.

request_body.description: Request body containing the appliance primary key identifier.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_best_apdex_time_series_stats
operations.summary: Get APDEX timeseries statistics for appliances and applications.
operations.description: Retrieves APDEX timeseries statistics for specified appliances and AppExpress applications. APDEX measures application performance using synthetic and observed quality scores. Results include transport path details, QoE metrics, and satisfaction counts.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of time range as EPOCH timestamp in milliseconds (signed 64-bit). Must be less than endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of time range as EPOCH timestamp in milliseconds (signed 64-bit). Must be greater than startTime.

parameters.name: format

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_time_series_stats
operations.summary: Get appliance time series statistics
operations.description: Retrieves time-series statistics for one or more appliances filtered by time range, granularity, and traffic type. Returns bandwidth, compression, latency, packet loss, and flow metrics organized by timestamp. When nePk is omitted, stats are retrieved for all appliances in the specified group (groupPk).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) for the start of the time range. Required unless 'latest' parameter is provided.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) for the end of the time range. Must be greater than startTime. Required unless 'latest' parameter is provided.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time interval granularity for aggregating stats data. Determines the resolution of returned data points.

parameters.name: groupPk
parameters.description: Internal group identifier. When specified without nePk, retrieves stats for all appliances in the group.

parameters.name: trafficType
parameters.description: Traffic category to filter statistics. Determines which type of traffic data is returned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of stat records to return. Default and maximum value is 10000.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. When set to 'CSV', returns data as downloadable CSV file instead of JSON.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: When true, uses appliance IP address as the key in response data instead of internal appliance ID (nePk). Default is false.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Retrieves stats for the most recent N minutes. When provided, overrides startTime and endTime (endTime becomes current time, startTime becomes current time minus N minutes).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_time_series_stats_by_post
operations.summary: Get time series statistics for multiple appliances (batch)
operations.description: Retrieves time-series statistics for multiple appliances specified in the request body. Returns bandwidth, throughput, compression, latency, and flow metrics grouped by timestamp. Use this endpoint when querying stats for specific appliances by their IDs.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) for the start of the time range. Required unless 'latest' is provided. Must be >= 0 and < endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) for the end of the time range. Required unless 'latest' is provided. Must be > startTime.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time granularity for data aggregation. Determines resolution of returned data points: minute (1-min intervals), hour (hourly), day (daily).

parameters.name: trafficType
parameters.description: Traffic category filter. OPTIMIZED_TRAFFIC(1)=WAN optimized, PASS_THROUGH_SHAPED(2)=shaped but not optimized, PASS_THROUGH_UNSHAPED(3)=neither, ALL_TRAFFIC(4)=combined.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum records to return per appliance. Limits result set size for performance.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Set to 'CSV' for downloadable CSV file (Content-Type: application/vnd.ms-excel). Omit or use any other value for JSON.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: When true, response keys use appliance IP address instead of nePk. Default is false (uses nePk).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Retrieve stats for most recent N minutes. When provided, overrides startTime/endTime: endTime=now, startTime=now-(latest*60).

request_body.description: JSON object containing list of appliance IDs (nePks) to retrieve statistics for. At least one valid appliance ID is required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_process_state
operations.summary: Get appliance process state time-series statistics
operations.description: Retrieves time-series process state data for a specific appliance within the given time range. Returns memory usage metrics (VmPeak, VmRSS, VmSize) for various system daemon processes. Results are ordered by timestamp in descending order (most recent first). Use this endpoint to monitor process memory trends and diagnose memory-related issues.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: startTime

parameters.name: endTime

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application_time_series_stats
operations.summary: Get application time series statistics filtered by appliance or group
operations.description: Retrieves time series statistics for a specific application filtered by appliance or group. Returns traffic data including bytes and packets for both LAN and WAN sides. When nePk is provided, returns stats for that specific appliance. When nePk is omitted and groupPk is provided, returns aggregated stats for all appliances in that group. The 'latest' parameter provides a convenient shortcut to get recent data without calculating epoch times.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of the time range in Unix epoch seconds (signed 64-bit). Required unless 'latest' parameter is provided. Must be less than endTime and greater than or equal to 0.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of the time range in Unix epoch seconds (signed 64-bit). Required unless 'latest' parameter is provided. Must be greater than startTime and greater than or equal to 0.

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Name of the application to filter statistics for. This parameter is required and cannot be empty.

parameters.name: groupPk
parameters.description: Internal unique identifier of an appliance group. Used to retrieve aggregated stats for all appliances in the group when nePk is not provided.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format for the response. When set to 'CSV', returns data as a downloadable CSV file instead of JSON.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: When true, returns aggregated total values for the application across all matching appliances. Default behavior returns per-appliance breakdown.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Retrieve stats for the last N minutes from current time. When provided, overrides startTime and endTime parameters. Value represents minutes.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of data points to return in the response. Used for pagination or limiting large result sets.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application_time_series_stats_by_post
operations.summary: Get application time series statistics for multiple appliances
operations.description: Retrieves time series traffic statistics for a specific application across multiple appliances. Returns bytes and packets for LAN (LRX/LTX) and WAN (WRX/WTX) sides at each timestamp. Use POST to query multiple appliances in a single request. Time range: provide startTime/endTime, or use 'latest' for recent data. Set total=true for aggregated stats across all appliances.

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Application name to filter statistics. Required, cannot be empty. Examples: HTTP, DNS, SSL, SMTP.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time in Unix epoch seconds. Required unless 'latest' is provided. Must be >= 0 and < endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time in Unix epoch seconds. Required unless 'latest' is provided. Must be >= 0 and > startTime.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Get stats for last N minutes. When provided, auto-calculates startTime=(now - N*60) and endTime=now, ignoring explicit time params.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: When true, aggregates stats across all appliances. When false (default), returns per-appliance breakdown.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. Set to 'CSV' for downloadable CSV file (application/vnd.ms-excel). Default: JSON.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of data points to return. Useful for limiting large result sets.

request_body.description: JSON object containing array of appliance IDs to query. All IDs must exist in GMS.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_application_performance_time_series_stats
operations.summary: Get application performance time series statistics
operations.description: Retrieves application performance time series statistics for specified appliances and applications. Returns metrics including client/server network delays, total network delay, application delay, response time, and sample counts. parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix epoch timestamp (seconds) for the end of the query time range. Must be greater than startTime and greater than or equal to 0.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Data aggregation granularity. Determines the time interval for data points. 'minute' returns raw minute-level data, 'hour' and 'day' return aggregated data.

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. Currently only JSON is supported for this endpoint.

request_body.description: JSON object containing appliance identifiers and application names to query.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_availability_time_series_stats
operations.summary: Get appliance reachability time series data
operations.description: Retrieves appliance reachability time series data for monitoring WebSocket connectivity status. Returns portal, orchestrator, and appliance reachability metrics at minute-level (day granularity) or daily-level (month granularity). The data source table and aggregation method changes based on granularity: 'day' uses minuteappliancereachability with raw values, 'month' uses dailyappliancereachability with sumMerge aggregation. Timezone is determined by the appliance's business hour configuration settings.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date for which to retrieve availability data. For 'day' granularity, provides minute-level data for this specific date. For 'month' granularity, provides daily data starting from this date's month.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time granularity for aggregating reachability data. 'day' returns minute-level samples from minuteappliancereachability table. 'month' returns daily aggregated samples from dailyappliancereachability table.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_interface_availability_time_series_stats
operations.summary: Get interface availability timeseries data
operations.description: Retrieves interface availability timeseries data for a specific appliance and interface. Returns availability state data points aggregated based on granularity. For 'day' granularity, queries minuteinterfaceavailability table with minute-level resolution. For 'month' granularity, queries dailyinterfaceavailability table with daily aggregated values including interface count and sample count.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Query date in YYYY-MM-DD format. For 'day' granularity, specifies the exact day. For 'month' granularity, use start of month (e.g., '2024-01-01').

parameters.name: ifName
parameters.description: Interface name identifier to filter statistics for a specific network interface.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Data aggregation granularity. 'day' returns minute-level data points for a single day. 'month' returns daily aggregated data points for the entire month.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnel_availability_timeseries_stats
operations.summary: Get tunnel availability timeseries data for monitoring tunnel health metrics over time.
operations.description: Retrieves tunnel availability timeseries data for a specified appliance and date. Returns downtime metrics including tunnel state, blackout, brownout, and IPSLA failures measured in seconds during business hours. The time range is determined by the appliance's configured timezone and business hours.

parameters.name: nePk

parameters.name: label

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_ddos_src_ip_sample10_time_series_stats

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_template_data
operations.summary: Create or update a template group
operations.description:
Creates a new template group from an existing one or updates an existing template group's configuration. When the request body 'name' matches the 'templateGroup' query parameter, the endpoint updates the existing group. When they differ, a new template group is created using templates from the source group. QoS templates require a valid license.

**Deployment behavior:** There is no separate deploy/apply endpoint. Modifying a template group here or changing selections via `POST /template/templateSelection` automatically queues all associated appliances for orchestration. To determine which appliances are affected, call `GET /template/applianceAssociation` (no nePk) and find appliances whose templateIds include the modified group name.

**Monitoring orchestration completion:** After a POST, poll `GET /template/history?nePk=<id>&latestOnly=true` for each affected appliance. When the response includes a history entry for the modified template name with `appliedOn` timestamp newer than your POST time and `status` of 'successful', orchestration is complete for that appliance. If no new entry appears within your timeout, the appliance may still be pending or unreachable.

**User Management template:** The 'users' template contains a map of local appliance user accounts keyed by username. Each user has fields: `self`, `enable`, `gid`, `password`, `gms_marked`. Passwords are redacted (empty string) on GET; supply the new password in `valObject` on POST. Use `GET /userAccount?nePk=<id>` to verify user changes were applied to an appliance.

**Related endpoints:** Associate groups with appliances via `POST /template/applianceAssociation`. Check which groups an appliance has via `GET /template/applianceAssociation?nePk=<id>`.

parameters.name: templateGroup
parameters.description: Target template group name. Must not be empty. If this matches the 'name' in the request body, the group is updated; otherwise a new group is created.

request_body.description: Template group configuration containing the source group name (for cloning) or target group name (for updating) and the templates to save.
