operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aws_artifacts
operations.summary: Retrieve AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager EC2 artifacts
operations.description: Returns cached AWS EC2 artifacts including VPCs, route tables, subnets, and routes for all configured regions. Data is organized by AWS region code (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1). Requires an active AWS subscription to be configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_aws_segment_get760
operations.summary: Get AWS Segments List
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all AWS segments in the AWS Transit Gateway Global Network. This includes both Transit Gateway Route Tables and Core Network Edge (CNE) segments. The segments are used for segment-to-zone association configuration in AWS integration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aws_configuration_entries
operations.summary: Retrieve AWS Transit Gateway and Cloud Network Edge configurations
operations.description: Returns a combined list of AWS LAN/WAN configurations from Transit Gateway Network Manager and Cloud Network Edge integrations. This endpoint aggregates configuration data for all appliances associated with AWS Transit Gateways and Core Network Edges in the Global Network.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_connection_status761
operations.summary: Get AWS VPN Connection BGP Peer Status
operations.description: Retrieves the BGP peer status for AWS VPN connections associated with a specific appliance. Returns connection status for WAN IPSEC and LAN GRE configurations including per-peer BGP state.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: interfaceLabel
parameters.description: Interface label ID to filter BGP peer status for a specific VPN connection. If omitted, returns status for all interface labels.

parameters.name: tgwId
parameters.description: AWS Transit Gateway ID to filter BGP peer status for a specific Transit Gateway. If omitted, returns status for all associated Transit Gateways.

operations.name: edgeconnect_aws_tgnm_connectivity_get762
operations.summary: Check AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager connectivity status
operations.description: Tests the connection to AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager using the configured subscription credentials. Attempts login to AWS and returns the connectivity status. If connection fails, a GMS alarm (FAILED_TO_CONNECT_TO_AWS) is raised. Successful connections clear any existing AWS connection alarms.

operations.name: edgeconnect_core_networks_with_cn_edges_get760
operations.summary: Get AWS Core Networks with CN-Edges
operations.description: Retrieves all AWS Cloud WAN Core Networks associated with the configured AWS Global Network, including their Core Network Edge (CNE) locations, segments, and routing information. Requires valid AWS subscription credentials to be configured. Data is refreshed periodically based on the configured polling interval.

operations.name: edgeconnect_aws_tgnm_default_tunnel_setting_get763
operations.summary: Get default tunnel settings for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager
operations.description: Returns recommended IPsec/GRE tunnel settings for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager integration. Settings are returned per interface label - WAN interfaces receive IPsec tunnel defaults while LAN interfaces receive GRE tunnel defaults. These represent the AWS-recommended configuration values for establishing VPN connections.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_global_network_to_cne_association
operations.summary: Retrieve Global Network to Core Network Edge associations
operations.description: Returns a map of AWS Global Network IDs to their associated Core Network (CNE) objects from the orchestrator cache. Each Global Network ID maps to a list of Core Network Summary objects containing network metadata.

operations.name: edgeconnect_global_networks_info_get764
operations.summary: Get Global Network to Transit Gateway associations
operations.description: Retrieves a mapping of AWS Global Network IDs to their associated Transit Gateway artifacts from the Orchestrator cache. This cached data represents the current AWS TGNM (Transit Gateway Network Manager) configuration known to the Orchestrator.

operations.name: edgeconnect_tgw_association_get765
operations.summary: Get AWS Transit Gateway to Global Network Associations (Refresh)
operations.description: Retrieves the current mapping of AWS Transit Gateways associated with Global Networks from cache. Returns data only when the SDK is logged into AWS and valid associations exist.

operations.name: edgeconnect_global_networks_info_get766
operations.summary: Get AWS Global Networks ID to Name mapping
operations.description: Retrieves a map of AWS Global Network IDs to their corresponding Global Network Names from the cache. This endpoint is used for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager (TGNM) integration to display and reference global networks.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aws_tgnm_interfaces767
operations.summary: Get AWS TGNM interface label configuration for VPN orchestration.
operations.description: Retrieves the configured interface label IDs used for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager VPN connection orchestration. Returns a 2D array where the first element contains primary interface label IDs and the second contains backup interface label IDs. Note: AWS TGNM integration only supports primary interfaces; backup interface configuration will result in a validation error.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_aws_tgnm_interfaces768
operations.summary: Configure WAN interface labels for AWS TGNM VPN orchestration.
operations.description: Configures the WAN interface label order for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager VPN connection orchestration. The primary interfaces define which WAN labels are used for creating VPN tunnels. Note: AWS TGNM only supports primary interfaces; backup interfaces must remain empty or a validation error will occur.

request_body.description: Interface label configuration with primary and backup arrays. Backup array must be empty for AWS TGNM.

operations.name: edgeconnect_pause_orchestration_get769
operations.summary: Get AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager orchestration pause state
operations.description: Retrieves the current pause state for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager orchestration. Returns whether orchestration is currently paused (true) or active (false). When paused, the system stops automatic synchronization and configuration updates to AWS TGNM resources.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_aws_tgnm_pause_orchestration770
operations.summary: Set AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager orchestration pause state
operations.description: Sets the pause/resume state for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager orchestration. When paused (true), automatic orchestration operations are suspended and all appliances are added to pending list. When resumed (false), orchestration resumes, appliances are added to pending list, and a full synchronization is triggered. This action is logged in the audit trail with details about whether orchestration was paused or resumed.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the desired pause state for AWS TGNM orchestration. The 'paused' field is required and must be a boolean value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_aws_tgnm_polling_interval_get771
operations.summary: Get AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager polling interval
operations.description: Retrieves the polling interval (in seconds) used to fetch the latest AWS Global Network and associated Transit Gateways from the AWS Portal. Default value is 14400 seconds (4 hours) if not configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_aws_tgnm_subscription_get773
operations.summary: Get AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager Subscription
operations.description: Retrieves the current AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager (TGNM) subscription credentials. Returns the AWS access key ID and encrypted secret access key used to authenticate with AWS services. If no subscription is configured, returns a 404 response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_aws_tgnm_subscription_post774
operations.summary: Create or Update AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager Subscription
operations.description: Creates or updates AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager (TGNM) subscription credentials. On initial setup, both awsAccessKeyId and awsSecretAccessKey are required. For updates, only awsAccessKeyId is required; if awsSecretAccessKey is omitted, the previous value is retained. The secret key is encrypted before storage. Upon successful save, the system clears any AWS connection failure alarms, reserves AWS-specific BGP ASNs (64512 for AWS, 7224 for us-east-1, 9059 for eu-west-1), initializes VTI subnet pool settings, schedules AWS polling jobs, and adds all appliances to the orchestration pending list.

request_body.description: AWS credentials for authenticating with AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager services.

operations.name: edgeconnect_aws_tgnm_subscription_delete772
operations.summary: Delete AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager Subscription
operations.description: Deletes the AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager subscription and performs cleanup operations. Standard deletion removes the subscription, logs out from AWS SDK, and cancels scheduled polling jobs. Force deletion (using deletionType=forceDeleteSubscription) additionally removes all segment firewall associations, appliance associations, TGW and CNE configurations, AWS GMS configs, and VTI subnets. Clears any existing AWS connection failure alarms.

parameters.name: deletionType
parameters.description: Controls the deletion behavior. Use 'forceDeleteSubscription' to remove all AWS configurations including appliance associations, segment firewall associations, TGW configs, CNE configs, and VTI subnets. If omitted or set to 'deleteSubscription', performs a standard deletion that only removes the subscription.

operations.name: edgeconnect_tgw_association_get775
operations.summary: Get all AWS Transit Gateway and Core Network Edge associations for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves all configured associations between SD-WAN appliances and AWS Transit Gateways (TGW) or Core Network Edges (CNE). Used for AWS Network Manager integration to determine which appliances are connected to which AWS resources. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role permissions.

operations.name: edgeconnect_tgw_association_post776
operations.summary: Create or update appliance-to-AWS Transit Gateway and Core Network Edge associations
operations.description: Creates or updates associations between SD-WAN appliances and AWS Transit Gateways (TGW) or Core Network Edges (CNE). The system validates each nePk against existing appliances; only matching entries are saved. Priority is automatically calculated: set to 1 if tgwId or coreNetworkEdgeId arrays contain values, otherwise 0. Timestamps are managed by the system.

request_body.description: Array of appliance-to-AWS resource association objects. Each object maps an appliance (by nePk) to Transit Gateways and/or Core Network Edges.

operations.name: edgeconnect_tgw_id_to_name_get760
operations.summary: Retrieve AWS Transit Gateway ID to Name mappings
operations.description: Returns a mapping of all AWS Transit Gateway IDs to their corresponding human-readable names. The data is cached from AWS Network Manager and refreshed periodically based on the configured polling interval. Returns an empty object if no Transit Gateways are configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_tgw_not_in_global_network_get760
operations.summary: Get AWS Transit Gateways not in Global Network
operations.description: Returns a list of AWS Transit Gateway artifacts that are not associated with any AWS Global Network. This endpoint helps identify standalone TGWs available for orchestration. Requires AWS subscription to be configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aws_tgnm_tunnel_settings777
operations.summary: Get AWS TGNM tunnel settings per interface label
operations.description: Retrieves AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager tunnel settings per interface label. Returns a map of interface label IDs to their corresponding IPsec/IKE tunnel configuration. If no custom settings exist, default tunnel settings are returned for each WAN/LAN interface label.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_aws_tgnm_tunnel_settings778
operations.summary: Update AWS TGNM tunnel settings per interface label
operations.description: Updates AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager IPsec/IKE tunnel settings per interface label. Validates: IKE version (must be 2 for AWS compatibility), IKE lifetime (0-480 mins, where 0 uses AWS default of 28800 seconds), IPsec lifetime (15-60 mins). Also validates IPsec Suite B algorithm combinations when using gcm128/gcm256/gmac128/gmac256 modes. Invalid ipSecSuiteB defaults to 'none', invalid ikePrf defaults to 'auto'. Settings are persisted and trigger orchestration to update all associated appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aws_tgnm_vti_cidr779
operations.summary: Get AWS VTI IP Pool Settings
operations.description: Retrieves the VTI subnet and mask configuration for the AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager global IP pool. Returns default values (169.254.0.0/16) if not previously configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_aws_tgnm_vti_cidr780
operations.summary: Update AWS VTI IP Pool Settings
operations.description: Configures the VTI subnet and mask for the AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager global IP pool. Saving triggers: (1) VTI pool update via AwsVtiSubnetPoolManager, (2) GMS config persistence, and (3) vti_cidr_change flag set to 1 on all AWS TGNM configuration entries. This clears the FAILED_TO_GET_AWS_VTI_IP_GLOBAL_POOL alarm on success.

request_body.description: VTI subnet pool configuration. Both ipAddress and mask fields are required and cannot be null or empty.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_reserved_subnets781
operations.summary: Get VTI Subnets from AWS Subnet Global Pool
operations.description: Retrieves VTI (Virtual Tunnel Interface) CIDR subnet entries from the AWS global subnet pool. Subnets can be filtered by their reservation status to return all, reserved-only, or unreserved-only entries.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: Filter subnets by reservation status. When 'true', returns only reserved subnets. When 'false', returns only unreserved subnets. When omitted or null, returns all subnets.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_aws_zone
operations.summary: Retrieve AWS Transit Gateway zone configurations
operations.description: Returns all configured AWS segment-to-EdgeConnect firewall zone associations. These mappings define how AWS Transit Gateway segments are associated with EdgeConnect segments, firewall zones, and roles for network orchestration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_aws_segment_zone_association
operations.summary: Configure AWS Transit Gateway zone associations
operations.description: Creates or updates AWS segment-to-EdgeConnect firewall zone associations. Performs an upsert operation based on edgeConnectSegment. Validates role configuration before saving and triggers appliance orchestration upon success.

request_body.description: List of AWS segment-to-firewall zone association configurations. Each entry maps an EdgeConnect segment to AWS segments with zone and role settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zone_for_default_segment_get760
operations.summary: Get VRF zones mapped by segment for AWS Transit Gateway integration
operations.description: Retrieves a map of segment IDs to their associated VRF zones for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager. Excludes zones with ID 65535 and 'Unknown' named zones. Used for configuring segment-zone associations in AWS TGNM integration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_association_get849
operations.summary: Retrieve HPE SSE appliance associations
operations.description: Returns all appliances currently enabled for HPE SSE (Axis) third-party tunnel integration. Each appliance includes its network element primary key (nePk), priority level, and last update timestamp.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_association_post850
operations.summary: Update HPE SSE appliance associations
operations.description: Creates or updates the list of appliances associated with HPE SSE (Axis) third-party tunnel integration. Duplicate appliance entries are automatically merged, retaining the higher priority value. Triggers orchestration progress indicator for all appliances after successful update.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the list of appliances to associate with HPE SSE integration. Duplicate nePk entries are automatically deduplicated; if priorities differ, priority 1 is retained.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_connectivity_get853
operations.summary: Get HPE SSE (Axis) Connectivity Status
operations.description: Checks the connectivity status between the Orchestrator and HPE SSE (Axis) service. Validates subscription configuration and attempts to connect to the HPE SSE API. On success, clears any existing connection failure alarms.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_default_tunnel_setting_get858
operations.summary: Get HPE SSE default tunnel settings
operations.description: Returns the recommended default IPsec/IKE tunnel configuration for HPE SSE (Axis) integration. These settings define the encryption, authentication, and key exchange parameters used to establish secure VPN tunnels between SD-WAN appliances and HPE SSE Cloud endpoints.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_axis_interfaces
operations.summary: Retrieve HPE SSE interface label order configuration
operations.description: Returns the configured HPE SSE (Axis) interface label order for tunnel orchestration. The response is a 2D array where each element represents a category of interfaces: primary (index 0), backup (index 1), and secondary (index 2). If no configuration exists, returns three empty arrays.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_axis_interfaces
operations.summary: Save HPE SSE interface label order configuration
operations.description: Persists the HPE SSE (Axis Security) interface label order for WAN tunnel orchestration. The 'ids' array contains three sub-arrays: primary interfaces (index 0) used as default path, backup interfaces (index 1) used for failover, and secondary interfaces (index 2) for additional redundancy. Interface label IDs must correspond to existing WAN interface labels defined in the system. Changes trigger re-orchestration of affected appliances.

request_body.description: Wrapper object containing 'ids' property with a 2D array of WAN interface label IDs for HPE SSE tunnel orchestration. Array indices: 0=primary, 1=backup, 2=secondary interfaces.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_ipsla_rule_destination_get858
operations.summary: Retrieve HPE SSE IPSLA rule destination configuration
operations.description: Returns the current IP SLA rule destination settings for HPE SSE integration. These settings define how path quality monitoring probes are configured, including monitor type, destination endpoints, thresholds, and latency/loss parameters for determining tunnel health.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_ipsla_rules855
operations.summary: Save HPE SSE IPSLA rule destination configuration
operations.description: Saves or updates the IP SLA rule destination settings for HPE SSE integration. The destination field is required and will be trimmed of whitespace. Changes trigger re-orchestration and are logged as system actions.

request_body.description: IPSLA rule destination configuration object containing probe settings, thresholds, and monitoring parameters.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_axis_ipsla_setting
operations.summary: Get HPE SSE IP SLA Setting
operations.description: Retrieves the current HPE SSE (Axis) IP SLA orchestration setting. Returns default settings (enableIpslaRuleOrchestration=true) if no configuration exists.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_axis_ipsla_setting
operations.summary: Update HPE SSE IP SLA Setting
operations.description: Updates the HPE SSE (Axis) IP SLA orchestration setting. When enabled, IP SLA rules are automatically configured on appliances. Changes are logged to the system action log with the current user's identity.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the IP SLA orchestration setting. The enableIpslaRuleOrchestration field controls automatic rule configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_axis_sites_info
operations.summary: Get HPE SSE site information for specified appliances
operations.description: Retrieves HPE SSE (Axis) site configuration data including VPN tunnel details, sublocation information, and POP override settings for one or more appliances. Use this endpoint to query the current HPE SSE integration status and configuration for specific appliances.

request_body.description: Array of appliance network primary keys (nePks) to query HPE SSE site information for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_pause_orchestration_get868
operations.summary: Get HPE SSE orchestration pause status
operations.description: Retrieves the current pause state of HPE SSE (Axis) tunnel orchestration. When paused, the system will not perform automatic synchronization or configuration updates to connected appliances. Returns false by default if no configuration exists.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_pause_orchestration_post869
operations.summary: Pause or resume HPE SSE orchestration
operations.description: Sets the pause state for HPE SSE (Axis) tunnel orchestration. When paused is true, orchestration operations are suspended and no automatic tunnel configuration or synchronization occurs. When paused is false, orchestration resumes and pending configurations are processed. This action is logged in system actions for audit purposes.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the pause status to set for HPE SSE orchestration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_polling_interval_get870
operations.summary: Get HPE SSE polling interval for location synchronization
operations.description: Retrieves the current polling interval for synchronizing locations and sub-locations from the HPE SSE (Axis) Internet Access portal. Default value is 600 seconds (10 minutes). This interval determines how frequently the orchestrator downloads location data.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_polling_interval855
operations.summary: Update HPE SSE polling interval for location synchronization
operations.description: Updates the polling interval for synchronizing locations and sub-locations from the HPE SSE (Axis) Internet Access portal. This endpoint saves the new interval to the configuration store and reschedules the HPE SSE data retrieval job accordingly.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the new polling interval in seconds. The pollingInterval field is required and must be a positive integer greater than zero.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_remote_endpoint_exception_get871
operations.summary: Get all HPE SSE POP override configurations
operations.description: Retrieves all user-configured Point of Presence (POP) override settings for HPE SSE (Security Service Edge) tunnels across all appliances. Returns a nested map structure organized by appliance ID (nePk) and WAN interface label ID, containing custom primary and secondary service edge addresses.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_remote_endpoint_exception_post873
operations.summary: Add or update HPE SSE POP override configuration
operations.description: Creates or updates custom Point of Presence (POP) override settings for a specific appliance and WAN interface label. Allows specifying primary and secondary service edge IP addresses or FQDNs.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: ID of the WAN interface label for which to configure the POP override. Must be a valid WAN interface label ID.

request_body.description: POP override configuration containing primary and secondary service edge addresses.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_remote_endpoint_exception_delete872
operations.summary: Delete HPE SSE POP override configuration
operations.description: Removes user-configured POP (Point of Presence) override data for a specific appliance and WAN interface label. This clears custom primary and secondary service edge IP addresses.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: ID of the WAN interface label for which to delete the POP override. Must be a valid WAN interface label ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_sub_location_config_get863
operations.summary: Get All HPE SSE Sub-Location Configurations
operations.description: Retrieves all configured HPE SSE (Security Service Edge) sub-location configurations. Each configuration maps appliances to sub-locations based on LAN subnets, interface labels, firewall zones, or address groups. Configurations with missing appliance or sub-location criteria are flagged as invalid. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permission.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_sub_location_config_post864
operations.summary: Create or Update HPE SSE Sub-Location Configurations
operations.description: Creates or updates HPE SSE (Security Service Edge) sub-location configurations. This endpoint replaces all existing configurations with the provided list. Each configuration maps appliances to sub-locations for traffic steering. Invalid references to appliances, groups, regions, zones, labels, or address groups are automatically removed. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: Array of sub-location configurations. Each configuration must have valid appliance criteria (all=true OR at least one nePk/group/region) and valid sub-location criteria (at least one lanSubnet/lanLabel/lanZone/addressGroup).

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_sub_location_delete874
operations.summary: Delete HPE SSE Sub-Location Configuration
operations.description: Deletes an HPE SSE (Security Service Edge) sub-location configuration by its unique ID. This operation permanently removes the sub-location mapping for appliances. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the HPE SSE sub-location configuration to delete. Must be a valid positive integer ID from an existing configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_subscription_get875
operations.summary: Get HPE SSE Subscription
operations.description: Retrieves the current HPE SSE (formerly Axis Security) subscription configuration. The API token key is never returned for security purposes.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_subscription_post876
operations.summary: Create or Update HPE SSE Subscription
operations.description: Creates a new or updates an existing HPE SSE (formerly Axis Security) subscription. On success, validates credentials by connecting to HPE SSE and clears any previous connection failure alarms.

operations.name: edgeconnect_axis_subscription_delete874
operations.summary: Delete HPE SSE Subscription
operations.description: Deletes the HPE SSE (formerly Axis Security) subscription and all associated configurations. This operation removes portal configurations, database configurations, appliance associations, and clears related alarms. **Prerequisites:** Ensure all Axis policies are deselected in Business Intent Overlay and all Axis configurations have been removed from appliances before deletion.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_axis_tunnel_settings
operations.summary: Get HPE SSE tunnel settings for VPN connections
operations.description: Retrieves the global IPsec/IKE tunnel settings used for building HPE SSE (Axis) VPN connections. These settings control encryption, authentication, and tunnel lifecycle parameters applied to all HPE SSE tunnels.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_axis_tunnel_settings
operations.summary: Save HPE SSE tunnel settings
operations.description: Saves global IPsec/IKE tunnel settings for HPE SSE (Axis) VPN connections. These settings apply to all HPE SSE tunnels. Auto-corrections: when ikeVersion=2, idType is forced to 'address'; invalid ipSecSuiteB values default to 'none'; invalid ikePrf values default to 'auto'.

request_body.description: IPsec/IKE tunnel configuration settings for third-party cloud security integration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_configuration_entries
operations.summary: Retrieve Azure VPN Site configurations for Virtual WAN
operations.description: Returns a list of Azure VPN Site configurations created for appliances associated with Azure Virtual WAN. Each configuration entry contains VPN site details, pre-shared keys, and provisioning status for tunnel establishment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_connection_status783
operations.summary: Get Azure VWAN VPN Connection BGP Peer Status
operations.description: Retrieves the BGP peer status for Azure Virtual WAN VPN connections associated with an appliance. Returns status for all connections or filters by interface label or Azure VPN site ID.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: interfaceLabel
parameters.description: Interface label ID to filter BGP peer status for a specific VPN connection. When omitted, returns status for all interface labels.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Azure VPN Site ID to filter BGP peer status for a specific VPN connection. When omitted, returns status for all sites.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_connectivity_get784
operations.summary: Check Azure VWAN connectivity status
operations.description: Tests connectivity to Azure Virtual WAN by calling the Azure REST API endpoint `/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualWans`. Requires a valid Azure subscription to be configured. On success, clears any existing FAILED_TO_CONNECT_TO_AZURE alarm. On failure (wrong credentials, timeout, or other errors), creates a GMS alarm and returns NOT_CONNECTED status.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_default_tunnel_setting_get785
operations.summary: Get Azure default tunnel settings
operations.description: Returns the recommended default IPsec/IKE tunnel configuration settings optimized for establishing VPN tunnels to Azure Virtual WAN. These defaults are preconfigured to meet Azure VWAN requirements including IKEv2, specific encryption algorithms, and lifetime values.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_interfaces786
operations.summary: Get Azure VWAN interface label order
operations.description: Retrieves the WAN interface label priority order for Azure Virtual WAN VPN Site creation. Returns configuration stored in GmsConfig with base '/thirdPartyServices/azure' and key '/interfaces'.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_azure_interfaces787
operations.summary: Set Azure VWAN interface label order configuration
operations.description: Configures the priority order of WAN interface labels for Azure Virtual WAN VPN Site creation. The first array specifies primary interfaces in priority order; appliances matching the first available interface will use it for VPN Site creation. Currently only primary interfaces are supported (second array should be empty). Upon saving, all appliances are queued for orchestration.

request_body.description: Interface label IDs to configure for Azure Virtual WAN VPN Site creation

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_association_get775
operations.summary: Retrieve Azure LAN-side appliance associations
operations.description: Returns all configured appliance-to-Azure resource associations for LAN-side connectivity. Retrieves mappings between EdgeConnect appliances and Azure Virtual Hubs, Route Servers, and Internal Load Balancers used for SD-WAN orchestration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_association_post776
operations.summary: Create or update Azure LAN-side appliance associations
operations.description: Creates or updates EdgeConnect appliance associations with Azure LAN-side resources. Uses INSERT ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE semantics based on nePk as the unique identifier. Action is logged for audit purposes.

request_body.description: Array of appliance association objects. Each object is upserted based on the nePk (primary key). Pass empty arrays for vhub_id, routeserver_id, or loadbalancer_id to clear those associations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_azure_conf_fe76f2cb
operations.summary: Get Azure LAN-side resource configurations for cloud-deployed EdgeConnect appliances
operations.description: Retrieves all Azure LAN-side resource configurations that define how EdgeConnect appliances are associated with Azure VNets, resource groups, and regions. Used for Azure LAN-side automation orchestration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_azure_conf_252f269a
operations.summary: Save Azure LAN-side resource configurations (upsert operation)
operations.description: Saves Azure LAN-side resource configurations that associate EdgeConnect appliances with Azure VNets, resource groups, and regions. This endpoint performs an upsert operation: rules with existing IDs are updated, new rules (id=0 or new id) are created, and rules not in the submitted list are deleted. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

request_body.description: Array of Azure resource configuration rules. Submit the complete desired state; missing rules will be deleted.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_lan_config_18afd3d3
operations.summary: Retrieve all Azure LAN-side connectivity configurations
operations.description: Returns a consolidated list of Azure LAN configurations from Virtual Hubs (vHub), Route Servers, and Load Balancers. This data is used to display connection status in the Azure LAN-side connectivity UI tab. The response aggregates configurations across all three Azure resource types.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_get_connection_status791
operations.summary: Retrieve Azure LAN-side BGP connection status for an appliance
operations.description: Gets all BGP peer status information for the corresponding BGP endpoints on the Azure side (Virtual Hub or Route Server) for a specified appliance. Returns detailed status for each configured interface including individual peer states.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_lan_side_connectivity
operations.summary: Get Azure LAN-side connectivity status for Virtual Hub, Route Server, and Load Balancer
operations.description: Checks connectivity to Azure LAN-side resources by querying Azure Virtual Hubs and Load Balancers APIs. Returns status for three resource types: vwanHub, routeServer, and loadBalancer. Connectivity values: 0 = NOT_CONNECTED (authentication failed, timeout, or general error), 1 = CONNECTED (successful API call), 2 = CONNECTING (in progress), 3 = INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS (HTTP 403). Requires a configured Azure LAN-side subscription.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_lan_side_s_91efba54
operations.summary: Retrieves Azure LAN-side subscription configuration
operations.description: Returns the configured Azure LAN-side subscription account details used for SD-WAN LAN-side connectivity automation. The subscription enables integration with Azure Virtual Hubs, Route Servers, and Load Balancers. Note: The clientSecret is always masked (null) in the response for security.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_lan_side_s_26d6ab58
operations.summary: Create or update Azure LAN-side subscription
operations.description: Creates or updates the Azure LAN-side subscription credentials for SD-WAN LAN-side connectivity automation. The subscription enables integration with Azure Virtual Hubs, Route Servers, and Load Balancers. On success, Azure reserved BGP ASNs are automatically configured and a scheduled job is created for orchestration.

request_body.description: Azure account configuration with subscription credentials. The id field must reference an existing Azure cloud deployment account to retrieve the clientSecret.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_lan_side_s_4aff1a62
operations.summary: Delete Azure LAN-side subscription
operations.description: Permanently removes the Azure LAN-side subscription configuration and all associated data. This operation deletes the subscription credentials, stops the orchestration schedule job, removes appliance associations with Virtual Hubs, Route Servers, and Load Balancers, clears related alarms, and logs out from Azure.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_load_balan_83a5acfb
operations.summary: Get Azure Load Balancers for LAN-side connectivity
operations.description: Retrieves the list of Azure Load Balancers associated with the configured Azure LAN-side subscription. Used for appliance-to-load-balancer association in Azure LAN-side automation workflows.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_lan_side_pause_orchestration
operations.summary: Get Azure LAN Side Connectivity orchestration pause state
operations.description: Retrieves the pause state for Azure LAN Side Connectivity orchestration from the GMS configuration store. Returns false by default when no configuration exists.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_azure_lan_side_pause_orchestration
operations.summary: Set Azure LAN Side Connectivity orchestration pause state
operations.description: Sets the pause state for Azure LAN Side Connectivity orchestration. When paused (true), all appliances are added to the pending list with message 'Pause orchestration enabled for Azure LAN Integration'. When resumed (false), appliances are added to pending list for processing with message 'Resumed orchestration for Azure LAN Integration'. Configuration is stored in GMS config at '/azure/pauseAzureLanOrchestration'.

request_body.description: Object containing the desired pause state for orchestration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_polling_interval_get790
operations.summary: Get the Azure LAN-side connectivity polling interval
operations.description: Retrieves the current polling interval in seconds for synchronizing Azure LAN-side connectivity resources. This interval determines how frequently the system fetches the latest Virtual WAN Hub, Route Server, and Internal Load Balancer configurations from the Azure portal. The default interval is 14400 seconds (4 hours).

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_regions_get782
operations.summary: Get Azure regions mapping for LAN-side connectivity
operations.description: Retrieves a mapping of Azure region IDs to their human-readable display names for the configured Azure LAN-side subscription. Used for configuring Azure LAN-side connectivity features including Virtual Hubs, Route Servers, and Load Balancers.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connnectivity_route_serv_4ce208a1
operations.summary: Retrieve Azure Route Servers
operations.description: Returns a list of Azure Route Servers associated with the configured Azure LAN-side subscription. Route Servers enable dynamic routing between network virtual appliances and Azure virtual networks via BGP.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_virtual_hubs_with_vwan
operations.summary: Get Azure Virtual Hubs grouped by Virtual WAN
operations.description: Retrieves a mapping of Azure Virtual WAN IDs to their associated Virtual Hub IDs. The data is fetched from cached GMS configuration stored under the '/azure/virtualHubs' resource key.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connectivity_lan_interfa_8e4ddbf3
operations.summary: Get Azure LAN-side connectivity interface label configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the configured interface label order for Azure LAN-side connectivity. The returned array contains two sub-arrays: the first for primary interface labels and the second for backup interface labels. Currently, only primary interfaces are supported for Azure LAN-side connectivity orchestration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_lan_side_connectivity_lan_interfa_9d19ca68
operations.summary: Configure Azure LAN-side connectivity interface labels
operations.description: Saves interface label order for Azure LAN-side connectivity orchestration. Defines which appliance LAN interfaces connect to Azure Virtual Hubs, Route Servers, and Load Balancers. Upon successful save, all appliances are automatically added to the orchestration pending list.

request_body.description: Request body containing interface label arrays. The 'ids' field is required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_pause_orchestration_get788
operations.summary: Get Azure VWAN orchestration pause state
operations.description: Retrieves the current pause state for Azure Virtual WAN orchestration. When paused, the system stops automatic orchestration of Azure VPN sites, tunnels, and BGP configurations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_pause_orchestration_post789
operations.summary: Set Azure VWAN orchestration pause state
operations.description: Updates the pause state for Azure Virtual WAN orchestration. When set to true, automatic orchestration of Azure VPN sites, tunnels, and BGP configurations is suspended. When set to false (resumed), a full sync is triggered for all affected appliances. The action is logged in the system audit log.

request_body.description: The pause state configuration to apply. The paused field is required and must be a boolean value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_subscription_get791
operations.summary: Get Azure Virtual WAN Subscription Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the current Azure Virtual WAN subscription configuration from Orchestrator. Sensitive credentials (clientSecret, storageAccountKey) are redacted from the response for security. Use this endpoint to verify subscription setup before configuring Azure Virtual WAN integration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_subscription_post792
operations.summary: Create or Update Azure Virtual WAN Subscription
operations.description: Creates a new Azure Virtual WAN subscription configuration or updates an existing one. On first creation, all fields are required. On update, clientSecret and storageAccountKey are optional unless other subscription fields have changed. Upon success, reserves Azure BGP ASNs (65515, 65517-65520, 8074-8075, 12076) and starts a scheduled polling job for Azure synchronization.

request_body.description: Azure subscription configuration containing Azure AD credentials and storage account details for Virtual WAN integration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_azure_subscription_delete790
operations.summary: Delete Azure Virtual WAN Subscription
operations.description: Removes the Azure Virtual WAN subscription configuration from Orchestrator. Standard deletion removes the subscription and stops scheduled jobs. Force deletion additionally removes all Azure GMS configurations including breakout interfaces. Before deleting, ensure appliances are disassociated from Azure Virtual WANs. Clears AZURE_PAUSED and FAILED_TO_CONNECT_TO_AZURE alarms upon success.

parameters.name: deletionType
parameters.description: Controls the type of deletion. Use 'forceDeleteSubscription' to remove all Azure GMS configurations along with the subscription, or omit for standard deletion.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_azure_tunnel_settings793
operations.summary: Get Azure Virtual WAN tunnel settings
operations.description: Retrieves the IPsec/IKE tunnel settings configured for Azure Virtual WAN pass-through tunnels. Returns saved settings if available, otherwise returns Azure-specific default values. These settings control VPN tunnel parameters between EdgeConnect appliances and Azure Virtual WAN hubs.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_azure_tunnel_settings794
operations.summary: Set Azure Virtual WAN tunnel settings
operations.description: Updates the IPsec/IKE tunnel settings for Azure Virtual WAN pass-through tunnels. Azure requires IKE Version 2 (mandatory). Invalid ipSecSuiteB values default to 'none'; invalid ikePrf values default to 'auto'. Suite B algorithms require specific parameter combinations enforced by validation.

request_body.description: Azure Virtual WAN tunnel configuration settings to save.

operations.name: edgeconnect_virtual_wan_association_get795
operations.summary: Get Azure Virtual WAN to appliance associations
operations.description: Retrieves the mapping of Azure Virtual WAN names to associated EdgeConnect appliance IDs (nePks). Each Virtual WAN can have multiple appliances associated for automated IPsec tunnel orchestration. Returns an empty object if no associations exist.

operations.name: edgeconnect_virtual_wan_association_post796
operations.summary: Save Azure Virtual WAN to appliance associations
operations.description: Creates or updates the mapping of Azure Virtual WAN names to EdgeConnect appliance IDs (nePks). This triggers orchestration progress updates for all affected appliances and initiates automated IPsec tunnel configuration. Requires VTI IP Pool to be configured beforehand. The action is recorded in the audit log. Minimum appliance version required: 8.3.0.4.

request_body.description: JSON object mapping Azure Virtual WAN names to arrays of appliance nePk identifiers. Virtual WAN names must match existing WANs in the Azure subscription. Each appliance can only be associated with one Virtual WAN at a time; reassigning requires removing from the previous WAN first.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_clear_pass_account_by_id818
operations.summary: Retrieve ClearPass Policy Manager account(s)
operations.description: Retrieves ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) account configuration. Returns a single account when ID is provided, or all accounts as a map keyed by ID when no ID is specified. The accessKey field is always excluded from the response for security.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of a specific ClearPass account to retrieve. If omitted, all accounts are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_clear_pass_account819
operations.summary: Update ClearPass Policy Manager account configuration
operations.description: Updates an existing ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) account with new configuration values. The account must exist and the updated name/domain must not conflict with other existing accounts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the ClearPass account to update. Must reference an existing account.

request_body.description: Updated ClearPass account configuration. At least name or domain must be provided.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_clear_pass_account815
operations.summary: Add new ClearPass Policy Manager account
operations.description: Creates a new ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) account configuration in the Orchestrator. The account enables integration with Aruba ClearPass for user identity and authentication services.

request_body.description: ClearPass account configuration with connection and authentication details.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_clear_pass_subscription
operations.summary: Delete ClearPass Policy Manager account
operations.description: Permanently removes a ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) account configuration from the Orchestrator. This operation also clears related alarms and removes the ClearPass synchronization job if no accounts remain.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the ClearPass account to delete. Must be a valid existing account ID.

operations.name: edgeconnect_update_service_pause_status816
operations.summary: Pause or resume ClearPass Policy Manager account orchestration
operations.description: Updates the pause status of a specific ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) account integration. When paused, the account will stop processing login/logout events from ClearPass. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the ClearPass Policy Manager account configuration. Must reference an existing configuration in the system.

parameters.name: isPaused
parameters.description: Set to true to pause orchestration (stop processing events) or false to resume orchestration for the specified account.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_clear_pass_configuration_list820
operations.summary: Get ClearPass Policy Manager configurations
operations.description: Retrieves ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) configuration details. When called without an ID parameter, returns all configurations as an array. When called with an ID, returns a single configuration object. The accessKey field is masked in responses for security.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of a specific ClearPass configuration. When omitted, all configurations are returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_connectivity821
operations.summary: Get ClearPass Policy Manager account connectivity status
operations.description: Tests the connectivity to a configured ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) account by attempting to authenticate with the stored credentials. Returns the current connection state indicating whether the CPPM server is reachable and credentials are valid.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ClearPass Policy Manager account configuration to test connectivity for. Must correspond to an existing account.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_login_info_from_cppm822
operations.summary: Posts ClearPass Policy Manager login event
operations.description: Receives and processes user login events from ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM). This endpoint is called by CPPM to notify the Orchestrator when a user authenticates via ClearPass. The event is queued for processing if the CPPM domain is configured and the integration is not paused.

request_body.description: Login event data from ClearPass Policy Manager containing user authentication details.

operations.name: edgeconnect_post_logout_info_from_cppm823
operations.summary: Post ClearPass Policy Manager logout event
operations.description: Receives and processes user logout events from ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM). The event is queued for processing if the CPPM configuration exists and is not paused.

request_body.description: ClearPass logout event data containing user session and authentication details

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_all_clear_pass_configuration_list824
operations.summary: Filter ClearPass Policy Manager events
operations.description: Retrieves ClearPass Policy Manager login/logout events filtered by time range, IP address, username, and event type. Returns authentication events from CPPM integration including user identity, device, and session information.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of the time range as epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be provided and less than or equal to endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of the time range as epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be greater than or equal to startTime.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Filter by client IP address. Supports wildcard (*) at start or end for partial matching (e.g., '192.168.*' or '*10.1').

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Filter by username. Supports wildcard (*) at start or end for partial matching (e.g., 'admin*' or '*@domain.com').

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return. If not specified or exceeds 10000, defaults to 10000.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Event filter type. 'All' returns all events, 'Active' returns only sessions without logout (end_time=0), 'Historical' returns completed sessions with logout timestamp.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_username_and_role_list_by_ip_and_time825
operations.summary: Get usernames and roles for given IP and time range
operations.description: Retrieves a list of usernames and roles from ClearPass event logs for a specified IP address within a time range. When type is 'flow', filters events where the flow falls within the time range; otherwise returns events that started within the range.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: The IP address to query for associated usernames and roles. Must be a valid IPv4 address.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Query type for filtering events. Use 'flow' to filter events where the flow time falls within the range (start_time <= startTime AND end_time >= endTime). Default behavior returns events that started within the range.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of the time range as epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Events are filtered based on this value.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of the time range as epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Must be greater than or equal to startTime.

operations.name: edgeconnect_is_pause_cp_orchestration826
operations.summary: Get ClearPass orchestration pause status
operations.description: Retrieves the current pause state of ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) orchestration. When paused, Orchestrator stops processing ClearPass login/logout events and synchronizing configurations. Returns false by default if no pause configuration exists.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_pause_cp_orchestration827
operations.summary: Set ClearPass orchestration pause status
operations.description: Sets the pause state of ClearPass Policy Manager orchestration. When pausing (paused=true), all ClearPass accounts are marked as paused and event processing stops. When resuming (paused=false), a full sync is triggered via setAllNeedService() to refresh all configurations and ensure synchronization.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the pause state to set for ClearPass orchestration. The 'paused' field is required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_reset_service_endpoint828
operations.summary: Reset ClearPass Policy Manager service endpoint
operations.description: Resets a specific ClearPass Policy Manager service endpoint configuration. Use this to re-establish communication with CPPM when the context server or login/logout action endpoints need to be recreated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ClearPass Policy Manager account configuration. Must reference an existing CPPM account.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: The service endpoint type to reset. Determines which CPPM integration component will be recreated.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_service_status829
operations.summary: Get ClearPass Policy Manager service endpoint status
operations.description: Retrieves the integration status of ClearPass Policy Manager service endpoints. Returns the status of context server, login action, and logout action endpoints configured for the specified account.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the ClearPass Policy Manager configuration account. Must reference an existing configuration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_netskope_appliance_association
operations.summary: Retrieve Netskope appliance associations
operations.description: Returns the list of appliances associated with Netskope cloud security service. Each association includes appliance identifier, priority level, and last update timestamp. Used to determine which appliances participate in Netskope orchestration.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_netskope_appliance_association
operations.summary: Save Netskope appliance associations
operations.description: Saves or updates the list of appliances associated with Netskope cloud security service. Duplicate entries by nePk are automatically deduplicated. Triggers orchestration progress updates when called by authenticated user.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the enabled array of appliance associations. The request body is validated for JSON syntax before processing.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_connection_status785
operations.summary: Get Netskope tunnel connection status for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the connection status of all Netskope IPsec tunnels with IP SLA monitoring for the specified appliance. Returns a map of interface-specific connection statuses.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: interfaceLabel
parameters.description: The WAN interface label ID to filter results. Currently unused but reserved for future filtering.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_connectivity_get853
operations.summary: Get Netskope connectivity status
operations.description: Checks and returns the current connectivity status between the Orchestrator and Netskope cloud services. The endpoint validates connectivity by attempting to reach the Netskope steering/ipsec/pops API. If a subscription exists and connectivity fails, a GMS alarm is triggered.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_netskope_default_tunnel_setting
operations.summary: Retrieve default IPsec tunnel settings for Netskope Cloud integration
operations.description: Returns the recommended default IPsec/IKE tunnel configuration settings for establishing secure connections to Netskope Cloud. These settings are pre-configured with optimal values and can be used as a template when configuring Netskope tunnel interfaces.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_netskope_interface_tunnel_setting
operations.summary: Retrieve Netskope tunnel settings for all WAN interface labels
operations.description: Fetches the IPSec/GRE tunnel configuration settings for each WAN interface label configured for Netskope integration. The response is a map where keys are WAN label IDs and values contain IKE and IPSec parameters. Returns null if no settings are configured.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_netskope_interface_tunnel_setting
operations.summary: Save Netskope tunnel settings for WAN interface labels
operations.description: Updates the IPSec/GRE tunnel configuration settings for WAN interface labels used in Netskope integration. Each interface label can have unique IKE and IPSec parameters. The operation logs the action to the system action log with the current user and triggers orchestration progress updates for all appliances. Supported tunnel modes include 'ipsec', 'ipsec_ip', and 'gre'.

request_body.description: Map of WAN interface label IDs to their tunnel settings. Each label ID key maps to a ThirdPartyTunnelSetting object containing IKE and IPSec configuration parameters. The configuration is stored in the GMS config database and triggers orchestration for all associated appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_configuration_get851
operations.summary: Retrieve Netskope interface configuration and tunnel settings
operations.description: Retrieves the current Netskope configuration from the GMS config cache. Returns interface label ordering for primary, backup, and secondary interfaces, along with default IPsec/GRE tunnel settings. No request parameters required.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_configuration_post852
operations.summary: Save Netskope interface configuration and tunnel settings
operations.description: Saves the Netskope interface configuration to the GMS config cache. This endpoint configures the interface label ordering for Netskope tunnel priorities (primary, backup, secondary) and default IPsec/GRE tunnel settings. Changes are logged to the system action log. Requires READ_WRITE role authorization.

request_body.description: Netskope configuration containing interface label ordering for tunnel priorities and default tunnel settings. The interfaces array defines which WAN interface labels are used for primary (index 0), backup (index 1), and secondary (index 2) Netskope tunnels.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_ipsla_rule_destination_get858
operations.summary: Retrieve Netskope IPSLA rule destination configuration
operations.description: Returns the IP SLA (Service Level Agreement) monitoring configuration for Netskope third-party tunnel integration. This configuration defines how the SD-WAN appliances monitor tunnel health to Netskope service edges using ICMP ping probes. The returned settings include probe intervals, thresholds for marking tunnels up/down, loss/latency thresholds, and the source interface used for probes. The destination field is dynamically generated based on Netskope POP endpoints and should not be manually set.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_netskope_ipsla_rule_destination
operations.summary: Save Netskope IPSLA rule destination
operations.description: Updates the IP SLA monitoring configuration for Netskope tunnel health checks. Validates that type is 'ip-monitor' and destination is empty. Changes are logged to system audit trail.

request_body.description: IPSLA rule destination configuration. The 'type' must be 'ip-monitor' and 'destination' must be null/empty (auto-generated from Netskope POP endpoints).

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_ipsla_setting_get858
operations.summary: Retrieve Netskope IP SLA orchestration settings
operations.description: Returns the current IP SLA orchestration configuration for Netskope integration. If no configuration exists, returns default settings with IP SLA orchestration enabled.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_ipsla_setting855
operations.summary: Update Netskope IP SLA orchestration settings
operations.description: Updates or creates the IP SLA orchestration configuration for Netskope integration. When enabled, IP SLA monitoring rules are automatically configured for Netskope tunnels to track connectivity health. This endpoint performs an upsert operation - creating new settings if none exist, or updating existing settings.

request_body.description: IP SLA setting configuration object containing the orchestration toggle. The setting controls automatic IP SLA rule management for Netskope tunnel monitoring.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_task_status_get870
operations.summary: Get Netskope Task Manager status for appliances
operations.description: Returns the orchestration status of appliances in the Netskope Task Manager. Without a filter, returns all appliances with their statuses. With a filter, returns only appliances matching that status. Primarily used for debugging when appliances are not being orchestrated.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter appliances by orchestration status. When omitted, returns all appliances with their respective statuses.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_netskope_orchestrated_list
operations.summary: Get Netskope configuration entries for specified appliances
operations.description: Retrieves Netskope tunnel configuration data including IPsec and GRE tunnel settings, pre-shared keys, and service edge overrides for one or more appliances identified by their nePks.

request_body.description: Array of appliance identifiers (nePks) to retrieve configuration for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_pause_orchestration_get868
operations.summary: Get Netskope orchestration pause status
operations.description: Retrieves the current pause state of Netskope orchestration. When paused, automatic tunnel configuration synchronization between Orchestrator and EdgeConnect appliances is halted.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_pause_orchestration_post869
operations.summary: Set Netskope orchestration pause status
operations.description: Updates the pause state of Netskope orchestration. When paused (true), automatic IPSec and GRE tunnel configuration synchronization with Netskope is halted for all associated EdgeConnect appliances. The action is recorded in the system audit trail with the current user context.

request_body.description: JSON object with the 'paused' boolean field to control orchestration state.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_polling_interval_get870
operations.summary: Get Netskope location polling interval
operations.description: Retrieves the configured time interval (in seconds) between consecutive downloads of location data from the Netskope Internet Access portal. This interval controls how frequently the system synchronizes location information with Netskope. Default value is 600 seconds (10 minutes).

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_pop_override871
operations.summary: Retrieve all Netskope service edge POP override configurations
operations.description: Returns a map of all configured Netskope service edge POP overrides organized by appliance nePk and interface label ID. Each override specifies custom primary (pop1) and secondary (pop2) service edge addresses. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_pop_override872
operations.summary: Create or update Netskope service edge POP override
operations.description: Saves a custom Netskope service edge POP override for a specific appliance WAN interface. Validates that both pop1 and pop2 are valid IPv4 addresses or FQDN domains matching pattern '^((?!-)[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}(?<!-)\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,6}$'. The addresses must be different to ensure failover capability. Creates new entry if none exists, otherwise updates existing configuration.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: WAN interface label ID. Must be a valid WAN label configured in interface labels.

request_body.description: Service edge override with primary (pop1) and secondary (pop2) addresses. Both must be valid IPv4 or FQDN.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_pop_override873
operations.summary: Delete Netskope service edge POP override
operations.description: Removes a custom Netskope service edge POP (Point of Presence) override for a specific appliance and WAN interface. After deletion, the appliance reverts to using automatically discovered service edge addresses for IPsec tunnel establishment. The deletion removes the label-specific override while preserving other label overrides for the same appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: WAN interface label ID. Must be a valid WAN label configured in interface labels.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_subscription_get875
operations.summary: Get Netskope Subscription
operations.description: Retrieves the current Netskope third-party service subscription configuration. Returns the username, API token (decrypted), and domain used for VPN credentials. The response is retrieved from the GMS configuration cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_subscription_post876
operations.summary: Create or Update Netskope Subscription
operations.description: Creates a new Netskope third-party service subscription or updates an existing one. The API token is encrypted before storage. After saving, the system validates connectivity by querying Netskope POPs and clears any FAILED_TO_CONNECT_TO_NETSKOPE alarms.

request_body.description: Netskope subscription credentials for IPsec VPN tunnel integration

operations.name: edgeconnect_netskope_subscription_delete874
operations.summary: Delete Netskope Subscription
operations.description: Permanently removes the Netskope third-party subscription and all associated configurations. This operation cleans up portal configurations, appliance associations, scheduled jobs, default tunnel settings, and clears related alarms. Before calling this endpoint, ensure Netskope Policies are deselected in Business Intent Overlay and all Netskope config has been deleted. The operation logs all actions for audit purposes.

operations.name: edgeconnect_bio_breakout_get830
operations.summary: Get BIO Breakout state for a service provider
operations.description: Retrieves the current BIO (Business Intent Overlay) Breakout state for a specified service provider. The state indicates whether the service provider is included in BIO Breakout Internet Policies for overlay traffic routing.

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the service provider. Must reference an existing service provider in the database.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_service_provider_bio_breakout831
operations.summary: Set BIO Breakout state for a service provider
operations.description: Updates the BIO (Business Intent Overlay) Breakout state for a service provider. When enabled (bioBreakout=1), the service provider is added to BIO Breakout Internet Policies and the service icon is saved to local storage. When disabled (bioBreakout=0), the service provider is removed from BIO policies and the icon path is cleared (except for Netskope). This operation updates the serviceorchestrationproviders table, modifies BIO policy configuration, and triggers orchestration progress updates for all appliances. A system action log entry is created to record the configuration change.

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the service provider. Must be a valid numeric ID referencing an existing service provider in the serviceorchestrationproviders table.

request_body.description: Request body containing the desired BIO Breakout state. Only the bioBreakout field is read from the ServiceOrchServiceProviderEntry object.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_connection_status790
operations.summary: Get service orchestration tunnel connection status for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the IP SLA tunnel connection status for all configured service provider remote endpoints on a specified appliance. Returns tunnel state information including primary and backup endpoint status.

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the third-party service provider. Must reference an existing service provider configuration.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: interfaceLabel
parameters.description: Optional WAN interface label filter. Not currently used in response filtering.

parameters.name: remoteId
parameters.description: Optional remote endpoint identifier filter. Not currently used in response filtering.

operations.name: edgeconnect_service_orch_default_tunnel_setting_get832
operations.summary: Get default tunnel settings for Service Orchestration
operations.description: Returns the recommended IPsec/IKE tunnel configuration defaults for Service Orchestration third-party integrations. These settings provide a baseline for configuring secure VPN tunnels to third-party service providers. No parameters required; returns system-wide defaults.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_connection_status78
operations.summary: Gets all Zscaler Tunnels with IP SLA's status of the appliance. The response contains <nePk_labelId>, <connectionStatus> map.
operations.description:
Retrieves the real-time connection status of all Zscaler third-party tunnels configured on the specified appliance. The status is determined using IP SLA (Service Level Agreement) monitoring which tracks the health of each tunnel.

**Connection Status Values:**
- **Up**: Both primary and secondary tunnels (if configured) are operational
- **Down**: All configured tunnels are not operational
- **1 of 2 Up**: Only one of the two configured tunnels is operational (partial connectivity)
- **Deleting**: The tunnel configuration is being removed
- **Appliance Unreachable**: Unable to communicate with the appliance to determine tunnel status

**Response Structure:**
The response is a key-value map where:
- **Key**: Composite identifier in format `<nePk>_<labelId>` representing the appliance and interface
- **Value**: One of the connection status values listed above

**Use Cases:**
- Monitor Zscaler tunnel health for specific appliances
- Detect partial connectivity issues (1 of 2 tunnels up)
- Identify unreachable appliances in the network
- Track tunnel deletion progress

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: interfaceLabel
parameters.description: Optional interface label filter. This parameter exists in the API but is currently not utilized in the implementation. Tunnel status is returned for all configured Zscaler interfaces on the specified appliance regardless of this parameter.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zscaler_location_config_get863
operations.summary: Retrieve Zscaler Location and Sub-Location gateway options and bandwidth control configurations
operations.description: Returns all Zscaler location configurations including gateway options and bandwidth control settings. The response validates configurations against current appliances, groups, regions, WAN labels, and firewall zones, flagging invalid rules where referenced entities no longer exist. Bandwidth values are returned in Kbps (converted from internal Mbps storage). Time values are converted based on their displayTimeUnit (MINUTE, HOUR, or DAY).

operations.name: edgeconnect_zscaler_location_config_post864
operations.summary: Save Zscaler location and sub-location configurations
operations.description: Replaces all Zscaler location configurations with the provided array. Validates appliances, groups, regions, WAN labels, LAN labels, and firewall zones exist; removes invalid references silently. Converts bandwidth from Kbps to Mbps (multiplied by 1000) for storage unless bwControl is 'usePercent'. Converts time values to minutes based on displayTimeUnit/surrogateRefreshTimeUnit. Gateway options have dependencies: authRequired=true disables aupEnabled/cautionEnabled but enables surrogateIP/kerberosAuth; ofwEnabled=false disables ipsControl; aupEnabled=false resets aupTimeoutInDays; surrogateIP=false disables surrogateIPEnforcedForKnownBrowsers and resets idleTimeInMinutes. After save, triggers orchestration for all appliances.

request_body.description: Array of Zscaler location configurations. The entire configuration set is replaced. IDs are auto-reassigned sequentially (1, 2, 3...) to maintain database order. Bandwidth in Kbps is converted to Mbps for storage (except usePercent mode). Time values converted based on their unit fields.
