operations.name: edgeconnect_zscaler_remote_endpoint_exception_delete872
operations.summary: Delete Zscaler ZEN override configuration
operations.description: Removes user-configured Zscaler ZEN (Zscaler Enforcement Node) override IP addresses for a specific appliance and WAN interface label combination. This operation clears the custom remote endpoint exception, allowing the system to use automatically discovered Zscaler endpoints. Requires READ_WRITE permission.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: Numeric identifier for the WAN interface label. Must be a valid WAN interface label configured in the system.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zscaler_subscription_get875
operations.summary: Get Zscaler Subscription
operations.description: Retrieves the current Zscaler subscription configuration including cloud endpoint, credentials, and ZDX settings. The password field is always masked (empty string) for security. Supports ETag-based caching via If-None-Match header.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from previous response for cache validation. Returns 304 if unchanged.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zscaler_subscription_post876
operations.summary: Create or Update Zscaler Subscription
operations.description: Creates or updates the Zscaler subscription configuration. For new subscriptions, all fields including password are required. For updates, password is optional (existing password retained if not provided). On success, verifies Zscaler connectivity, downloads location data, and clears connection failure alarms.

request_body.description: Zscaler subscription configuration. Password required for new subscriptions, optional for updates.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zscaler_subscription_delete874
operations.summary: Delete Zscaler Subscription
operations.description: Permanently removes the Zscaler subscription and all associated configurations from the orchestrator. This operation deletes Zscaler portal configurations, location settings, appliance associations, scheduled jobs, and clears related alarms. **Prerequisites**: Deselect Zscaler Policies in Business Intent Overlay first and wait until all Zscaler config has been deleted from appliances before calling this endpoint.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_zscaler_timezones
operations.summary: Get Zscaler timezone mappings
operations.description: Retrieves configured timezone mappings from cache that map standard IANA timezones to Zscaler timezone identifiers. Each mapping uses a pipe separator format.

operations.name: edgeconnect_save_zscaler_timezones
operations.summary: Save Zscaler timezone mappings
operations.description: Saves custom timezone mappings that map standard IANA timezones to Zscaler-specific timezone identifiers. Each mapping uses a pipe separator format (IANA_timezone|Zscaler_timezone).

request_body.description: Timezone mappings as pipe-separated string. Format: IANA_timezone|Zscaler_timezone for each mapping. Multiple mappings can be separated by pipe or newline characters.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_zscaler_zdx_vpn_locations
operations.summary: Get Zscaler ZDX VPN locations for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves Zscaler ZDX VPN location information for EdgeConnect appliances. Returns a map of device keys to their associated VPN locations, including both primary locations and sub-locations. Sub-locations are named using the pattern 'locationName(subLocationName)'. Supports ETag-based caching for efficient polling.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zscaler_task_status_get870
operations.summary: Get Zscaler Task Manager status for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves the current Zscaler Task Manager orchestration status for appliances. Without a filter, returns all appliances mapped to their status. With a filter, returns a list of appliance nePks matching that status. Useful for debugging appliances not getting Zscaler orchestrated.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter appliances by orchestration status. When omitted, returns all appliances with their respective statuses.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_traffic_behavior_mode
operations.summary: Get traffic behavior mode status
operations.description: Retrieves the traffic behavior mode for a specific appliance or all appliances. When nePk is provided, returns mode for that appliance. When omitted, returns aggregate mode across all appliances.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_bonded_tunnel_config_batch
operations.summary: Retrieve batch of bonded tunnel configurations
operations.description: Retrieves configuration data for a batch of bonded tunnels from a specific appliance. This endpoint supports two data retrieval modes: cached mode (from Orchestrator cache) for faster response times, or direct mode (from appliance) for real-time data. Use this endpoint to efficiently fetch multiple tunnel configurations in a single request instead of making individual calls.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When 'true', retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When 'false', fetches directly from the appliance.

request_body.description: List of tunnel IDs (tunnel names) for which to retrieve configurations. Only tunnels matching these IDs will be returned.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_bonded_tunnels_states880
operations.summary: Get bonded tunnel state from multiple appliances
operations.description: Retrieves the current operational state of bonded tunnels from multiple appliances. Returns tunnel state data including operational status, bandwidth, MTU, IPsec health, and uptime. Use the optional state query parameter to filter tunnels by operational status using case-insensitive pattern matching.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter tunnels by operational state. Uses case-insensitive regex pattern matching against the 'oper' field. Common values: 'Up', 'Down', 'Active'.

request_body.description: List of appliance primary keys (nePks) to retrieve bonded tunnel state from.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_bonded_tunnel_state_batch
operations.summary: Retrieve bonded tunnel states in batch
operations.description: Retrieves the operational state of multiple bonded tunnels in a single batch request. Use this endpoint for efficient bulk retrieval of tunnel states instead of individual requests. Supports both cached (GMS database) and live (direct appliance) data sources.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source flag. When 'true', retrieves from GMS cache. When 'false' or omitted, retrieves directly from the appliance.

request_body.description: List of bonded tunnel IDs. Each ID corresponds to a specific bonded tunnel on the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_pass_through_tunnel_config_batch
operations.summary: Retrieve batch of pass-through tunnel configurations
operations.description: Retrieves configuration data for multiple pass-through (third-party) tunnels in a single batch request. Pass-through tunnels are used for third-party service integrations such as Zscaler, Netskope, and other cloud security providers. The endpoint supports two retrieval modes: cached (from Orchestrator database) or live (directly from the appliance).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval mode. When 'true', retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When 'false', fetches directly from the appliance.

request_body.description: Array of tunnel IDs to retrieve configurations for. Each ID should match an existing pass-through tunnel name on the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_pass_through_tunnel_state_batch
operations.summary: Retrieve batch of pass-through tunnel states
operations.description: Retrieves the operational state of multiple pass-through (third-party) tunnels in a single batch request. Pass-through tunnels are used for third-party service integrations such as Zscaler. When cached=true, data is retrieved from Orchestrator's cache for faster response. When cached=false, data is fetched directly from the appliance for real-time accuracy.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data source: 'true' retrieves from Orchestrator cache (faster), 'false' fetches real-time data from the appliance (slower but current).

request_body.description: A JSON array containing the tunnel IDs (names) for which to retrieve state information. Only tunnels matching these IDs will be returned in the response.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_physical_tunnel_config_batch
operations.summary: Retrieve batch of physical tunnel configurations
operations.description: Retrieves a batch of physical tunnel configurations for specified tunnel IDs. Use cached=true for faster responses from GMS database, or cached=false to query the appliance directly for real-time data. Requires READ or READ_WRITE role permissions.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selection. When 'true', retrieves from GMS cache (faster). When 'false', queries the appliance directly (real-time data).

request_body.description: List of tunnel IDs to retrieve. Tunnel IDs can be obtained from GET /tunnels/physical/tunnelIds endpoint.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnel_state_from_multiple_appliances
operations.summary: Get physical tunnel state for multiple appliances
operations.description: Retrieves the current operational state of all physical tunnels for multiple appliances. Returns live tunnel data directly from appliances (not cached). Use the state query parameter to filter results by operational status.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Regex pattern to filter tunnels by operational state (e.g., 'Up', 'Down', 'Up - Active'). Case-insensitive matching is applied.

request_body.description: List of appliance primary keys (nePks) to retrieve tunnel state for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_physical_tunnel_state_batch
operations.summary: Retrieve batch of physical tunnel states
operations.description: Retrieves state information for a batch of physical tunnels on the specified appliance. Use this endpoint to efficiently fetch multiple tunnel states in a single request. When cached=true, returns data from Orchestrator cache; when cached=false (default), queries the appliance directly for real-time state.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When 'true', retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When 'false', fetches directly from the appliance.

request_body.description: Array of tunnel IDs to retrieve state information for. Each ID must match an existing tunnel on the target appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_initiate_traceroute
operations.summary: Initiate traceroute on a physical tunnel
operations.description: Starts an asynchronous traceroute operation on the specified physical tunnel. The traceroute executes on the target appliance via `/tunnelTraceroute/{id}` and results are retrieved using `/tunnels/physical/tracerouteState`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Tunnel name/identifier to perform traceroute on. Must match an existing tunnel name in the configuration.

request_body.description: Appliance target specification. Only the first nePk in the array is used.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnel_traceroute_state
operations.summary: Get traceroute state for a physical tunnel
operations.description: Retrieves the current traceroute state for a specified physical tunnel. The traceroute state includes hop information, latency metrics, and path diagnostics between tunnel endpoints. Uses a fallback mechanism to retrieve state via tunnel state API if the dedicated traceroute API is unavailable.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (name) of the physical tunnel for which to retrieve traceroute state. This corresponds to the tunnel's configured name.

request_body.description: Request body containing the appliance primary key(s). Only the first appliance in the array is used to query traceroute state.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_physical_tunnel_ids
operations.summary: Get physical tunnel IDs for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves the list of physical tunnel identifiers (tunnel names) for a specified appliance. Optionally filters results by tunnel operational state. Data is fetched directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter tunnels by operational state. Uses case-insensitive partial matching (e.g., 'Up' matches 'Up - Active').

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_third_party_tunnels_states887
operations.summary: Get third-party tunnel states from multiple appliances
operations.description: Retrieves the current operational state of all third-party tunnels from multiple appliances. Returns tunnel state data keyed by appliance primary key, with each appliance containing an 'allTunnelState' map of tunnel names to their state objects. Supports optional filtering by tunnel state using a regex pattern.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Regular expression pattern to filter tunnels by operational state. Matches against the 'oper' field using case-insensitive partial matching.

request_body.description: Object containing array of appliance primary keys to query for tunnel states.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnels2_meta_data
operations.summary: Get total tunnel count metadata
operations.description: Retrieves metadata about tunnels, specifically the total count of all tunnels in the system. When metaData is true, queries the tunnel2 database table to return the total number of tunnel records.

parameters.name: metaData
parameters.description: Flag to request tunnel metadata. Must be true to retrieve tunnel count data. If false or omitted, returns 204 No Content.

operations.name: edgeconnect_search_all_bonded_tunnels889
operations.summary: Get bonded tunnels configuration
operations.description: Retrieves bonded tunnel configurations from the Orchestrator cache. Supports three query modes: (1) No nePk/tunnelId - returns all tunnels for all appliances, (2) nePk only - returns all tunnels for a specific appliance, (3) nePk + tunnelId - returns a single tunnel. Use boolean field selectors to return only specific fields. Use 'limit' parameter to control result size.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: tunnelId
parameters.description: Filter by specific tunnel ID. Must be used with nePk to retrieve a single tunnel.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of bonded tunnels to return. Use this to limit results as networks may have many tunnels.

parameters.name: matchingAlias
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match filter for tunnel alias names.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Filter by overlay ID. Use 'all' to return tunnels from all overlays, or a specific numeric ID.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Regex pattern to filter tunnels by operational status (e.g., 'Up', 'Down'). Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'id' field in response objects.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'alias' field (tunnel display name) in response objects.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'tag' field (overlay name) in response objects.

parameters.name: srcNePk
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'srcNePk' field (source appliance ID) in response objects.

parameters.name: destNePk
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'destNePk' field (destination appliance ID) in response objects.

parameters.name: destTunnelId
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'destTunnelId' field in response objects.

parameters.name: destTunnelAlias
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'destTunnelAlias' field in response objects.

parameters.name: operStatus
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'operStatus' field (operational status like Up/Down) in response objects.

parameters.name: adminStatus
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'adminStatus' field (administrative status) in response objects.

parameters.name: remoteIdState
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'remoteIdState' field in response objects.

parameters.name: fecStatus
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'fecStatus' field (Forward Error Correction status) in response objects.

parameters.name: fecRatio
parameters.description: When true, includes only the 'fecRatio' field (FEC ratio value) in response objects.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: When true, includes 'children' array with physical tunnel id/alias pairs for each bonded tunnel.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_bonded_tunnels_with_physical_tunnels892
operations.summary: Get bonded tunnels containing a specific physical tunnel
operations.description: Returns all bonded tunnels that have the specified physical tunnel as a child member. Useful for finding parent bonded tunnels when you know a physical tunnel ID. Data is retrieved from the Orchestrator's in-memory cache.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: physicalTunnelId
parameters.description: Physical tunnel ID to search for. Returns all bonded tunnels containing this physical tunnel as a child.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Regular expression to filter results by tunnel operational state. Case-insensitive partial match against operStatus field.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnels_between_appliances893
operations.summary: Get tunnels between appliances
operations.description: Retrieves all tunnel connections between a list of appliances from cache. Returns physical tunnels (overlayId=0), bonded tunnels (overlayId='all' or specific ID), or pass-through tunnels based on parameters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tunnels to return. Limits the result set size for pagination or performance optimization.

parameters.name: matchingAlias
parameters.description: Filter tunnels by alias using case-insensitive substring matching. Only tunnels containing this text in their alias are returned.

parameters.name: overlayId
parameters.description: Filter by overlay type: '0' for physical tunnels only, 'all' for all bonded tunnels, or a specific overlay ID integer for tunnels in that overlay.

parameters.name: includePassThrough
parameters.description: Include pass-through tunnels in results. Only effective when overlayId is null or '0'. Pass-through tunnels connect to third-party services.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Regex pattern to filter tunnels by operational state. Matches against tunnel 'oper' status (e.g., 'Up', 'Down').

request_body.description: List of appliance IDs (nePks) to query tunnels between. Tunnels are returned where both source and destination are in this list.

operations.name: edgeconnect_search_all_pass_through_tunnels894
operations.summary: Search and retrieve pass-through tunnels
operations.description: Retrieves pass-through tunnel configurations from the Orchestrator cache. Supports three query modes: (1) No nePk/tunnelId returns all tunnels grouped by appliance, (2) nePk only returns tunnels for that appliance, (3) nePk + tunnelId returns a specific tunnel. Field selector parameters (id, alias, tag, etc.) limit response fields when set to true.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: tunnelId
parameters.description: Specific pass-through tunnel ID. Must be used with nePk to retrieve a single tunnel.

parameters.name: matchingAlias
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter for tunnel alias. Returns tunnels where alias contains this string.

parameters.name: matchingService
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter for tunnel peer/service name. Returns tunnels where peerName contains this string.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tunnels to return. Default is 100 when nePk is provided. Use to limit response size.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Regex pattern to filter tunnels by operational status (operStatus). Case-insensitive matching.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'id' field in response objects. Used for field selection.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'alias' field in response objects. The alias is the tunnel name shown in the UI.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'tag' field in response objects. The tag is the internal overlay name for the tunnel.

parameters.name: srcNePk
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'srcNePk' field in response objects. Identifies the source appliance.

parameters.name: destNePk
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'destNePk' field in response objects. Identifies the destination appliance (if applicable).

parameters.name: destTunnelId
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'destTunnelId' field in response objects.

parameters.name: destTunnelAlias
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'destTunnelAlias' field in response objects.

parameters.name: operStatus
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'operStatus' field in response objects. Shows current operational state (Up/Down).

parameters.name: adminStatus
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'adminStatus' field in response objects. Shows administrative state.

parameters.name: remoteIdState
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'remoteIdState' field in response objects.

parameters.name: fecStatus
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'fecStatus' field in response objects. Shows Forward Error Correction status.

parameters.name: fecRatio
parameters.description: When true, include only the 'fecRatio' field in response objects. Shows FEC ratio value.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_physical_tunnels
operations.summary: Search physical tunnels across appliances
operations.description: Retrieves physical tunnel configurations from the Orchestrator cache. Supports three query modes: (1) All tunnels across all appliances when no filters provided, (2) All tunnels for a specific appliance when only nePk provided, (3) A specific tunnel when both nePk and tunnelId provided. Boolean field selector parameters (id, alias, tag, etc.) control which fields appear in the response - if any are true, only those fields are returned.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

parameters.name: tunnelId
parameters.description: Tunnel identifier. When combined with nePk, returns a specific tunnel. Ignored if nePk is not provided.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tunnels to return. Applied when iterating through all appliances or a single appliance's tunnels.

parameters.name: matchingAlias
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on tunnel alias. Filters tunnels whose alias contains this string.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Regex pattern to match tunnel operational status (operStatus). Case-insensitive matching is applied.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Include only the 'id' field in response when true. Used for selective field retrieval.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Include only the 'alias' field (tunnel display name) in response when true.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Include only the 'tag' field (overlay name) in response when true.

parameters.name: srcNePk
parameters.description: Include only the 'srcNePk' field (source appliance nePk) in response when true.

parameters.name: destNePk
parameters.description: Include only the 'destNePk' field (destination appliance nePk) in response when true.

parameters.name: destTunnelId
parameters.description: Include only the 'destTunnelId' field (remote tunnel ID) in response when true.

parameters.name: destTunnelAlias
parameters.description: Include only the 'destTunnelAlias' field (remote tunnel alias) in response when true.

parameters.name: operStatus
parameters.description: Include only the 'operStatus' field (current operational state) in response when true.

parameters.name: adminStatus
parameters.description: Include only the 'adminStatus' field (administrative state) in response when true.

parameters.name: remoteIdState
parameters.description: Include only the 'remoteIdState' field in response when true.

parameters.name: fecStatus
parameters.description: Include only the 'fecStatus' field (Forward Error Correction status) in response when true.

parameters.name: fecRatio
parameters.description: Include only the 'fecRatio' field (FEC ratio value) in response when true.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_tunnel_counts900
operations.summary: Get tunnel counts by overlay type for specified appliances
operations.description: Retrieves tunnel counts for specified appliances, categorized by tunnel type: Underlay (non-bonded tunnels), overlay names (bonded tunnels grouped by overlay), Passthrough tunnels, and Total count. Results are keyed by appliance ID (nePk).

request_body.description: JSON object containing an array of appliance IDs (nePks) to retrieve tunnel counts for.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_deployment902
operations.summary: Get tunnel-related deployment information for appliances
operations.description: Retrieves deployment mode and network interface information from Orchestrator's in-memory cache. Used for tunnel configuration context. When nePk is omitted, returns data for all appliances keyed by nePk. When nePk is provided, returns data for that appliance with key '0'. Requires 'read' or 'read-write' role.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE'). When omitted, results are returned for all appliances.

operations.name: edgeconnect_ui_usage_stats904
operations.summary: Increment UI feature usage counter
operations.description: Records and increments the usage count for a specific UI feature, dialog, or tab. Used for analytics and tracking feature adoption across the Orchestrator interface.

parameters.name: uiName
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the UI feature, dialog, or tab being tracked. Must be a non-empty string representing the UI element name.

operations.name: edgeconnect_upgrade_appliances905
operations.summary: Upgrade EdgeConnect appliances with ECOS firmware
operations.description: Initiates an asynchronous upgrade operation for one or more EdgeConnect appliances. The upgrade can use images from Aruba Portal, locally uploaded images, or external URLs. For HA pairs, upgrades are coordinated sequentially with a 5-minute wait between peers. Returns a clientKey for tracking progress via polling.

request_body.description: Upgrade configuration specifying target appliances, image source, and installation behavior.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_user_account906
operations.summary: Get user accounts and active sessions for an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves all user account details and active sessions for a specified appliance. Returns a map of users keyed by username and a map of sessions keyed by session number. Data can be fetched from cache or directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When 'true', retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance and updates cache. Defaults to 'true' if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_password_settings907
operations.summary: Retrieve appliance password policy settings
operations.description: Retrieves password policy configuration for a specified appliance, including password length, expiration, history, and user inactivity settings. Data can be retrieved from cache or fetched directly from the appliance.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Controls data source. When true (default), retrieves from Orchestrator cache for faster response. When false, fetches fresh data from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_users
operations.summary: Retrieve user accounts
operations.description: Retrieves all user accounts or a specific user by username. Returns user profile information including login status, two-factor authentication settings, and account status. Sensitive fields (password, salt, userTwoFactorKey) are cleared in the response.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Username to filter by. If omitted, returns all users. If provided, returns a single-element array with the matching user.

operations.name: edgeconnect_add_modify_user
operations.summary: Create or update a user account
operations.description: Creates a new user account or updates an existing one. For new users without a password, a reset password email is sent. On cloud orchestrator, two-factor authentication must be enabled.

parameters.name: newUser
parameters.description: Set to true to create a new user, false to update existing user. Required parameter.

request_body.description: User account details for creation or update.

operations.name: edgeconnect_delete_user
operations.summary: Delete a user account
operations.description: Permanently deletes a user account and all associated data including password history, topology preferences, flow settings, and RBAC assignments. This action cannot be undone.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique primary key identifier (userPk) of the user to delete. Must be provided along with userName.

parameters.name: userName
parameters.description: The username of the user to delete. Used for logging and deleting related records. Must match the userId.

operations.name: edgeconnect_forgot_password
operations.summary: Initiate password reset
operations.description: Initiates a password reset flow by sending a reset email to the user. Accepts username or email address for user lookup. For security, returns 200 even if user not found or has no email configured.

request_body.description: User identification for password reset request.

operations.name: edgeconnect_generate_new_user_key
operations.summary: Generate new TOTP two-factor authentication key
operations.description: Generates a new Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) secret key for app-based two-factor authentication. Returns a QR code barcode that can be scanned with authenticator apps like Google Authenticator or Authy. The user must have app-based TFA enabled on their account.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_notify_password_expiry
operations.summary: Get password expiry notification status
operations.description: Returns password expiration notification status for the currently authenticated user. Checks if the user's password is approaching expiration based on the 'notifyPasswordExpiryDays' system setting.

operations.name: edgeconnect_set_admin_password
operations.summary: Change user password
operations.description: Changes an authenticated user's password. Validates the old password before allowing the change. Updates password expiration time based on system settings. For 'admin' user on non-container deployments, also updates the Unix and Apache admin password.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username of the account whose password is being changed. Must match an existing user in the system.

request_body.description: Current and new password credentials for the password change operation.

operations.name: edgeconnect_reset_password
operations.summary: Reset user password
operations.description: Resets a user's password using a reset token from an email link or by providing a username. Also allows updating two-factor authentication settings and generating a new TOTP key.

request_body.description: Password reset details including new password and TFA settings.

operations.name: edgeconnect_validate_common_words
operations.summary: Validate password against common words list
operations.description: Checks if the provided password matches any entry in the system's common words dictionary. Used during password validation to enforce password security policies by preventing use of easily guessable passwords.

parameters.name: userPassword
parameters.description: The password string to validate against the common words list. Comparison is case-insensitive (converted to lowercase before checking).

operations.name: edgeconnect_validate_appliance_upgrade915
operations.summary: Validate ECOS firmware upgrade compatibility for appliances
operations.description: Validates ECOS firmware version compatibility for EdgeConnect appliance upgrades by consulting the Aruba Cloud Portal. Returns supported upgrade paths based on each appliance's model, platform, and current version. When imageUrl is provided, the version is extracted from the image's build_version.txt file. In Air-Gap mode, validation is skipped and a message advises checking Release Notes. Requires READ_WRITE role permission.

request_body.description: Validation request with target versions and optional appliance filters. At minimum, provide either versions array or imageUrl.

operations.name: edgeconnect_loopback_get916
operations.summary: Get loopback interface configuration
operations.description: Retrieves loopback interface configuration from an appliance. Returns all configured loopback interfaces including their IP addresses, network masks, labels, zones, and VRF associations. Data can be retrieved from cache for faster response or directly from the appliance for real-time configuration.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval source. When 'true' (default), returns cached configuration from Orchestrator database. When 'false', fetches real-time configuration directly from the appliance and updates the cache.

operations.name: edgeconnect_vti_get917
operations.summary: Get VTI interface configuration
operations.description: Retrieves Virtual Tunnel Interface (VTI) configuration from an appliance. Returns all configured VTI interfaces with their IP addresses, labels, tunnel associations, and zone/VRF assignments.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval source. When 'true' or omitted, returns cached data from Orchestrator. When 'false', fetches fresh data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segments_enable_get918
operations.summary: Get Routing Segmentation enable status
operations.description: Retrieves the global Routing Segmentation (VRF) enable/disable status configured in Orchestrator. Returns a boolean indicating whether VRF segmentation is active. When disabled (default), all traffic uses the default segment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segments_enable_g_post919
operations.summary: Update Routing Segmentation enable status
operations.description: Enables or disables global Routing Segmentation (VRF) in Orchestrator. When enabling, validates all appliances support VRF (minimum version required). When disabling, ensures all non-default segments are deleted first. Enabling VRF also automatically enables End-to-End (E2E) zone-based firewall policies. Changes trigger orchestration to all managed appliances.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the Routing Segmentation enable/disable state. The 'enable' field is required and must be a boolean.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segment_map_get922
operations.summary: Get Inter-Segment DNAT policies
operations.description: Retrieves Inter-Segment Destination NAT (DNAT) policies configured in Orchestrator. These policies define traffic translation rules for cross-segment communication in VRF environments. Without srcSegmentId, returns all policies grouped by source segment. With srcSegmentId, returns policies for that specific segment only.

parameters.name: srcSegmentId
parameters.description: Optional source routing segment ID to filter DNAT policies. If omitted, returns all Inter-Segment DNAT policies for all segments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segment_map_post923
operations.summary: Create or update Inter-Segment DNAT policies for a source segment
operations.description: Creates or updates Inter-Segment Destination NAT (DNAT) policies for a specific source routing segment. Each policy defines traffic matching criteria and translation actions for cross-segment communication. Changes trigger orchestration to all managed appliances.

parameters.name: srcSegmentId
parameters.description: Source routing segment ID for which to create or update DNAT policies. Must be a non-negative integer representing an existing segment.

request_body.description: Map of DNAT policy rules keyed by priority number (integer). Lower priority numbers are evaluated first. Each rule defines match criteria and translation actions for inter-segment traffic.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segment_map_delete921
operations.summary: Delete Inter-Segment DNAT policies for a source segment
operations.description: Deletes all Inter-Segment Destination NAT (DNAT) policies configured for a specific source routing segment. This removes all traffic translation rules that apply when traffic originates from the specified segment. After deletion, changes are automatically queued for orchestration to all managed appliances.

parameters.name: srcSegmentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the source routing segment whose Inter-Segment DNAT policies will be deleted. Must be a non-negative integer.

operations.name: edgeconnect_security_map_get924
operations.summary: Get Security Policies for a segment map
operations.description: Retrieves zone-based firewall security policies for a specific segment-to-segment traffic flow. The policies define rules for allowing or denying traffic between routing segments based on matching criteria such as IP addresses, ports, protocols, and applications.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: Segment map identifier in format 'sourceSegmentId_destinationSegmentId'. Specifies the source and destination routing segments for which to retrieve security policies.

operations.name: edgeconnect_security_map_post925
operations.summary: Create or update Security Policies for a segment map
operations.description: Creates or updates zone-based firewall security policies for a specific segment-to-segment traffic flow. Policies define rules for allowing or denying traffic between routing segments based on matching criteria. Validates that both segment IDs and all zone IDs in the policies exist. Changes trigger orchestration to all managed appliances.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: Segment map identifier in format 'sourceSegmentId_destinationSegmentId'. Specifies the source and destination routing segments for which to create/update security policies. Both segment IDs must reference existing segments.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Optional audit log comment for tracking changes. Appears in system action logs with prefix 'Audit Log Comment'.

request_body.description: Security policies configuration containing firewall rules. The 'data' field is required and contains zone-to-zone policies keyed by 'map1'. Rules are prioritized by numeric key (lower = higher priority). Valid actions are 'allow' and 'deny'.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_security_maps926
operations.summary: Get all security policy segment map identifiers
operations.description: Retrieves all configured security policy segment map identifiers from Orchestrator. Returns a list of strings in format 'sourceSegmentId_destinationSegmentId' representing segment-to-segment firewall policy configurations. Use these identifiers with the /vrf/config/securityPolicies endpoint to retrieve or modify specific policies.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segment_get930
operations.summary: Get routing segments
operations.description: Retrieves routing segment (VRF) configurations from Orchestrator. Without the id parameter, returns all segments as a map keyed by segment ID. With an id parameter, returns only the specified segment. The default segment (id=0, name='Default') is always included when retrieving all segments. Segment names must be unique and contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of a routing segment to retrieve. If omitted, returns all segments. Use 0 for the default segment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segment_put931
operations.summary: Update an existing routing segment
operations.description: Updates an existing routing segment (VRF) configuration in Orchestrator. Only the segment name and comment can be modified; the segment ID cannot be changed. Validates that the new name is unique, contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores, and is not 'Default'. Changes trigger orchestration to all managed appliances.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the routing segment to update. Must be a positive integer (1-65400). The default segment (id=0) cannot be modified via this endpoint.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the updated segment properties. The 'name' field is required and must be unique across all segments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segments_post928
operations.summary: Create a new routing segment
operations.description: Creates a new routing segment (VRF) in Orchestrator. The segment ID is auto-generated and returned in the response. Segment names must be unique, contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores, and cannot be 'Default'. Creating a segment automatically associates it with all overlays and creates corresponding firewall zones. Changes trigger orchestration to all managed appliances.

request_body.description: JSON object containing the segment name. The 'name' field is required and must be unique across all segments. Only alphanumeric characters and underscores are allowed. The segment ID is auto-generated by the system.

operations.name: edgeconnect_segment_delete929
operations.summary: Delete a routing segment
operations.description: Deletes a routing segment (VRF) from Orchestrator. This operation removes the segment and all associated configurations including: internal subnets (IPv4/IPv6), overlay associations, Inter-Segment SNAT maps, DNAT policy maps, firewall zones and policies, loopback interfaces, port profiles, BGP configurations, and AWS tunnel settings. Changes trigger orchestration to all managed appliances. The default segment (id=0) cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the routing segment to delete. Must be a positive integer (greater than 0). The default segment (id=0) cannot be deleted.

operations.name: edgeconnect_snat_maps_get932
operations.summary: Get all Inter-Segment SNAT maps
operations.description: Retrieves all Inter-Segment Source NAT (SNAT) enable/disable configurations from Orchestrator. Each entry controls whether SNAT is applied for traffic between a specific source and destination segment pair. By default, SNAT is enabled for inter-segment traffic. Use this endpoint to manage SNAT overrides for specific segment combinations.

operations.name: edgeconnect_snat_maps_post933
operations.summary: Create or update Inter-Segment SNAT maps
operations.description: Creates or updates Inter-Segment Source NAT (SNAT) enable/disable configurations for segment-to-segment traffic flows. By default, SNAT is enabled for inter-segment traffic. Use this endpoint to disable SNAT for specific segment pairs when you need to preserve original source IP addresses. Validates that source and destination segment IDs are different. Changes trigger orchestration to all managed appliances.

request_body.description: Map of Inter-Segment SNAT configurations keyed by segment pair identifier. Each key must be in format 'sourceSegmentId_destinationSegmentId' where segment IDs are non-negative integers. Source and destination segment IDs must be different. Each value contains enable flag (controls SNAT), gms_marked (internal flag, always true), and optional comment.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_appliance_vrf_segment_policies
operations.summary: Get Inter-Segment DNAT policies from appliance
operations.description: Retrieves all Inter-Segment Destination NAT (DNAT) policies configured on a specific appliance. These policies define traffic translation rules for cross-segment (VRF) communication. The endpoint queries either the Orchestrator's cached data or fetches live configuration directly from the appliance based on the 'cached' parameter. Requires READ or READ_WRITE permissions.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data retrieval source. When true (default), returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When false, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_vrrp_get934
operations.summary: Get VRRP instances configured on an appliance
operations.description: Retrieves all VRRP (Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol) instances configured on a specific appliance. VRRP provides automatic failover between a master and backup router to ensure network availability. Maximum of 4 VRRP instances per interface.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator. When false, fetches live data directly from the appliance. Defaults to true if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_vxlan_config
operations.summary: Get VXLAN Configuration
operations.description: Retrieves the VXLAN (Virtual Extensible LAN) tunnel endpoint configuration for a specific appliance. Returns VTEP source interface and destination UDP port settings used for VXLAN encapsulation.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_vni_mappings
operations.summary: Get VRF to VNI Segment Mappings
operations.description: Retrieves the mapping between VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding) segments and VNI (VXLAN Network Identifier) configurations for a specific appliance. Returns zone ID and fallback role assignments for each VRF.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: fromGms
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_get_vxlan_state_details
operations.summary: Get VXLAN State Details
operations.description: Retrieves the VXLAN (Virtual Extensible LAN) operational state for a specific appliance. Returns VNI statistics, tunnel statistics, and tunnel state information used for monitoring VXLAN overlay network health.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Data source selector. When true, returns cached data from Orchestrator database. When false or omitted, fetches live data directly from the appliance.

operations.name: edgeconnect_vxoa_images_get935
operations.summary: List available ECOS/VXOA software images
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all ECOS/VXOA software images available on the Orchestrator. Images are scanned from the ftp/images directory and include both manually uploaded (.img/.zip) files and portal-downloaded images (prefixed with 'pdimage-'). Corrupted image files are automatically deleted during retrieval.

operations.name: edgeconnect_vxoa_images_delete936
operations.summary: Delete ECOS/VXOA image
operations.description: Deletes a specified ECOS/VXOA software image file from the Orchestrator's image repository. Requires READ_WRITE permission. The operation is logged in the action log upon successful deletion.

parameters.name: imageFile
parameters.description: The filename of the ECOS/VXOA image to delete from the Orchestrator. Must be a valid filename that exists in the images directory.

operations.name: edgeconnect_wccp_config_group937
operations.summary: Get WCCP service groups configuration
operations.description: Retrieves WCCP (Web Cache Communication Protocol) service groups configuration for a specified appliance. Returns an object where each key represents a service group ID and its value contains the complete group settings including interface, encapsulation method, assignment method, hash settings, and router information.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance. Defaults to true if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_wccp_config_system938
operations.summary: Get WCCP system configuration
operations.description: Retrieves WCCP (Web Cache Communication Protocol) system-level configuration for a specified appliance. Returns settings that control WCCP behavior globally including enable/disable status and multicast TTL value.

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance. Defaults to true if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_wccp_state939
operations.summary: Get WCCP operational state
operations.description: Retrieves WCCP (Web Cache Communication Protocol) operational state for a specified appliance. Returns both system-level state (protocol version, alive status, debug info) and per-group state (operational status, router/appliance counts, uptime, assignment method).

parameters.name: nePk
parameters.description: Network Element Primary Key - unique appliance identifier assigned by Orchestrator. Format: '<id>.NE' (e.g., '0.NE', '10.NE').

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: When true, retrieves data from Orchestrator cache. When false, fetches fresh data directly from the appliance. Defaults to true if not specified.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zones_get940
operations.summary: Retrieve firewall zones
operations.description: Returns all firewall zones defined in Orchestrator. When allVRFZones is true, returns zones from all VRF segments with unique IDs. When false or omitted, returns only the base zone definitions.

parameters.name: allVRFZones
parameters.description: When true, returns all zone names assigned to different VRF segments with segment-specific IDs. When false or omitted, returns unique base zone names only.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zones_post941
operations.summary: Create, update, or delete firewall zones
operations.description: Replaces the entire zones configuration with the provided map. Zones not in the request body will be deleted. New zone IDs must be >= nextId. Triggers appliance pending state for orchestration.

parameters.name: deleteDependencies
parameters.description: When true, removes deleted zones from overlays, security policies, port profiles, templates, AWS TGNM, Azure VWAN, and SSE connectors. Required parameter.

request_body.description: Complete map of zone IDs (as strings) to zone objects. This replaces all existing zones. Default zone (ID 0) is system-managed.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zone_ee_enable_get942
operations.summary: Get End-to-End Zone-Based Firewall status
operations.description: Retrieves the current End-to-End (E2E) Zone-Based Firewall configuration status. When enabled, zone-based firewall policies are enforced across all appliances in the SD-WAN fabric. Returns `false` by default if no configuration has been set.

operations.name: edgeconnect_zone_ee_enable_post943
operations.summary: Configure End-to-End Zone-Based Firewall
operations.description: Enables or disables End-to-End (E2E) Zone-Based Firewall across all SD-WAN appliances. Configuration changes are applied synchronously and logged for audit purposes.

request_body.description: E2E Zone-Based Firewall enable/disable configuration. Request body cannot be null.

operations.name: edgeconnect_next_id_get944
operations.summary: Get next available zone ID
operations.description: Returns the next available ID for creating a new firewall zone. The ID is dynamically calculated to avoid conflicts with existing zones across all VRF segments.

operations.name: edgeconnect_next_id_post945
operations.summary: Set next available zone ID
operations.description: Manually sets the next ID for firewall zone allocation. If null is provided, defaults to 1. The change is logged to the system action log for audit purposes.

request_body.description: Next ID configuration object. If null, defaults to nextId=1.

operations.name: edgeconnect_vrf_zones_map_get946
operations.summary: Get VRF segment zones mapping with full details
operations.description: Returns a flat list of all firewall zones across all VRF segments with complete details. Each entry includes zone ID, zone name, VRF segment ID, and VRF segment name. Unknown zone index entries are automatically filtered out.

operations.name: edgeconnect_vrf_zones_map_get947
operations.summary: Get VRF segment to zone index mapping
operations.description: Returns a hierarchical map of VRF segment IDs to their zone index maps. Each zone entry contains the zone ID and name. Zone indices with value 255 (unknown) are automatically filtered out from the response.
